`bf1943-auto-navkit-big-endian/tools/rsnvgrid1943.py`:

```py
r"""NavKit (big-endian): an RSNV world (core rsnv.py) from cells on a grid - the vehicle worlds' writer
(groundnav1943.py: jeeps and tanks; seanav1943.py: the landing craft; airnav1943.py: planes).

  sets = [CellSet(pitch, x0, z0, i, j, y, links)]      cells: grid indices, ground heights, 4-neighbour links
  write_world(lv, cls, sets, nodes, edges, offm, out, sector_offsets, header, meta)

A world holds what the soldier's export holds, built from cells instead of a NavKit .hpd:
  - SECT: the 100 m sectors (the soldier build's sector grid: XOffset / ZOffset from navkit.json), one record per
    sector and cell set; `layer` is the class id (vehicleclasses1943.CLASS_IDS);
  - AREA: per sector and cell set, flood-filled pieces of linked cells with at most one cell per column (so the
    bitmap and height grid are unique); bitmaps at the set's pitch, one height block per cell (hstep = pitch);
  - PORT: one record per pair of neighbouring areas (both directions), the shared cell edges' extent;
  - GBKT / GLST: 25 x 25 buckets of 4 m per sector record, areas by their bounding box, lowest first;
  - NODE / NAUX / EDGE / ANOD: route nodes at their cells' centres and ground, edges both ways unless one-way,
    integer costs in 1/16 m (the 3-D length unless given), kinds as given (walk = drive; drop for a launch);
  - ISLD: the graph's islands (MAIN on the largest, flags as given);
  - OFFM: transfers as given (kind, team mask, vehicle class, node, the soldier-side point, yaw, radius, aux);
  - META: exporter version, sources and their hashes, the class's parameters.
"""
import collections
import json
import math
import os
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt

import navkitjson1943 as nj  # noqa: E402
from bfbc2core import rsnv  # noqa: E402

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from groundnav1943 import Grid

type IntArray = npt.NDArray[np.int64]
type Links = dict[tuple[int, int, int], int]            # {(cell, di, dj): neighbour cell}
type Edge = tuple[int, int, int, float | None, bool]    # (node a, node b, kind, cost in m or None, both ways)
type Point = Sequence[float] | npt.NDArray[np.float64]  # x, y, z
type Log = Callable[[str], object]

EXPORTER_VERSION = '1.2 (2026-10-29: costs rounded up to 16 x length, the heuristic scale in the header)'
OFFM_ALIGHT_ZONE = 2         # design 1.3's OFFM kinds beside rsnv.py's BOARD_VEHICLE (1) and MOUNT_STATIC (5)
ALIGHT_TARGET_REACH = 60.0   # m: a ground vehicle's alight node lies within this of its base or flag
ALIGHT_REACH = 6.0           # m from the alight node to the soldier node


def soldier_node(soldier: rsnv.World, point: Point, reach: float, dy: float = 3.5, main_only: bool = False) -> int | None:
    """The soldier node nearest p horizontally within reach whose ground is within dy of p's height (lowest index on
    a tie; main_only: on the main island), or None - the rule the runtime resolves a transfer with again
    (core rsnvtrip.resolve)."""
    dist = np.hypot(soldier.node_pos[:, 0] - point[0], soldier.node_pos[:, 2] - point[2])
    within = (dist <= reach) & (np.abs(soldier.node_pos[:, 1] - point[1]) <= dy)
    if main_only:
        within &= soldier.node_island == 0
    if not within.any():
        return None
    candidates = np.nonzero(within)[0]
    return int(candidates[np.argmin(dist[candidates])])


STRAIGHT = ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1))
SECTOR_NUDGE = 1e-3          # m


class CellSet:
    """Cells of one grid: indices i, j (centre x0 + i * pitch, z0 + j * pitch), ground y, and links
    {(k, di, dj): n} between straight neighbours (only those are used for areas)."""

    def __init__(self, pitch: float, x0: float, z0: float, i: npt.ArrayLike, j: npt.ArrayLike, y: npt.ArrayLike,
                 links: Links, name: str = '') -> None:
        self.pitch, self.x0, self.z0 = float(pitch), float(x0), float(z0)
        self.i, self.j = np.asarray(i, np.int64), np.asarray(j, np.int64)
        self.y = np.asarray(y, np.float64)
        self.links = links
        self.name = name
        self.n = len(self.i)

    def xz(self, k: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
        """Cell k's centre (x, z)."""
        return self.x0 + int(self.i[k]) * self.pitch, self.z0 + int(self.j[k]) * self.pitch


def grid_links(mask_index: npt.NDArray[np.integer], di_dj: Iterable[tuple[int, int]] = STRAIGHT) -> Links:
    """Links between straight neighbours of a 2-D index grid (-1: no cell): {(k, di, dj): n}."""
    nz, nx = mask_index.shape
    out = {}
    for di, dj in di_dj:
        # the grid shifted by (di, dj): dst[r, c] is the neighbour of src[r, c]
        dst = mask_index[max(0, dj):nz + min(0, dj), max(0, di):nx + min(0, di)]
        src = mask_index[max(0, -dj):nz - max(0, dj), max(0, -di):nx - max(0, di)]
        both = (src >= 0) & (dst >= 0)
        for src_cell, dst_cell in zip(src[both].tolist(), dst[both].tolist()):
            out[(src_cell, di, dj)] = dst_cell
    return out


sha256 = nj.sha256                 # (navkitjson1943: one chunked SHA-256 for every tool)


def areas_of(cell_set: CellSet, sector_offsets: Sequence[int]) -> tuple[list[tuple[int, list[int]]], IntArray]:
    """[(sector id, [cell indices])] - flood fills of linked cells within each sector, one cell per column."""
    xoff, zoff = sector_offsets
    x = cell_set.x0 + cell_set.i * cell_set.pitch
    z = cell_set.z0 + cell_set.j * cell_set.pitch
    # a cell on a sector edge (x a multiple of 100 m, computed as i x 0.8 with rounding either side) goes to the sector
    # it starts: queries nudge the same way (rsnvhybrid.BUCKET_NUDGE), so the bucket holding it is found
    sector_x = np.floor((x + SECTOR_NUDGE) / 100.0).astype(np.int64) - xoff
    sector_z = np.floor((z + SECTOR_NUDGE) / 100.0).astype(np.int64) - zoff
    if cell_set.n and (sector_x.min() < 0 or sector_z.min() < 0 or sector_x.max() > 255 or sector_z.max() > 255):
        raise ValueError(f'{cell_set.name}: cells outside the sector grid (X {sector_x.min()}..{sector_x.max()}, '
                         f'Z {sector_z.min()}..{sector_z.max()})')
    sector = sector_x * 256 + sector_z
    order = np.lexsort((cell_set.i, cell_set.j, sector))
    area_of = np.full(cell_set.n, -1, np.int64)
    out = []
    links = cell_set.links
    for seed in order.tolist():
        if area_of[seed] >= 0:
            continue
        sector_id = int(sector[seed])
        area_id = len(out)
        columns = {(int(cell_set.i[seed]), int(cell_set.j[seed]))}
        members = [seed]
        area_of[seed] = area_id
        queue = collections.deque([seed])
        while queue:
            cell = queue.popleft()
            for di, dj in STRAIGHT:
                neighbour = links.get((cell, di, dj))
                if neighbour is None or area_of[neighbour] >= 0 or sector[neighbour] != sector_id:
                    continue
                column = (int(cell_set.i[neighbour]), int(cell_set.j[neighbour]))
                if column in columns:
                    continue
                columns.add(column)
                area_of[neighbour] = area_id
                members.append(neighbour)
                queue.append(neighbour)
        out.append((sector_id, members))
    return out, area_of


def write_world(lv: str, cls: str, sets: Sequence[CellSet], nodes: Sequence[tuple[int, int]], edges: Iterable[Edge],
                offm: Sequence[Sequence[Any]], out: str, sector_offsets: Sequence[int], header: Mapping[str, Any],
                meta: Mapping[str, Any], island_flags: Mapping[int, int] | None = None,
                node_flags: Sequence[int] | None = None, big_endian: bool = False, flag_tight: bool = True,
                log: Log = print) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """nodes: [(set index, cell index)]; edges: [(a, b, kind, cost_m or None, both_ways)]; offm: rows as rsnv.SCHEMA
    ['OFFM'] with the node as a node index; header: sea_level, radius, height, step, water_depth, source sha256 (hex);
    island_flags: {island: flags}; node_flags: [u16 per node]. Returns stats."""
    import vehicleclasses1943 as vc
    layer = vc.CLASS_IDS[cls]
    xoff, zoff = sector_offsets
    # areas per set, grouped by sector
    per_set = [areas_of(cell_set, sector_offsets) for cell_set in sets]
    sect_keys = sorted({(sector_id, set_index) for set_index, (set_areas, _) in enumerate(per_set)
                        for sector_id, _members in set_areas})
    area_rows, bmap, hght, area_cells = [], bytearray(), [], []
    area_index = {}                 # (set, local area) -> global area
    sect_rows, gbkt, glst = [], [], []
    by_key = collections.defaultdict(list)          # (sector id, set) -> [(local area, cells)]
    for set_index, (set_areas, _) in enumerate(per_set):
        for local_area, (sector_id, members) in enumerate(set_areas):
            by_key[(sector_id, set_index)].append((local_area, members))
    for sect_row, (sector_id, set_index) in enumerate(sect_keys):
        cell_set = sets[set_index]
        first_area = len(area_rows)
        for local_area, members in by_key[(sector_id, set_index)]:
            cells = np.asarray(members)
            ii, jj, yy = cell_set.i[cells], cell_set.j[cells], cell_set.y[cells]    # the area's cells: indices, ground
            i0, j0 = int(ii.min()), int(jj.min())
            width, height = int(ii.max()) - i0 + 1, int(jj.max()) - j0 + 1
            row_bytes = (width + 7) >> 3
            bits = np.zeros((height, row_bytes * 8), np.uint8)
            bits[jj - j0, ii - i0] = 1
            packed = np.packbits(bits.reshape(height, row_bytes, 8)[:, :, ::-1], axis=-1).reshape(-1)
            min_y, max_y = float(yy.min()), float(yy.max())
            grid = np.full((height, width), 0xFFFF, np.int64)
            grid[jj - j0, ii - i0] = np.minimum(np.round((yy - min_y) * 100).astype(np.int64), 0xFFFE)
            pitch_mm = int(round(cell_set.pitch * 1000))
            x0, z0 = cell_set.x0 + i0 * cell_set.pitch, cell_set.z0 + j0 * cell_set.pitch
            area_index[(set_index, local_area)] = len(area_rows)
            area_rows.append([x0, z0, x0 + (width - 1) * cell_set.pitch, z0 + (height - 1) * cell_set.pitch, min_y, max_y,
                              len(bmap), width, height, 0, 0, sect_row, 0, 0, 0, 0, pitch_mm, len(hght), width, height,
                              pitch_mm])
            bmap += packed.tobytes()
            hght += grid.ravel().tolist()
            area_cells.append((set_index, cells))
        sector_x, sector_z = sector_id // 256, sector_id % 256
        sector_x0, sector_z0 = (sector_x + xoff) * 100.0, (sector_z + zoff) * 100.0
        first_bucket = len(gbkt)
        buckets = [[] for _ in range(rsnv.BUCKETS * rsnv.BUCKETS)]
        for k in range(first_area, len(area_rows)):
            box = area_rows[k]                          # min x, min z, max x, max z of the cell centres
            half = sets[set_index].pitch / 2
            bucket_i0 = max(int((box[0] - half - sector_x0) // rsnv.BUCKET), 0)
            bucket_i1 = min(int((box[2] + half - sector_x0) // rsnv.BUCKET), rsnv.BUCKETS - 1)
            bucket_j0 = max(int((box[1] - half - sector_z0) // rsnv.BUCKET), 0)
            bucket_j1 = min(int((box[3] + half - sector_z0) // rsnv.BUCKET), rsnv.BUCKETS - 1)
            for bj in range(bucket_j0, bucket_j1 + 1):
                for bi in range(bucket_i0, bucket_i1 + 1):
                    buckets[bj * rsnv.BUCKETS + bi].append(k)
        for bucket in buckets:
            bucket.sort(key=lambda k: (area_rows[k][4], k))
            gbkt.append((len(glst), len(bucket)))
            glst += bucket
        normal_pitch = 1 if sets[set_index].pitch >= 0.5 else 0
        sect_rows.append(((sector_x << 8) | sector_z, layer, normal_pitch, sector_x0, sector_z0, sector_x0 + 100.0,
                          sector_z0 + 100.0, first_bucket, first_area, len(area_rows) - first_area, 0))
    if len(area_rows) >= 0xFFFF:
        raise ValueError(f'{len(area_rows)} areas: more than an RSNV area id holds')
    # global area of every cell
    cell_area = [np.full(cell_set.n, -1, np.int64) for cell_set in sets]
    for set_index, (set_areas, local) in enumerate(per_set):
        if set_areas:
            global_of_local = np.array([area_index[(set_index, local_area)] for local_area in range(len(set_areas))],
                                       np.int64)
        else:
            global_of_local = np.zeros(0, np.int64)
        cell_area[set_index] = global_of_local[local] if len(local) else local
    # portals: neighbouring cells in different areas (same set)
    port_pairs = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for set_index, cell_set in enumerate(sets):
        areas = cell_area[set_index]
        for (k, di, dj), n in cell_set.links.items():
            if (di, dj) not in STRAIGHT:
                continue
            area_a, area_b = int(areas[k]), int(areas[n])
            if area_a != area_b and area_a >= 0 and area_b >= 0:
                x, z = cell_set.xz(k)
                port_pairs[(area_a, area_b)].append((x + di * cell_set.pitch / 2, z + dj * cell_set.pitch / 2,
                                                     (cell_set.y[k] + cell_set.y[n]) / 2))
    per_area = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for (area_a, area_b), edge_points in port_pairs.items():
        points = np.array(edge_points)                       # the shared edges' midpoints: x, z, y
        per_area[area_a].append((float(points[:, 0].min()), float(points[:, 1].min()), float(points[:, 0].max()),
                                 float(points[:, 1].max()), float(points[:, 2].mean()), area_a, area_b))
    portals = []
    for k in range(len(area_rows)):
        area_rows[k][9] = len(portals)
        area_rows[k][10] = len(per_area[k])
        portals += sorted(per_area[k], key=lambda portal: portal[6])
    # nodes and edges
    node_xyz = []
    for set_index, k in nodes:
        x, z = sets[set_index].xz(k)
        node_xyz.append([x, sets[set_index].y[k], z])
    pos = np.array(node_xyz, np.float64).reshape(-1, 3)
    node_area = np.array([cell_area[set_index][k] for set_index, k in nodes], np.int64)
    adjacency = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    pos32 = pos.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64)       # the node positions as the file holds them (float32)
    for a, b, kind, cost, both in edges:
        # drive edges cost 16 x their length between the float32 positions as the search measures it (x, y summed, then
        # z), rounded up (exporter 1.4's rule: no chain of edges then costs less than the heuristic); a given cost (a
        # launch's drop: its horizontal run) no less than that either, so the header's scale stays near 0.999
        delta = pos32[b] - pos32[a]
        length = math.sqrt((delta[0] * delta[0] + delta[1] * delta[1]) + delta[2] * delta[2])
        cost_m = cost if cost is not None else length
        cost_q = max(1, min(int(math.ceil(cost_m * 16.0 - 1e-9)), 0xFFFF), min(int(math.ceil(16.0 * length)), 0xFFFF))
        adjacency[a][b] = (kind, cost_q)
        if both:
            adjacency[b][a] = (kind, cost_q)
    edge_rows, first_edge = [], []
    for node in range(len(nodes)):
        first_edge.append(len(edge_rows))
        for b in sorted(adjacency[node]):
            kind, cost_q = adjacency[node][b]
            edge_rows.append((int(b) | (int(kind) << 24), cost_q, 0))
    first_edge.append(len(edge_rows))
    # islands (undirected)
    parent = list(range(len(nodes)))

    def find(x: int) -> int:
        while parent[x] != x:
            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
            x = parent[x]
        return x
    for a in adjacency:
        for b in adjacency[a]:
            root_a, root_b = find(a), find(b)
            if root_a != root_b:
                parent[max(root_a, root_b)] = min(root_a, root_b)
    root = np.array([find(x) for x in range(len(nodes))], np.int64)
    roots, root_of_node, counts = np.unique(root, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    order = np.argsort(-counts, kind='stable')
    rank = np.empty(len(roots), np.int64)               # islands numbered largest first
    rank[order] = np.arange(len(roots))
    island = rank[root_of_node] if len(nodes) else np.zeros(0, np.int64)
    island_rows = []
    for island_k in range(len(roots)):
        members = np.nonzero(island == island_k)[0]
        flags = (rsnv.ISLD_MAIN if island_k == 0 else 0) | ((island_flags or {}).get(island_k, 0))
        island_rows.append([len(members), int(members[0]), flags, 0, 0])
    # transfers per island (OFFM sorted by island, then as given); row[3]: the transfer's vehicle node
    offm = sorted(offm, key=lambda row: (int(island[row[3]]) if row[3] != 0xFFFFFFFF else 1 << 30))
    for k, row in enumerate(offm):
        if row[3] == 0xFFFFFFFF:
            continue
        island_row = island_rows[int(island[row[3]])]
        if island_row[3] == 0:
            island_row[4] = k
        island_row[3] += 1
    # areas: island and nodes
    anod = []
    by_area = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for node, area in enumerate(node_area.tolist()):
        if area >= 0:
            by_area[area].append(node)
    for k, row in enumerate(area_rows):
        area_nodes = by_area.get(k, [])
        row[12] = collections.Counter(island[area_nodes].tolist()).most_common(1)[0][0] if area_nodes else 0xFFFF
        row[14], row[15] = len(anod), len(area_nodes)
        anod += area_nodes
    flags_of_node = node_flags if node_flags is not None else [0] * len(nodes)
    node_rows = [(float(x), float(y), float(z), int(first_edge[n])) for n, (x, y, z) in enumerate(pos)]
    node_rows.append((0.0, 0.0, 0.0, int(first_edge[-1])))
    naux = []
    for node in range(len(nodes)):
        area = int(node_area[node])
        naux.append((area if area >= 0 else 0xFFFF, area_rows[area][11] if area >= 0 else 0, int(island[node]),
                     int(flags_of_node[node])))
    meta = dict(meta)
    meta.setdefault('exporter', 'rsnvgrid1943 ' + EXPORTER_VERSION)
    meta['level'] = lv
    meta['class'] = cls
    meta['layer'] = layer
    meta['params'] = vc.params_id(cls)          # the class's parameters (navexport_vehicles1943.check compares them)
    meta['counts'] = {'nodes': len(nodes), 'edges': len(edge_rows), 'areas': len(area_rows), 'portals': len(portals),
                      'sectors': len(sect_rows), 'islands': len(island_rows), 'transfers': len(offm),
                      'cells': int(sum(cell_set.n for cell_set in sets))}
    sections = {'SECT': sect_rows, 'NODE': node_rows, 'NAUX': naux, 'EDGE': edge_rows,
                'AREA': [tuple(row) for row in area_rows], 'PORT': portals, 'BMAP': bytes(bmap),
                'HGHT': [(value,) for value in hght], 'GBKT': gbkt, 'GLST': [(value,) for value in glst],
                'ANOD': [(value,) for value in anod], 'OFFM': [tuple(row) for row in offm],
                'ISLD': [tuple(row) for row in island_rows],
                'META': json.dumps(meta, indent=1).encode('utf-8')}
    if not offm:
        del sections['OFFM']
    # the search heuristic's scale (rsnv.heuristic_scale): the least edge cost per 1/16 m of length, so the heuristic
    # floor(16 x distance x scale) never overestimates a path (admissible, as the soldier worlds from exporter 1.4)
    srcs = np.repeat(np.arange(len(nodes)), np.diff(np.asarray(first_edge, np.int64)))
    dsts = np.array([int(row[0]) & 0xFFFFFF for row in edge_rows], np.int64)
    h_scale_q = rsnv.heuristic_scale(pos, srcs, dsts, [row[1] for row in edge_rows]) if edge_rows else 0
    meta['heuristic scale'] = h_scale_q / rsnv.H_SCALE_ONE if h_scale_q else None
    sections['META'] = json.dumps(meta, indent=1).encode('utf-8')
    file_header = {'level': lv, 'sea_level': header['sea_level'], 'radius': header['radius'],
                   'height': header['height'], 'step': header['step'], 'water_depth': header['water_depth'],
                   'hpd_sha256': header.get('sha256', '0' * 8), 'h_scale_q': h_scale_q}
    size = rsnv.write(out, sections, file_header, big_endian)
    if flag_tight:
        # tight edges: drive edges with no line of sight either way under the runtime's rule (rsnv.World.los), as
        # navexport1943 flags the soldier's; the file is written again with the flags
        world = rsnv.load(out)
        edge_source = np.repeat(np.arange(len(nodes)), np.diff(world.node_first_edge))
        edge_pairs = list(zip(edge_source.tolist(), world.edge_target.tolist()))
        tight = set()
        index = {(int(a), int(b)): k for k, (a, b) in enumerate(edge_pairs)}

        def f32(coords: Point) -> tuple[float, ...]:
            """The point as the file holds it (float32)."""
            return tuple(float(np.float32(x)) for x in coords)
        for k, (a, b) in enumerate(edge_pairs):
            # each pair once: an edge whose reverse is in the file is looked at from its lower node
            if int(world.edge_kind[k]) != rsnv.EDGE_WALK or k in tight or a > b and (b, a) in index:
                continue
            pa, pb = f32(world.node_pos[a]), f32(world.node_pos[b])
            if not world.los(pa, pb) and not world.los(pb, pa):
                tight.add(k)
                if (b, a) in index:
                    tight.add(index[(b, a)])
        sections['EDGE'] = [(target, cost, rsnv.EDGEF_TIGHT if k in tight else 0)
                            for k, (target, cost, _flags) in enumerate(edge_rows)]
        meta['counts']['tight edges'] = len(tight)
        sections['META'] = json.dumps(meta, indent=1).encode('utf-8')
        size = rsnv.write(out, sections, file_header, big_endian)
    stats: dict[str, Any] = dict(meta['counts'])
    stats['bytes'] = size
    stats['island sizes'] = [row[0] for row in island_rows[:8]]
    log(f'  RSNV {out}: {size / 1e6:.2f} MB, {len(nodes)} nodes, {len(edge_rows)} edges, {len(area_rows)} areas, '
        f'{len(island_rows)} islands (largest {island_rows[0][0] if island_rows else 0}), {len(offm)} transfers')
    return stats


def export_surfaces(lv: str, cls: str, grid: 'Grid', kept: npt.NDArray[np.bool_], table: Links, nodes: Sequence[int],
                    edges: Iterable[tuple[int, int]], seeds: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], out: str,
                    st: Mapping[str, Any], sources: Mapping[str, str | None], sea: float, log: Log = print,
                    soldier: str | None = None,
                    objectives: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """groundnav1943's world: the kept surfaces as one cell set, boarding transfers at the class's spawns."""
    import vehicleclasses1943 as vc
    kept_cells = np.nonzero(kept)[0]
    local = np.full(grid.n, -1, np.int64)                  # surface index -> index in the cell set
    local[kept_cells] = np.arange(len(kept_cells))
    links = {}
    for (k, di, dj), n in table.items():
        if (di, dj) in STRAIGHT and kept[k] and kept[n]:
            links[(int(local[k]), di, dj)] = int(local[n])
    cell_set = CellSet(grid.pitch, grid.x0, grid.z0, grid.i[kept_cells], grid.j[kept_cells], grid.y[kept_cells], links,
                       name=f'{lv} {cls}')
    node_list = [(0, int(local[n])) for n in nodes]
    node_index = {n: k for k, n in enumerate(nodes)}
    edge_list = [(node_index[a], node_index[b], rsnv.EDGE_WALK, None, True) for a, b in edges]
    # node flags: shallow / wading by the water over them
    depth = sea - grid.y[np.asarray(nodes, np.int64)] if nodes else np.zeros(0)
    flags_of_node = np.zeros(len(nodes), np.int64)
    flags_of_node[(depth > 0) & (depth <= 0.5)] |= rsnv.NAUX_SHALLOW
    flags_of_node[depth > 0.5] |= rsnv.NAUX_WADE
    # boarding: each spawn of the class, its entry points on the soldier side, the vehicle's own node
    node_xyz = []
    for n in nodes:
        x, z = cell_set.xz(local[n])
        node_xyz.append([x, grid.y[n], z])
    node_pos = np.array(node_xyz).reshape(-1, 3)
    offm, board, alight = [], [], []
    soldier_world = rsnv.load(soldier) if soldier and os.path.isfile(soldier) else None
    for seed in seeds:
        if seed['class'] != cls or not len(node_pos):
            continue
        spawn = seed['pos']
        dist = (np.hypot(node_pos[:, 0] - spawn[0], node_pos[:, 2] - spawn[2])
                + 2 * np.abs(node_pos[:, 1] - spawn[1]))
        node = int(np.argmin(dist))
        team = {1: 1, 2: 2}.get(seed['team'], 3)
        entries = seed['entries'] or [{'point': spawn, 'radius': 4.0, 'order': 0}]
        for entry in entries:
            if entry.get('order', 0) != 0:
                continue                                     # the driver's seat
            # the soldier's node at the entry (on foot)
            foot_node = (soldier_node(soldier_world, entry['point'], float(entry['radius']) + 2.0)
                         if soldier_world is not None else None)
            offm.append((rsnv.OFFM_BOARD_VEHICLE, team, vc.CLASS_IDS[cls], node if dist[node] <= 12.0 else 0xFFFFFFFF,
                         *[float(v) for v in entry['point']], float(seed['yaw']), float(entry['radius']),
                         foot_node if foot_node is not None else 0xFFFFFFFF))
            board.append({'vehicle': seed['vehicle'], 'spawn': seed['index'], 'node': node,
                          'distance': round(float(dist[node]), 2), 'soldier node': foot_node,
                          # (foot_node is None without a soldier world)
                          'soldier island': (int(soldier_world.node_island[foot_node])  # pyright: ignore[reportOptionalMemberAccess]
                                             if foot_node is not None else None)})
    # leaving the vehicle: at the drivable node nearest each base and flag (and each boarding spawn), onto the soldier
    # node nearest it on the main island (the exits are 1.8-2.5 m beside the body [O])
    if soldier_world is not None and len(node_pos):
        targets = [(objective.get('name'), objective['position']) for objective in (objectives or []) if objective.get('position')]
        targets += [(f'spawn {b["spawn"]}', node_pos[b['node']].tolist()) for b in board]
        for name, target in targets:
            dist = np.hypot(node_pos[:, 0] - target[0], node_pos[:, 2] - target[2])
            for node in np.argsort(dist, kind='stable')[:40].tolist():
                if dist[node] > ALIGHT_TARGET_REACH:
                    break
                foot_node = soldier_node(soldier_world, node_pos[node], ALIGHT_REACH, 2.5, main_only=True)
                if foot_node is not None:
                    soldier_pos = soldier_world.node_pos[foot_node]
                    reach = float(np.hypot(soldier_pos[0] - node_pos[node, 0], soldier_pos[2] - node_pos[node, 2]))
                    offm.append((OFFM_ALIGHT_ZONE, 3, vc.CLASS_IDS[cls], node, float(soldier_pos[0]),
                                 float(soldier_pos[1]), float(soldier_pos[2]), 0.0, reach, foot_node))
                    alight.append({'target': name, 'node': node, 'soldier node': foot_node,
                                   'from target': round(float(dist[node]), 1)})
                    break
    meta = {'sources': {k: {'path': v, 'sha256': sha256(v)} for k, v in sources.items() if v and os.path.isfile(v)},
            'class parameters': {k: list(v) if isinstance(v, tuple) else v for k, v in vc.CLASSES[cls].items()},
            'boarding': board, 'alighting': alight}
    header = {'sea_level': sea, 'radius': vc.value(cls, 'radius'), 'height': vc.value(cls, 'height'),
              'step': vc.value(cls, 'step'), 'water_depth': vc.value(cls, 'water_depth'),
              'sha256': meta['sources'].get('samples', {}).get('sha256', '0' * 8)}
    return write_world(lv, cls, [cell_set], node_list, edge_list, offm, out, st['sector_offsets'], header, meta,
                       node_flags=flags_of_node.tolist(), log=log)

```

`bf1943-auto-navkit-big-endian/tools/rsnvtool.py`:

```py
r"""RSNV tool: look inside a navigation export (core/bfbc2core/rsnv.py, written by navexport1943.py and
navexport_vehicles1943.py), ask it questions, draw it, and compare two of them.

  rsnvtool.py info <file|level> [--class C]                     header, sections, counts, edge kinds, tight edges, islands
  rsnvtool.py validate <file|level> [--class C]                 consistency (rsnv.World.validate); exit 1 on a problem
  rsnvtool.py locate <file|level> X Y Z [--max-dist M]          the walkable cell and nearest node under a point
  rsnvtool.py los <file|level> X,Y,Z X,Y,Z                      line of sight between two points (the runtime's rule)
  rsnvtool.py route <file|level> FROM TO [--soldier] [--png F]  a search between nodes or points (X,Y,Z), as rsnav finds it
  rsnvtool.py pockets <file|level> [--top N]                    the main network's pieces when tight edges are left out
                                                                (weakly connected, disjoint), and the one-way share
  rsnvtool.py tight <file|level> [--samples] [--json F]         every tight walk edge: its ends' areas, the first
                                                                failing line-of-sight sample each way, the rule that
                                                                refuses it and by how much, a cause; --samples adds
                                                                the build's own samples there (a level's work folder)
  rsnvtool.py cells <file|level> --at X,Z --y Y [--radius R] [--dy D] [--samples] [--line A B]
                                                                text maps around a point: each area's cells, the
                                                                build's samples on both grids, a line over them
  rsnvtool.py walk <level> A B [--reach R]                      the build's kept samples along a line (A, B: nodes or
                                                                X,Y,Z), both grids: the surface followed column by
                                                                column, the largest step, the gaps, the end's offset
  rsnvtool.py picture <file|level> --at X,Z [--radius R] [--y Y [--dy D]] [--route FROM TO] [--png F]
                                                                top-down: cells, edges (tight ones red), nodes, a route;
                                                                --y draws only the floors near that height
  rsnvtool.py diff <a> <b>                                       what changed between two exports

<file|level> is an .rsnv path or a level name (work\levels\<level>\navkit\<level>.rsnv; --class jeep|tank|lcvp|plane
for a vehicle world). FROM / TO are node numbers or points X,Y,Z (the nearest walkable cell's area node). --soldier
searches with the runtime's soldier filter (water x1.5 / x3, a tight edge +50 m); otherwise the file's own costs.
Pictures default to work\levels\<level>\navkit\rsnvtool-*.png. Reads only; never writes an export.
"""
import argparse
import collections
import math
import os
import re
import sys
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable, Iterator, Sequence
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
if __name__ == '__main__':      # the suite's bootstrap (core/suitepath.py)
    import pathlib
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, str(next(p for p in pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents if (p / 'core' / 'suitepath.py').is_file()) / 'core'))
    import suitepath
    suitepath.use(suitepath.NAVKIT_BE)
from bfbc2core import game1943, rsnv  # noqa: E402

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    import numpy as np
    import numpy.typing as npt
    from navsample import Samples

type Point = tuple[float, ...]                  # x, y, z
type World = rsnv.World

# rsnav's rsn_filter_soldier, without the dynamic state
SOLDIER: dict[str, Any] = {'water_scale': (256, 384, 768), 'tight_extra': 800,
                           'kind_mask': (1 << 7) - 1 & ~(1 << rsnv.EDGE_BOARD) & ~(1 << rsnv.EDGE_ALIGHT)}


def resolve(spec: str, klass: str | None = None) -> str:
    """An .rsnv path, or a level name's export (with --class, its vehicle world)."""
    if os.path.isfile(spec):
        return spec
    path = os.path.join(game1943.level_work(spec), 'navkit', f'{spec}.{klass}.rsnv' if klass else f'{spec}.rsnv')
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'{path}: no such export (navexport1943.py {spec}'
                                f'{"; navexport_vehicles1943.py " + spec if klass else ""})')
    return path


def out_dir(path: str) -> str:
    """The folder of a file (pictures go beside the export)."""
    return os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))


def point(text: str) -> Point:
    """A point X,Y,Z."""
    values = [float(x) for x in text.split(',')]
    if len(values) != 3:
        raise ValueError(f'{text!r}: a point is X,Y,Z')
    return tuple(values)


def node_of(world: World, text: str) -> int:
    """A node number, or the node of the walkable cell nearest a point X,Y,Z."""
    if ',' not in text:
        node = int(text)
        if not 0 <= node < len(world.node_pos):
            raise ValueError(f'node {node}: the file has nodes 0..{len(world.node_pos) - 1}')
        return node
    x, y, z = point(text)
    loc = world.locate(x, y, z, max_dist=6.0)
    if loc is None:
        raise ValueError(f'{text}: no walkable cell within 6 m')
    node = world.nearest_node(loc[0], x, z)
    if node is None:
        raise ValueError(f'{text}: area {loc[0]} has no node')
    return node


def edge_source(world: World) -> list[int]:
    """The source node of every edge (the edges are stored grouped by source)."""
    sources = [0] * len(world.edge_target)
    for n in range(len(world.node_pos)):
        for k in range(int(world.node_first_edge[n]), int(world.node_first_edge[n + 1])):
            sources[k] = n
    return sources


def _kept_edges(world: World, nodes: Iterable[int]) -> Iterator[tuple[int, int]]:
    """(a, b) of every edge between two of `nodes` that is not tight."""
    inside = set(nodes)
    for a in inside:
        for k in range(int(world.node_first_edge[a]), int(world.node_first_edge[a + 1])):
            b = int(world.edge_target[k])
            if b in inside and not int(world.edge_flags[k]) & rsnv.EDGEF_TIGHT:
                yield a, b


def pieces(world: World, nodes: Iterable[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """The pieces of `nodes` when tight edges are left out: weakly connected components (an edge joins its ends
    whichever way it runs), disjoint, largest first, each sorted. 2026-10-30 second review: the pieces followed
    outgoing edges only and could take nodes of an earlier piece again (1 -> 0 alone gave [[0, 1], [0]]), so pieces
    overlapped and the share outside the largest could be counted twice."""
    parent = {n: n for n in nodes}                   # union-find

    def root(n: int) -> int:
        while parent[n] != n:
            parent[n] = parent[parent[n]]
            n = parent[n]
        return n
    for a, b in _kept_edges(world, nodes):
        root_a, root_b = root(a), root(b)
        if root_a != root_b:
            parent[max(root_a, root_b)] = min(root_a, root_b)
    groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for n in parent:
        groups[root(n)].append(n)
    return sorted((sorted(group) for group in groups.values()), key=lambda group: (-len(group), group[0]))


def strong_core(world: World, nodes: Sequence[int]) -> list[int]:
    """The largest strongly connected component of `nodes` without tight edges (every node of it reaches every other
    one and back), sorted: the nodes of a piece outside it can be left but not reached again, or reached but not left
    (one-way edges: a drop, a one-way link)."""
    out_edges, in_edges = collections.defaultdict(list), collections.defaultdict(list)
    for a, b in _kept_edges(world, nodes):
        out_edges[a].append(b)
        in_edges[b].append(a)
    order, seen = [], set()
    for seed in nodes:                               # Kosaraju, iteratively: finishing order on the edges ...
        if seed in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(seed)
        stack = [(seed, iter(out_edges[seed]))]
        while stack:
            node, targets = stack[-1]
            for target in targets:
                if target not in seen:
                    seen.add(target)
                    stack.append((target, iter(out_edges[target])))
                    break
            else:
                stack.pop()
                order.append(node)
    best, done = [], set()
    for seed in reversed(order):                     # ... then the components on the reversed edges
        if seed in done:
            continue
        component, todo = [seed], [seed]
        done.add(seed)
        while todo:
            node = todo.pop()
            for source in in_edges[node]:
                if source not in done:
                    done.add(source)
                    component.append(source)
                    todo.append(source)
        if len(component) > len(best) or (len(component) == len(best) and min(component) < min(best)):
            best = component
    return sorted(best)


def _tight_count(world: World) -> int:
    return sum(1 for k in range(len(world.edge_target)) if int(world.edge_flags[k]) & rsnv.EDGEF_TIGHT)


def cmd_info(world: World, path: str) -> int:
    kinds = collections.Counter(int(k) for k in world.edge_kind)
    walk = kinds.get(rsnv.EDGE_WALK, 0)
    tight = _tight_count(world)
    conditional = sum(1 for k in range(len(world.edge_target)) if int(world.edge_flags[k]) & rsnv.EDGEF_COND)
    pitches = collections.Counter(round(a.pitch, 1) for a in world.areas)
    kind_counts = ', '.join(f'{rsnv.EDGE_NAMES[k] if k < len(rsnv.EDGE_NAMES) else k} {count}'
                            for k, count in sorted(kinds.items()))
    print(f'{path}')
    print(f'  {os.path.getsize(path) / 1e6:.2f} MB, {"big" if world.big_endian else "little"}-endian, level id '
          f'{world.level_id:#010x}, sea level {world.sea_level:.2f} m; agent radius {world.radius} m, '
          f'height {world.agent_height} m, step {world.step} m, water {world.water_depth} m')
    print('  sections: ' + ', '.join(f'{tag} {count}' for tag, (_offset, count, _stride) in world.sections.items()))
    print(f'  {len(world.node_pos)} nodes, {len(world.edge_target)} edges ({kind_counts}); tight {tight} of {walk} '
          f'walk edges ({100 * tight / max(walk, 1):.2f} %); conditional {conditional}')
    print(f'  {len(world.areas)} areas ('
          + ', '.join(f'{pitch} m: {count}' for pitch, count in sorted(pitches.items())) + '), '
          f'{len(getattr(world, "ports", []))} portals, {len(world.ladders)} ladder / jump records, '
          f'{len(world.offmesh)} off-mesh records, {len(world.objects)} objects')
    island_sizes = collections.Counter(int(i) for i in world.node_island)
    largest = island_sizes.most_common(1)[0] if island_sizes else (None, 0)
    print(f'  {len(island_sizes)} islands; the largest (island {largest[0]}) has {largest[1]} nodes')
    meta = world.meta or {}
    if meta:
        sources = ', '.join(f"{name} {source.get('sha256', '')[:12]}"
                            for name, source in (meta.get('sources') or {}).items())
        print(f"  exporter {meta.get('exporter', '?')}; sources: " + sources)
    return 0


def cmd_validate(world: World, path: str) -> int:
    problems = world.validate()
    for problem in problems:
        print(f'  {problem}')
    print(f'{path}: {len(problems)} problem(s)')
    return 1 if problems else 0


def cmd_locate(world: World, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    loc = world.locate(args.x, args.y, args.z, max_dist=args.max_dist)
    if loc is None:
        print(f'no walkable cell within {args.max_dist} m of ({args.x}, {args.y}, {args.z})')
        return 1
    area_index, (i, j), dist = loc
    area = world.areas[area_index]
    node = world.nearest_node(area_index, args.x, args.z)
    if node is not None:
        node_at = tuple(round(float(v), 2) for v in world.node_pos[node])
        print(f'area {area_index} (pitch {area.pitch} m, sector {area.sector}), cell ({i}, {j}) at {dist:.2f} m, '
              f'ground {world.ground(area, args.x, args.z):.2f} m; nearest node {node} at {node_at}')
    else:
        print(f'area {area_index}, cell ({i}, {j}) at {dist:.2f} m; the area has no node')
    return 0


def search(world: World, start: int, goal: int, soldier: bool) -> tuple[str, int, list[int], int]:
    """rsnv.search with the file's own costs, or with the runtime's soldier filter (SOLDIER)."""
    return rsnv.search(world, start, goal, **(SOLDIER if soldier else {}))


def cmd_route(world: World, args: argparse.Namespace, path: str) -> int:
    start, goal = node_of(world, args.start), node_of(world, args.goal)
    status, cost, nodes, expansions = search(world, start, goal, args.soldier)
    length = sum(math.dist(world.node_pos[src], world.node_pos[dst]) for src, dst in zip(nodes, nodes[1:]))
    kinds = collections.Counter()
    tight = 0
    for src, dst in zip(nodes, nodes[1:]):                 # the edge p -> q taken: its kind, whether it is tight
        for k in range(int(world.node_first_edge[src]), int(world.node_first_edge[src + 1])):
            if int(world.edge_target[k]) == dst:
                kinds[rsnv.EDGE_NAMES[int(world.edge_kind[k])]] += 1
                tight += bool(int(world.edge_flags[k]) & rsnv.EDGEF_TIGHT)
                break
    print(f'{start} -> {goal}: {status}, cost {cost / 16:.1f} m over {length:.1f} m, {len(nodes)} nodes, {expansions} '
          f'expansions; edges {dict(kinds)}, tight {tight}' + (' (soldier filter)' if args.soldier else ''))
    if args.png:
        points = [tuple(float(v) for v in world.node_pos[n]) for n in nodes]
        xs, zs = [src[0] for src in points], [src[2] for src in points]
        cx, cz = (min(xs) + max(xs)) / 2, (min(zs) + max(zs)) / 2
        radius = max(max(xs) - min(xs), max(zs) - min(zs)) / 2 + 8
        if args.png != '-':
            png = args.png
        else:
            png = os.path.join(out_dir(path), f'rsnvtool-route-{start}-{goal}.png')
        picture(world, cx, cz, radius, nodes, png)
    return 0 if status == rsnv.DONE else 1


def cmd_pockets(world: World, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    island_sizes = collections.Counter(int(i) for i in world.node_island)
    main_id = island_sizes.most_common(1)[0][0]
    main = [n for n in range(len(world.node_pos)) if int(world.node_island[n]) == main_id]
    parts = pieces(world, main)                          # disjoint: the shares below add up to the main network
    outside = sum(len(part) for part in parts[1:])
    print(f'main network (island {main_id}): {len(main)} nodes; without tight edges {len(parts)} pieces, the largest '
          f'{len(parts[0])}; {outside} nodes ({100 * outside / len(main):.2f} %) outside it')
    core = strong_core(world, parts[0])
    one_way = len(parts[0]) - len(core)
    print(f'  of the largest piece, {one_way} nodes ({100 * one_way / len(main):.2f} %) are outside its strongly '
          f'connected core (reached but not left, or left but not reached again, by one-way edges)')
    for part in parts[1:1 + args.top]:
        centre = [sum(float(world.node_pos[n][i]) for n in part) / len(part) for i in range(3)]
        print(f'  {len(part):5d} nodes around ({centre[0]:.1f}, {centre[1]:.1f}, {centre[2]:.1f})')
    return 0


def end_info(world: World, p: Sequence[float]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The area under an edge's end (a node position): index, sector id, pitch, layer, cell and ground."""
    loc = world.locate(p[0], p[1], p[2], max_dist=1.0)
    if loc is None:
        return {'area': None}
    area_index, (i, j), _dist = loc
    area = world.areas[area_index]
    sector = world.sectors[area.sector]
    return {'area': area_index, 'sector': f'{int(sector[0]):04x}', 'layer': int(sector[1]),
            'pitch': round(area.pitch, 1), 'cell': [i, j], 'ground': round(world.ground(area, p[0], p[2]), 3)}


def _hood(world: World, area: rsnv.Area, x: float, z: float) -> str:
    """The 3 x 3 cells of the area around (x, z), rows from +z down: '#' walkable, '.' not, ' ' outside the bitmap."""
    i, j, _in = world._cell_of(area, x, z)

    def mark(a: int, b: int) -> str:
        if not (0 <= a < area.width and 0 <= b < area.height):
            return ' '
        return '#' if world.walkable(area, a, b) else '.'
    rows = []
    for dj in (1, 0, -1):
        rows.append(''.join(mark(i + di, j + dj) for di in (-1, 0, 1)))
    return '/'.join(rows)


def los_failure(world: World, pa: Sequence[float], pb: Sequence[float]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """None when pa sees pb; otherwise the first failing sample (rsnv.World.los's trace) with what lies there: the
    current area's cells, every nearby area with ground on that spot (its height against the current area's, and the
    allowance), and a cause: 'hole' (no other area has a cell there: a gap in the cells, its length along the line),
    'step' (cells there, all beyond the height allowance), 'lean' (the sample on its 0.8 m area's ground, a neighbour
    cell it leans to blocked), 'cell' (ground within the allowance whose cell test fails), 'climb' (the ground
    changing too fast between samples), 'start' / 'end' (an end off its ground)."""
    trace: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if world.los(pa, pb, trace):
        return None
    out = {k: (round(v, 3) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in trace.items()}
    rule = trace['rule']
    if rule not in ('cell', 'climb'):
        out['cause'] = rule
        return out
    x, z, current = trace['x'], trace['z'], trace['area']
    area = world.areas[current]
    i, j, _in = world._cell_of(area, x, z)
    here = world.ground(area, x, z)
    out.update(pitch=round(area.pitch, 1), sector=f'{int(world.sectors[area.sector][0]):04x}', cell=[i, j],
               own=world.walkable(area, i, j), hood=_hood(world, area, x, z), cur_ground=round(here, 3))
    others = []
    for k in world._near_los(x, z):
        if k == current:
            continue
        other = world.areas[k]
        if not world.on_cell(other, x, z):
            continue
        dy = world.ground(other, x, z) - here
        others.append({'area': k, 'pitch': round(other.pitch, 1),
                       'sector': f'{int(world.sectors[other.sector][0]):04x}', 'dy': round(dy, 3),
                       'allowed': round(world._allowed(current, k), 3), 'cell_ok': world._cell_ok(k, x, z),
                       'hood': _hood(world, other, x, z)})
    others.sort(key=lambda candidate: abs(candidate['dy']))
    out['others'] = others[:4]
    if rule == 'climb':
        out['cause'] = 'climb'
        return out
    if world.on_cell(area, x, z) and area.pitch_mm_ >= rsnv.COARSE_MM:
        out['cause'] = 'lean'
    elif not others:
        out['cause'] = 'hole'
    elif all(abs(candidate['dy']) > candidate['allowed'] for candidate in others):
        out['cause'] = 'step'
        out['step_excess'] = round(min(abs(candidate['dy']) - candidate['allowed'] for candidate in others), 3)
    else:
        out['cause'] = 'cell'
    if out['cause'] == 'hole':
        # the gap's length along the line: to the next sample on any area's cells within the coarse allowance
        dx, dz = pb[0] - pa[0], pb[2] - pa[2]
        length = math.hypot(dx, dz)
        failed_k, n_samples = trace['k'], trace['n']

        def on_ground(x2: float, z2: float) -> bool:
            for candidate in world._near_los(x2, z2):
                near = world.areas[candidate]
                if world.on_cell(near, x2, z2) and abs(world.ground(near, x2, z2) - trace['gy']) <= rsnv.LOS_COARSE_DY:
                    return True
            return False
        gap = None
        for k in range(failed_k + 1, n_samples + 1):
            t = k / n_samples
            if on_ground(pa[0] + dx * t, pa[2] + dz * t):
                gap = length * (k - failed_k) / n_samples
                break
        out['gap'] = None if gap is None else round(gap, 3)
    return out


class BuildSamples:
    """The build's own collision samples and kept surfaces (navaudit1943's base masks) of a level, both grids."""

    def __init__(self, level: str) -> None:
        import numpy as np
        import navaudit1943
        paths = navaudit1943.level_paths(level)
        # (grid name, samples, kept mask, the mask's build hpd_sha256)
        self.grids: list[tuple[str, Samples, npt.NDArray[np.bool_], str]] = []
        for which, src, mask_name in (('0.8 m', 'samples.bin', 'normal'), ('0.2 m', 'samples_02.bin', 'detailed')):
            mask_path = os.path.join(paths['audit'], 'masks', f'{mask_name}_base.npz')
            samples_path = os.path.join(paths['samples'], src)
            if not (os.path.isfile(mask_path) and os.path.isfile(samples_path)):
                continue
            samples = navaudit1943.load_samples(samples_path)
            mask = np.load(mask_path)
            if int(mask['surfaces']) != len(samples.y):
                raise SystemExit(f'{mask_path}: made from another sampling run')
            self.grids.append((which, samples, mask['keep'], str(mask['hpd_sha256'])))

    def at(self, x: float, z: float, y: float, dy: float = 2.5) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Per grid, the nearest column's surfaces within dy of y: (height, kept, slope in degrees)."""
        out = {}
        for which, samples, keep, _sha in self.grids:
            i = int(round((x - samples.min_x) / samples.pitch))
            j = int(round((z - samples.min_z) / samples.pitch))
            if not (0 <= i < samples.nx and 0 <= j < samples.nz):
                continue
            column = []
            for surface in samples.column(i, j):
                if abs(float(samples.y[surface]) - y) <= dy:
                    normal_y = max(-1.0, min(1.0, float(samples.normal[surface][1])))
                    slope = round(math.degrees(math.acos(normal_y)), 1)
                    column.append((round(float(samples.y[surface]), 2), bool(keep[surface]), slope))
            out[which] = {'column': [round(samples.min_x + i * samples.pitch, 2),
                                     round(samples.min_z + j * samples.pitch, 2)],
                          'surfaces': column}
        return out


def tight_pairs(world: World) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Every tight walk edge once: (node a, node b) with a < b."""
    sources = edge_source(world)
    pairs = set()
    for k in range(len(world.edge_target)):
        if int(world.edge_flags[k]) & rsnv.EDGEF_TIGHT and int(world.edge_kind[k]) == rsnv.EDGE_WALK:
            a, b = sources[k], int(world.edge_target[k])
            pairs.add((min(a, b), max(a, b)))
    return sorted(pairs)


def cmd_tight(world: World, args: argparse.Namespace, path: str) -> int:
    import json
    build_samples = BuildSamples(os.path.basename(path).split('.')[0]) if args.samples else None
    rows = []
    causes = collections.Counter()
    for n0, n1 in tight_pairs(world):
        pa, pb = (tuple(float(v) for v in world.node_pos[n]) for n in (n0, n1))
        row = {'nodes': [n0, n1], 'a': [round(v, 2) for v in pa], 'b': [round(v, 2) for v in pb],
               'length': round(math.dist(pa, pb), 3), 'ends': [end_info(world, pa), end_info(world, pb)],
               'ab': los_failure(world, pa, pb), 'ba': los_failure(world, pb, pa)}
        if build_samples is not None:
            for way in ('ab', 'ba'):
                failure = row[way]
                if failure and 'x' in failure:
                    failure['samples'] = build_samples.at(failure['x'], failure['z'], failure.get('gy', pa[1]))
        causes[(row['ab'] or {}).get('cause'), (row['ba'] or {}).get('cause')] += 1
        rows.append(row)
        end_a, end_b = row['ends']
        print(f"{n0}-{n1}: ({pa[0]:.1f}, {pa[1]:.1f}, {pa[2]:.1f}) -> ({pb[0]:.1f}, {pb[1]:.1f}, {pb[2]:.1f}), "
              f"{row['length']:.2f} m; ends area {end_a.get('area')} ({end_a.get('sector')}, {end_a.get('pitch')} m) / "
              f"area {end_b.get('area')} ({end_b.get('sector')}, {end_b.get('pitch')} m)")
        for way in ('ab', 'ba'):
            failure = row[way]
            if failure is None:
                print(f'    {way}: in sight')
                continue
            extra = ''.join(f', {k} {failure[k]}' for k in ('excess', 'step_excess', 'gap') if k in failure)
            print(f"    {way}: {failure['cause']} at {failure.get('along', 0):.2f} m ({failure.get('x', 0):.2f}, "
                  f"{failure.get('z', 0):.2f}), area {failure.get('area')} {failure.get('pitch', '')} m, cells "
                  f"{failure.get('hood', '')}{extra}")
            for other in failure.get('others', [])[:2]:
                print(f"        other area {other['area']} ({other['sector']}, {other['pitch']} m): dy "
                      f"{other['dy']:+.2f} of {other['allowed']:.2f}, cell test "
                      f"{'ok' if other['cell_ok'] else 'fails'}, cells {other['hood']}")
            for grid, column in (failure.get('samples') or {}).items():
                surfaces = ', '.join(f"{y}{' kept' if kept else ''} {slope} deg"
                                     for y, kept, slope in column['surfaces'])
                print(f"        samples {grid} at {tuple(column['column'])}: " + surfaces)
    print(f'{path}: {len(rows)} tight pairs; causes (a->b, b->a): '
          + ', '.join(f'{k[0]}/{k[1]} {v}' for k, v in causes.most_common()))
    if args.json:
        meta = {'file': os.path.abspath(path), 'pairs': len(rows)}
        if build_samples is not None:
            meta['masks_hpd_sha256'] = [sha for _which, _samples, _keep, sha in build_samples.grids]
        with open(args.json, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as fh:
            json.dump({'meta': meta, 'pairs': rows}, fh, indent=1)
        print(f'wrote {args.json}')
    return 0


def _on_line(line: tuple[Sequence[float], Sequence[float]], x: float, z: float, tol: float) -> bool:
    """Whether (x, z) lies within tol of the segment line ((x, y, z), (x, y, z)) in plan."""
    (ax, _ay, az), (bx, _by, bz) = line
    dx, dz = bx - ax, bz - az
    length2 = dx * dx + dz * dz
    t = 0.0 if length2 == 0 else max(0.0, min(1.0, ((x - ax) * dx + (z - az) * dz) / length2))
    return math.hypot(ax + dx * t - x, az + dz * t - z) <= tol


def cmd_cells(world: World, args: argparse.Namespace, path: str) -> int:
    """Text maps around a point, 0.2 m to a character, +z up: each area with ground within --dy of --y (its walkable
    cells '#', its other cells '.'); with --samples, the build's own samples on both grids ('K' a kept surface within
    0.6 m of --y, 'k' kept further off, 's' a surface within 0.6 m not kept, '.' none); with --line, '*' marks where the
    line runs over a character that is not ground."""
    cx, cz = (float(v) for v in args.at.split(','))
    radius, y = args.radius, args.y
    line = (point(args.line[0]), point(args.line[1])) if args.line else None
    n = int(round(radius / 0.2))
    xs = [cx + i * 0.2 for i in range(-n, n + 1)]
    zs = [cz + j * 0.2 for j in range(n, -n - 1, -1)]
    near_areas = set()
    for step_x in (-1, 0, 1):
        for step_z in (-1, 0, 1):
            near_areas.update(world._near_los(cx + step_x * radius, cz + step_z * radius))
    print(f'around ({cx:.2f}, {cz:.2f}), {radius} m, ground within {args.dy} m of {y:.2f}; 0.2 m a character, +z up, '
          f'x right')

    def show(title: str, char_at: Callable[[float, float], str]) -> None:
        print(title)
        for z in zs:
            row = ''
            for x in xs:
                char = char_at(x, z)
                if line and char in '. ' and _on_line(line, x, z, 0.1):
                    char = '*'
                if abs(x - cx) < 0.1 and abs(z - cz) < 0.1:
                    char = 'X' if char in '#K' else 'x'
                row += char
            print('    ' + row)
    for k in sorted(near_areas):
        area = world.areas[k]
        overlaps = (area.x0 - area.pitch <= cx + radius and cx - radius <= area.x1 + area.pitch
                    and area.z0 - area.pitch <= cz + radius and cz - radius <= area.z1 + area.pitch)
        if not overlaps:
            continue
        ground = world.ground(area, cx, cz)
        if abs(ground - y) > args.dy:
            continue

        def area_char(x: float, z: float, area: rsnv.Area = area) -> str:
            i, j, inside = world._cell_of(area, x, z)
            if not inside:
                return ' '
            return '#' if world.walkable(area, i, j) else '.'
        sector = world.sectors[area.sector]
        show(f'  area {k} (sector {int(sector[0]):04x}, {area.pitch:.1f} m, ground {ground:.2f} here, '
             f'{area.min_y:.2f}..{area.max_y - 1.52:.2f})', area_char)
    if args.samples:
        build_samples = BuildSamples(os.path.basename(path).split('.')[0])
        for which, samples, keep, sha in build_samples.grids:
            def sample_char(x: float, z: float, samples: 'Samples' = samples,
                            keep: 'npt.NDArray[np.bool_]' = keep) -> str:
                i = int(round((x - samples.min_x) / samples.pitch))
                j = int(round((z - samples.min_z) / samples.pitch))
                if not (0 <= i < samples.nx and 0 <= j < samples.nz):
                    return ' '
                best = '.'
                for surface in samples.column(i, j):
                    dist = abs(float(samples.y[surface]) - y)
                    if keep[surface] and dist <= 0.6:
                        return 'K'
                    if keep[surface] and dist <= 2.0:
                        best = 'k'
                    elif dist <= 0.6 and best == '.':
                        best = 's'
                return best
            show(f'  samples {which} (kept surfaces from the base mask of build {sha[:12]})', sample_char)
    return 0


def sample_walk(build_samples: BuildSamples, a: Sequence[float], b: Sequence[float], grid: str = '0.2 m',
                reach: float = 1.0) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """The build's own kept samples along the line a -> b on one grid: column by column (every 0.05 m along the line,
    the nearest column), the kept surface nearest the height followed so far (within reach), or a gap. Returns
    {'grid', 'columns': [(x, z, y or None, slope or None)], 'largest_step', 'step_at', 'gaps', 'end_dy'} or None when
    the grid does not cover the line. Read-only; what a straight walk over the kept surfaces meets."""
    found = [entry for entry in build_samples.grids if entry[0] == grid]
    if not found:
        return None
    _which, samples, keep, _sha = found[0]
    dx, dz = b[0] - a[0], b[2] - a[2]
    length = math.hypot(dx, dz)
    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(length / 0.05)))
    y, columns, last_column = a[1], [], None
    largest, step_at, gaps, gap = 0.0, None, [], 0.0
    for k in range(n + 1):
        t = k / n
        x, z = a[0] + dx * t, a[2] + dz * t
        i = int(round((x - samples.min_x) / samples.pitch))
        j = int(round((z - samples.min_z) / samples.pitch))
        if not (0 <= i < samples.nx and 0 <= j < samples.nz):
            return None
        if (i, j) == last_column:
            continue
        last_column = (i, j)
        nearest = None                               # the kept surface nearest y within reach
        for surface in samples.column(i, j):
            off = abs(float(samples.y[surface]) - y)
            if keep[surface] and off <= reach and (nearest is None or off < abs(float(samples.y[nearest]) - y)):
                nearest = surface
        col_x, col_z = samples.min_x + i * samples.pitch, samples.min_z + j * samples.pitch
        if nearest is None:
            columns.append((round(col_x, 2), round(col_z, 2), None, None))
            gap += samples.pitch
            continue
        if gap:
            gaps.append(round(gap, 2))
            gap = 0.0
        surface_y = float(samples.y[nearest])
        if columns and abs(surface_y - y) > largest:
            largest, step_at = abs(surface_y - y), (round(col_x, 2), round(col_z, 2))
        slope = math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, float(samples.normal[nearest][1])))))
        columns.append((round(col_x, 2), round(col_z, 2), round(surface_y, 3), round(slope, 1)))
        y = surface_y
    if gap:
        gaps.append(round(gap, 2))
    return {'grid': grid, 'columns': columns, 'largest_step': round(largest, 3), 'step_at': step_at, 'gaps': gaps,
            'end_dy': round(y - b[1], 3)}


def cmd_walk(world: World, args: argparse.Namespace, path: str) -> int:
    """The build's kept samples along a line, on both grids (sample_walk)."""
    build_samples = BuildSamples(os.path.basename(path).split('.')[0])
    pa, pb = node_of_point(world, args.a), node_of_point(world, args.b)
    print(f'{pa} -> {pb}: line of sight {"in sight" if world.los(pa, pb) else "not in sight"} / '
          f'{"in sight" if world.los(pb, pa) else "not in sight"} (back)')
    for grid in ('0.2 m', '0.8 m'):
        walk = sample_walk(build_samples, pa, pb, grid, args.reach)
        if walk is None:
            print(f'  {grid}: no samples there')
            continue
        print(f"  {grid}: largest step {walk['largest_step']} m at {walk['step_at']}, gaps {walk['gaps'] or 'none'}, "
              f"the end {walk['end_dy']:+.2f} m off b")
        print('    ' + ' '.join(f'{column[2]:.2f}' if column[2] is not None else '-' for column in walk['columns']))
    return 0


def node_of_point(world: World, text: str) -> Point:
    """A point X,Y,Z, or a node number's position."""
    if ',' in text:
        return point(text)
    return tuple(float(v) for v in world.node_pos[int(text)])


def _edge_colour(tight: int, kind: int) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    if tight:
        return (230, 25, 75)
    if kind in (1, 2):                               # ladders
        return (255, 140, 0)
    if kind == 4:                                    # jumps
        return (0, 200, 255)
    return (110, 110, 110)


def picture(world: World, cx: float, cz: float, radius: float, route: Sequence[int] | None, png: str,
            y: float | None = None, dy: float = 3.0) -> None:
    """A top-down PNG of radius m around (cx, cz): cells, edges, nodes and a route (--y: floors near that height)."""
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    x0, x1, z0, z1 = cx - radius, cx + radius, cz - radius, cz + radius
    scale = min(40.0, 1600.0 / (2 * radius))         # pixels per metre
    size = int(2 * radius * scale) + 1
    img = Image.new('RGB', (size, size), (24, 24, 28))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    def to_pixel(x: float, z: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
        return ((x - x0) * scale, (z1 - z) * scale)

    def node_pixel(n: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
        return to_pixel(world.node_pos[n][0], world.node_pos[n][2])
    for area in world.areas:
        if area.x1 < x0 or area.x0 > x1 or area.z1 < z0 or area.z0 > z1:
            continue
        if y is not None and not (area.min_y - dy <= y <= area.max_y + dy):
            continue                                       # another floor
        half = area.pitch * scale / 2
        for j in range(area.height):
            z = area.z0 + j * area.pitch
            if z < z0 - 1 or z > z1 + 1:
                continue
            for i in range(area.width):
                x = area.x0 + i * area.pitch
                if x0 - 1 <= x <= x1 + 1 and world.walkable(area, i, j):
                    u, v = to_pixel(x, z)
                    draw.rectangle([u - half, v - half, u + half, v + half], fill=(46, 78, 52))
    inside = [n for n in range(len(world.node_pos))
              if x0 <= world.node_pos[n][0] <= x1 and z0 <= world.node_pos[n][2] <= z1
              and (y is None or abs(world.node_pos[n][1] - y) <= dy)]
    inside_set = set(inside)
    for n in inside:
        for k in range(int(world.node_first_edge[n]), int(world.node_first_edge[n + 1])):
            target = int(world.edge_target[k])
            if target < n and target in inside_set:
                continue                                   # drawn from the other end
            tight = int(world.edge_flags[k]) & rsnv.EDGEF_TIGHT
            draw.line([node_pixel(n), node_pixel(target)], fill=_edge_colour(tight, int(world.edge_kind[k])),
                      width=2 if tight else 1)
    for n in inside:
        u, v = node_pixel(n)
        draw.ellipse([u - 2, v - 2, u + 2, v + 2], fill=(200, 200, 200))
    if route:
        draw.line([node_pixel(n) for n in route], fill=(255, 215, 0), width=3)
    img.save(png)
    print(f'picture: {png} (cells green; edges grey, tight red, ladders orange, jumps cyan; route yellow)')


def cmd_picture(world: World, args: argparse.Namespace, path: str) -> int:
    cx, cz = (float(v) for v in args.at.split(','))
    route = None
    if args.route:
        start, goal = node_of(world, args.route[0]), node_of(world, args.route[1])
        route = search(world, start, goal, args.soldier)[2]
    png = args.png or os.path.join(out_dir(path), f'rsnvtool-{cx:.0f}_{cz:.0f}.png')
    picture(world, cx, cz, args.radius, route, png, args.y, args.dy)
    return 0


def cmd_diff(path_a: str, path_b: str) -> int:
    world_a, world_b = rsnv.load(path_a), rsnv.load(path_b)
    rows = [('file size, MB', os.path.getsize(path_a) / 1e6, os.path.getsize(path_b) / 1e6),
            ('nodes', len(world_a.node_pos), len(world_b.node_pos)),
            ('edges', len(world_a.edge_target), len(world_b.edge_target)),
            ('areas', len(world_a.areas), len(world_b.areas)),
            ('tight edges', _tight_count(world_a), _tight_count(world_b)),
            ('islands', len(set(world_a.node_island.tolist())), len(set(world_b.node_island.tolist()))),
            ('ladder / jump records', len(world_a.ladders), len(world_b.ladders)),
            ('off-mesh records', len(world_a.offmesh), len(world_b.offmesh))]
    print(f'{"":24} {"a":>12} {"b":>12}')
    for name, value_a, value_b in rows:
        if isinstance(value_a, float):
            print(f'{name:24} {value_a:12.2f} {value_b:12.2f}')
        else:
            change = '' if value_a == value_b else f'   {value_b - value_a:+d}'
            print(f'{name:24} {value_a:12d} {value_b:12d}' + change)
    print(f"exporter: a {world_a.meta.get('exporter', '?')}; b {world_b.meta.get('exporter', '?')}")
    if len(world_a.node_pos) == len(world_b.node_pos):
        import numpy as np
        moved = np.linalg.norm(world_a.node_pos - world_b.node_pos, axis=1)
        edges_a = set(zip(edge_source(world_a), world_a.edge_target.tolist()))
        edges_b = set(zip(edge_source(world_b), world_b.edge_target.tolist()))
        print(f'same node count: {int((moved > 1e-4).sum())} nodes moved (largest {moved.max():.3f} m); '
              f'edges only in a {len(edges_a - edges_b)}, only in b {len(edges_b - edges_a)}')
    else:
        print('node counts differ: the graphs are different builds (compare counts, not nodes)')
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='rsnvtool.py', description=__doc__,
                                     formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest='cmd', required=True)

    def add(name: str) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
        command = sub.add_parser(name)
        command._negative_number_matcher = re.compile(r'^-\d')       # a point like -240.4,218.4,23.4 is a value
        command.add_argument('file')
        command.add_argument('--class', dest='klass', choices=('jeep', 'tank', 'lcvp', 'plane'))
        return command
    add('info')
    add('validate')
    command = add('locate')
    command.add_argument('x', type=float)
    command.add_argument('y', type=float)
    command.add_argument('z', type=float)
    command.add_argument('--max-dist', type=float, default=3.0)
    command = add('los')
    command.add_argument('a')
    command.add_argument('b')
    command = add('route')
    command.add_argument('start')
    command.add_argument('goal')
    command.add_argument('--soldier', action='store_true')
    command.add_argument('--png', nargs='?', const='-')
    command = add('pockets')
    command.add_argument('--top', type=int, default=10)
    command = add('tight')
    command.add_argument('--samples', action='store_true', help="the build's own samples at each failing sample")
    command.add_argument('--json')
    command = add('cells')
    command.add_argument('--at', required=True)
    command.add_argument('--y', type=float, required=True)
    command.add_argument('--radius', type=float, default=1.6)
    command.add_argument('--dy', type=float, default=1.5, help='areas whose ground at the point is within this of --y')
    command.add_argument('--samples', action='store_true')
    command.add_argument('--line', nargs=2, help='two points X,Y,Z: the line drawn over the maps')
    command = add('walk')
    command.add_argument('a')
    command.add_argument('b')
    command.add_argument('--reach', type=float, default=1.0,
                         help='the kept surface followed lies within this of the last')
    command = add('picture')
    command.add_argument('--at', required=True)
    command.add_argument('--radius', type=float, default=25.0)
    command.add_argument('--route', nargs=2)
    command.add_argument('--soldier', action='store_true')
    command.add_argument('--y', type=float, help='draw only the floors within --dy of this height')
    command.add_argument('--dy', type=float, default=3.0)
    command.add_argument('--png')
    command = sub.add_parser('diff')
    command.add_argument('a')
    command.add_argument('b')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv[1:])
    if args.cmd == 'diff':
        return cmd_diff(resolve(args.a), resolve(args.b))
    path = resolve(args.file, args.klass)
    world = rsnv.load(path)
    if args.cmd == 'info':
        return cmd_info(world, path)
    if args.cmd == 'validate':
        return cmd_validate(world, path)
    if args.cmd == 'locate':
        return cmd_locate(world, args)
    if args.cmd == 'los':
        pa, pb = point(args.a), point(args.b)
        in_sight = world.los(pa, pb)
        print(f'{"in sight" if in_sight else "not in sight"}: {pa} -> {pb}')
        return 0 if in_sight else 1
    if args.cmd == 'route':
        return cmd_route(world, args, path)
    if args.cmd == 'pockets':
        return cmd_pockets(world, args)
    if args.cmd == 'picture':
        return cmd_picture(world, args, path)
    if args.cmd == 'tight':
        return cmd_tight(world, args, path)
    if args.cmd == 'cells':
        return cmd_cells(world, args, path)
    if args.cmd == 'walk':
        return cmd_walk(world, args, path)
    return 2


if __name__ == '__main__':
    from bfbc2core import errors
```
