```py
"""Tests for ppcasm: every supported instruction, decoded back by capstone (an independent decoder).

  python -B test_ppcasm.py      (skips the capstone checks, with a note, if capstone is not installed)
"""
import struct
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
if __name__ == '__main__':      # the suite's bootstrap (core/suitepath.py)
    import pathlib
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, str(next(p for p in pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents if (p / 'core' / 'suitepath.py').is_file()) / 'core'))
    import suitepath
    suitepath.use()
import ppcasm  # noqa: E402

failures = []


def check(ok, what):
    print(('ok   ' if ok else 'FAIL ') + what)
    if not ok:
        failures.append(what)


ORIGIN = 0x82F00000
# (source line, capstone text); capstone prints simplified mnemonics
CASES = [
    ('stwu r1, -0x60(r1)', 'stwu r1, -0x60(r1)'),
    ('stw r31, 0x5c(r1)', 'stw r31, 0x5c(r1)'),
    ('lwz r3, 0x28(r3)', 'lwz r3, 0x28(r3)'),
    ('lbz r4, 0x214(r30)', 'lbz r4, 0x214(r30)'),
    ('std r31, -0x10(r1)', 'std r31, -0x10(r1)'),
    ('stfs f1, 0x184(r1)', 'stfs f1, 0x184(r1)'),
    ('lfs f31, -8(r3)', 'lfs f31, -8(r3)'),
    ('ld r29, -0x20(r1)', 'ld r29, -0x20(r1)'),
    ('stb r4, 0x214(r3)', 'stb r4, 0x214(r3)'),
    ('lhz r5, 2(r6)', 'lhz r5, 2(r6)'),
    ('sth r5, -2(r6)', 'sth r5, -2(r6)'),
    ('addi r3, r31, 0x10', 'addi r3, r31, 0x10'),
    ('addis r3, r3, -1', 'addis r3, r3, -1'),
    ('li r4, 1', 'li r4, 1'),
    ('li r4, -1', 'li r4, -1'),
    ('lis r3, 0x8236', 'lis r3, -0x7dca'),
    ('ori r3, r3, 0xbc98', 'ori r3, r3, 0xbc98'),
    ('oris r3, r3, 0x1234', 'oris r3, r3, 0x1234'),
    ('andi. r0, r3, 0xff', 'andi. r0, r3, 0xff'),
    ('mr r31, r3', 'mr r31, r3'),
    ('add r3, r4, r5', 'add r3, r4, r5'),
    ('subf r3, r4, r5', 'subf r3, r4, r5'),
    ('mullw r3, r4, r5', 'mullw r3, r4, r5'),
    ('cmpwi r3, 0', 'cmpwi r3, 0'),
    ('cmpwi cr6, r3, -5', 'cmpwi cr6, r3, -5'),
    ('cmplwi r3, 8', 'cmplwi r3, 8'),
    ('cmpw r3, r4', 'cmpw r3, r4'),
    ('cmplw cr7, r3, r4', 'cmplw cr7, r3, r4'),
    ('slwi r3, r4, 2', 'slwi r3, r4, 2'),
    ('srwi r3, r4, 3', 'srwi r3, r4, 3'),
    ('mflr r12', 'mflr r12'),
    ('mtlr r12', 'mtlr r12'),
    ('mtctr r11', 'mtctr r11'),
    ('mfctr r11', 'mfctr r11'),
    ('blr', 'blr'),
    ('bctr', 'bctr'),
    ('bctrl', 'bctrl'),
    ('nop', 'nop'),
]


def capstone_text(words, origin):
    import capstone
    md = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_PPC, capstone.CS_MODE_64 | capstone.CS_MODE_BIG_ENDIAN)
    return [f'{i.mnemonic} {i.op_str}'.strip() for i in md.disasm(words, origin)]


def encodings():
    try:
        import capstone  # noqa: F401
    except ImportError:
        print('skip capstone checks: capstone is not installed')
        return
    for line, want in CASES:
        code, _ = ppcasm.assemble(line, ORIGIN)
        got = capstone_text(code, ORIGIN)
        check(got == [want], f'{line} -> {got}')
    # branches: absolute targets and labels, forward and back
    src = '''
    start:
        bl 0x8236bc98
        b done
        beq start
        bne cr7, done
        blt done
        bge done
        bgt done
        ble start
    done:
        blr
    '''
    code, names = ppcasm.assemble(src, ORIGIN)
    got = capstone_text(code, ORIGIN)
    done = names['done']
    check(got == ['bl 0x8236bc98', f'b {done:#x}', f'beq {ORIGIN:#x}', f'bne cr7, {done:#x}', f'blt {done:#x}',
                  f'bge {done:#x}', f'bgt {done:#x}', f'ble {ORIGIN:#x}', 'blr'], f'branches decode as written: {got}')
    code, _ = ppcasm.assemble('la r3, 0x82f08000\nli32 r4, 0x8236bc98', ORIGIN)
    got = capstone_text(code, ORIGIN)
    check(got == ['lis r3, -0x7d0f', 'addi r3, r3, -0x8000', 'lis r4, -0x7dca', 'ori r4, r4, 0xbc98'],
          f'la and li32 build the full value: {got}')
    # la into r0: addi's base r0 reads 0, so lis + addi would leave only the low half (capstone: lis r0, ...; li r0,
    # 0x1234). Each pair is run as capstone decodes it, for the value it leaves in the register.
    for line in ('la r0, 0x82f01234', 'la r0, 0x82f08000', 'la r3, 0x82f01234', 'la r3, 0x82f08000', 'li32 r0, 0x82f08000'):
        v = int(line.split(', ')[1], 0)
        got = capstone_text(ppcasm.assemble(line, ORIGIN)[0], ORIGIN)
        check(loaded(got) == v, f'{line} leaves {v:#x} in the register: {got}')


def loaded(text):
    """The value a lis/li/addi/ori sequence (capstone's text) leaves in its register, rA = r0 in addi read as 0."""
    regs = {}
    for line in text:
        m, ops = line.split(None, 1)
        o = [x.strip() for x in ops.split(',')]
        if m == 'lis':
            regs[o[0]] = int(o[1], 0) << 16 & 0xFFFFFFFF
        elif m == 'li':
            regs[o[0]] = int(o[1], 0) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        elif m == 'addi':
            regs[o[0]] = ((0 if o[1] == 'r0' else regs[o[1]]) + int(o[2], 0)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        elif m == 'ori':
            regs[o[0]] = regs[o[1]] | int(o[2], 0)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f'loaded() does not know {line}')
    return regs[o[0]]


def data_and_errors():
    code, names = ppcasm.assemble('a: .long 0x12345678\nb: .string "Bot 1"\nc: .long a', ORIGIN)
    check(code == bytes.fromhex('12345678') + b'Bot 1\0\0\0' + struct.pack('>I', ORIGIN)
          and names['c'] == ORIGIN + 12, '.long and .string lay out words, padded, with labels')
    code, _ = ppcasm.assemble('stwu r1, -FRAME(r1)\nlwz r3, OFF(r4)', ORIGIN, {'FRAME': 0x1C0, 'OFF': 0x98})
    check(code == ppcasm.assemble('stwu r1, -0x1c0(r1)\nlwz r3, 0x98(r4)', ORIGIN)[0], 'symbols (and negated symbols) as offsets')
    # a base of r0 reads 0 (addi, addis and every D-form access): refused rather than assembled as something else
    for bad in ('li r3, 0x8000','std r31, -0x12(r1)','lwz r3, 0x28', 'foo r3', 'bl 0x80000000', 'beq far', 'mr r32, r3', 'x:\nx:',
                'addi r3, r0, 4', 'addis r3, r0, 1', 'lwz r3, 8(r0)', 'stw r3, 0(r0)', 'std r3, 8(r0)', 'lfs f1, 4(r0)'):
        try:
            ppcasm.assemble(bad, ORIGIN, {'far': ORIGIN + 0x10000})
            check(False, f'refuses {bad!r}')
        except ppcasm.AsmError:
            check(True, f'refuses {bad!r}')
    # operand counts: an extra operand was dropped and a missing one raised IndexError (no line number) before
    # 2026-10-30; both are an AsmError naming the line now
    for bad in ('li r3, 1, 2', 'mr r3, r4, r5', 'mtctr r11, r12', 'b 0x1000, 0x2000', 'subf r5, r6, r5, r7', 'blr r3',
                'lwz r3, 0(r4), 8', '.long 1, 2', 'beq cr0, x, y', 'cmpwi cr0, r3, 0, 1',
                'addi r3, r4', 'slwi r3, r4', 'mr r3', 'lis r3', 'la r3', 'std r3', 'cmpwi r3', 'beq', 'bl'):
        try:
            ppcasm.assemble(f'nop\n{bad}', ORIGIN, {'x': ORIGIN, 'y': ORIGIN})
            check(False, f'refuses {bad!r} (operand count)')
        except ppcasm.AsmError as e:
            check(str(e).startswith('line 2:'), f'refuses {bad!r} (operand count), naming the line: {e}')
        except Exception as e:      # noqa: BLE001 - anything else is the defect
            check(False, f'refuses {bad!r} (operand count) with an AsmError, not {type(e).__name__}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    encodings()
    data_and_errors()
    print('all passed' if not failures else f'{len(failures)} failed')
    sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
```

`bf1943-xenia-kit/tests/test_xeniakit.py`:

```py
"""Tests for the BF1943 Xenia kit.

  python -B test_xeniakit.py           no game data: known.json, the patch file, the port edit on a built ZIP,
                                       the Xenia fix on built executables (right bytes, wrong bytes), and
                                       verify's bot mode on a made-up build
  python -B test_xeniakit.py --game    + a full build from your package into a temporary folder, checked
                                       against the known hashes (BF1943_PACKAGE and XENIA_DIR, or the
                                       operation-rising-sun locations next to the suite)
"""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
KIT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
if __name__ == '__main__':      # the suite's bootstrap (core/suitepath.py)
    import pathlib
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, str(next(p for p in pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents if (p / 'core' / 'suitepath.py').is_file()) / 'core'))
    import suitepath
    suitepath.use()
import config_edits  # noqa: E402
import netfix  # noqa: E402

failures = []


def check(ok, what):
    print(('ok   ' if ok else 'FAIL ') + what)
    if not ok:
        failures.append(what)


def known_and_patch():
    known = json.load(open(os.path.join(KIT, 'known.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    files = known['game']['files']
    check(len(files) == 90 and len({f['path'] for f in files}) == 90 and
          all(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', f['sha256']) for f in files), 'known.json lists 90 distinct files with SHA-256')
    patch = open(os.path.join(KIT, 'patches', known['patch']['file']), 'rb').read()
    check(hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest() == known['patch']['sha256'], 'the patch file matches its recorded hash')
    text = patch.decode('utf-8')
    check(f'title_id = "{known["game"]["title_id"]}"' in text and f'hash = "{known["game"]["module_hash"]}"' in text,
          'the patch file names the game and its module hash (Xenia applies it to that executable only)')
    words = re.findall(r'address = 0x([0-9a-f]{8})\s+value = 0x([0-9a-f]{8})', text)
    check(len(words) == 11 and all(0x82000000 <= int(a, 16) < 0x83000000 for a, _ in words),
          f'the patch file holds 11 code words in the game image ({len(words)})')


def port_edit():
    cfg = b'// NetworkSettingsData\r\nNetwork.ClientPort 1001\r\nNetwork.ServerPort 1003\r\nNetwork.MaxClientCount 24\r\n'
    src = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        z.writestr('Game.cfg', b'Game.LogFileEnable true\r\n')
        z.writestr('GameSettings.cfg', cfg)
        z.writestr('Scripts/Startup.lua', b'-- lua\n' * 50)
    out, settings, changes = config_edits.build(src.getvalue())
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(out))
    check(settings == cfg.replace(b'1001', b'25001').replace(b'1003', b'25003') and z.read('GameSettings.cfg') == settings,
          'the port edit changes exactly the two port values')
    check(z.read('Game.cfg') == b'Game.LogFileEnable true\r\n' and z.read('Scripts/Startup.lua') == b'-- lua\n' * 50
          and [i.filename for i in z.infolist()] == ['Game.cfg', 'GameSettings.cfg', 'Scripts/Startup.lua'],
          'the port edit keeps every other entry and the order')
    try:
        bad = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(bad, 'w') as zz:
            zz.writestr('GameSettings.cfg', b'Network.ClientPort 2000\r\n')
        config_edits.build(bad.getvalue())
        check(False, 'the port edit refuses a GameSettings.cfg without the known ports')
    except ValueError:
        check(True, 'the port edit refuses a GameSettings.cfg without the known ports')


def fake_exe(right):
    """A minimal PE with one section over the five sites, holding the expected (or other) bytes."""
    rva, size = 0x29B000, 0x5000
    raw = 0x400
    data = bytearray(raw + size)
    data[:2] = b'MZ'
    struct.pack_into('<I', data, 0x3C, 0x80)
    struct.pack_into('<4sHH', data, 0x80, b'PE\0\0', 0x8664, 1)
    struct.pack_into('<H', data, 0x80 + 20, 0xF0)
    first = 0x80 + 24 + 0xF0
    struct.pack_into('<8sIIII', data, first, b'.text', size, rva, size, raw)
    for va, expected, _ in netfix.SITES:
        at = va - netfix.BASE - rva + raw
        b = bytes.fromhex(expected)
        data[at:at + len(b)] = b if right else b'\xcc' * len(b)
    return bytes(data)


def xenia_fix():
    fixed, changes = netfix.build(fake_exe(True))
    check(len(changes) == 5 and all(c['after'] == '90' * (len(c['before']) // 2) for c in changes),
          'the Xenia fix NOPs exactly the five sites')
    check(fixed.count(b'\x90') - fake_exe(True).count(b'\x90') == 16, 'the Xenia fix changes 16 bytes and nothing else')
    try:
        netfix.build(fake_exe(False))
        check(False, 'the Xenia fix refuses another Xenia build')
    except ValueError:
        check(True, 'the Xenia fix refuses another Xenia build')


def verify_bot_mode():
    """verify enforces the build's bot mode on a made-up build (no game data): a normal build fails while Xenia's
    patches folder holds a bots experiment patch (as another build against the same Xenia leaves it), under its
    own name or another; a bots build passes with its own patch and fails with a second one."""
    import logging
    import bots
    import xeniakit
    xeniakit.log = logging.getLogger('test_xeniakit')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        title, patches = os.path.join(d, 'title'), os.path.join(d, 'xenia', 'patches')
        os.makedirs(title)
        os.makedirs(patches)
        json.dump(dict(files=[]), open(os.path.join(title, 'title-manifest.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
        made = {}
        for name, text in (('netfix', b'exe'), ('patch', b'patch')):
            path = os.path.join(d, 'xenia', netfix.FIXED) if name == 'netfix' else os.path.join(patches, 'kit.patch.toml')
            open(path, 'wb').write(text)
            made[name], made[name + '_sha256'] = path, hashlib.sha256(text).hexdigest()
        bots_path = os.path.join(patches, bots.PATCH_FILE)
        text = bots.patch_toml().encode()

        def verify(bots_build):
            m = dict(made, title=title, bots_patch=bots_path if bots_build else None,
                     bots_patch_sha256=hashlib.sha256(text).hexdigest() if bots_build else None, gpu='vulkan')
            json.dump(m, open(os.path.join(d, 'kit-manifest.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
            xeniakit.write_launcher(d, m, 'vulkan')
            try:
                with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                    xeniakit.verify(argparse.Namespace(out=d))
                return True
            except ValueError:
                return False
        check(verify(False), 'verify: a normal build without a bots patch passes')
        open(bots_path, 'wb').write(text)
        check(not verify(False), 'verify: a normal build fails while Xenia has the bots patch (another build wrote it)')
        open(bots_path, 'wb').write(text.replace(b'is_enabled = true', b'is_enabled = false'))
        check(not verify(False), 'verify: and while it is there disabled')
        os.replace(bots_path, os.path.join(patches, 'renamed.patch.toml'))
        check(not verify(False), 'verify: and under another name')
        os.remove(os.path.join(patches, 'renamed.patch.toml'))
        open(bots_path, 'wb').write(text)
        check(verify(True), 'verify: a bots build passes with its own bots patch')
        open(os.path.join(patches, 'copy.patch.toml'), 'wb').write(text)
        check(not verify(True), 'verify: a bots build fails with a second bots patch')


def build_bots_patch():
    """build leaves Xenia's patches folder as verify requires (before 2026-10-30 it removed only the file under the
    kit's bots patch name, so a renamed kit-made copy passed the build and failed its verify): a normal build no kit-made
    bots patch under any name, a bots build only its own; other patch files stay; a file under the kit's name that the
    kit did not make is refused with nothing changed."""
    import bots
    import xeniakit
    text = bots.patch_toml()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as patches:
        own, renamed, mine = (os.path.join(patches, n) for n in (bots.PATCH_FILE, 'renamed.patch.toml', 'mine.patch.toml'))

        def put(path, data):
            open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n').write(data)
        put(renamed, text)
        put(own, text)
        put(mine, '# the user\'s own patch\n')
        xeniakit.install_bots_patch(patches, None)
        check(xeniakit.kit_bots_patches(patches) == [] and os.path.isfile(mine),
              'a normal build removes every kit-made bots patch (a renamed copy too) and keeps other patch files')
        put(renamed, text)
        xeniakit.install_bots_patch(patches, text)
        check(xeniakit.kit_bots_patches(patches) == [own] and open(own, encoding='utf-8').read() == text,
              'a bots build leaves exactly its own bots patch')
        put(own, '# not the kit\'s\n')
        put(renamed, text)
        for mode in (None, text):
            try:
                xeniakit.install_bots_patch(patches, mode)
                refused = False
            except FileExistsError:
                refused = True
            check(refused and open(own, encoding='utf-8').read() == '# not the kit\'s\n' and os.path.isfile(renamed),
                  f'{"a bots" if mode else "a normal"} build refuses a foreign file under the kit\'s name, changing nothing')


def launcher():
    """launch.cmd as cmd.exe reads it (Windows), in a console set to the OEM code page (437) and to UTF-8 (65001): in
    folders whose names hold an accented letter, a '%' and letters no OEM page holds (Cyrillic, CJK), its cd line
    reaches the Xenia folder, its start line names the paths whole (run with the start line turned into an echo:
    nothing is launched), and the console has its own code page back afterwards. Each run is in a new, hidden console,
    so the test's own is never switched. A control: the same file without its chcp line fails in the OEM console, so
    the lines after chcp are read in the page it sets. Before 2026-10-30 the file was UTF-8 without the switch and '%'
    was not doubled (cd failed on "Xenia José" in an OEM console, "%" paths were cut); until 2026-10-31 it was in the
    OEM page, which failed the same way in a UTF-8 console."""
    import xeniakit
    if os.name != 'nt':
        print('skip launch.cmd under cmd.exe: Windows only')
        return
    hidden = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
    hidden.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW          # wShowWindow 0: SW_HIDE
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        xenia, out = os.path.join(tmp, 'Xenia José 50%off Ж 中'), os.path.join(tmp, 'out 100% été')
        os.makedirs(xenia)
        os.makedirs(out)
        m = dict(netfix=os.path.join(xenia, netfix.FIXED), title=os.path.join(out, 'title'))
        xeniakit.write_launcher(out, m, 'vulkan')
        text = open(os.path.join(out, 'launch.cmd'), 'rb').read()
        head, tail = text.split(b'start ""')
        check(head.split(b'chcp 65001')[0].isascii() and text.decode('utf-8'),
              'launch.cmd is UTF-8, plain ASCII up to its chcp 65001 line')
        probe = os.path.join(tmp, 'probe.cmd')          # cmd /c itself expands % in the file's own path
        open(probe, 'wb').write(head + b'echo CD=%CD%\r\necho ARGS=' + tail)
        control = os.path.join(tmp, 'control.cmd')
        open(control, 'wb').write(head.replace(b'chcp 65001 >nul\r\n', b'') + b'echo CD=%CD%\r\n')
        want = f'"{m["netfix"]}" --gpu=vulkan --license_mask=1 "{os.path.join(out, "title", "default.xex")}"'

        def run(page, batch):
            """batch run in a new hidden console set to page; its CD= and ARGS= lines and the page after it."""
            wrapper = os.path.join(tmp, 'wrapper.cmd')
            open(wrapper, 'wb').write(f'@chcp {page} >nul\r\n@call "{batch}"\r\n@chcp\r\n'.encode('ascii'))
            r = subprocess.run(['cmd', '/d', '/c', wrapper], capture_output=True, cwd=tmp, startupinfo=hidden,
                               creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE, timeout=60)
            lines = r.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace').splitlines()    # echoed while the page is 65001
            cd = [ln[3:] for ln in lines if ln.startswith('CD=')]
            args = [ln[5:].strip() for ln in lines if ln.startswith('ARGS=')]
            after = re.findall(r'(\d+)\D*$', lines[-1]) if lines else []
            return r, cd, args, after

        for page in (437, 65001):
            r, cd, args, after = run(page, probe)
            check(r.returncode == 0 and cd == [xenia] and not r.stderr.strip(),
                  f'launch.cmd in code page {page}: cmd.exe changes to a Xenia folder named with an accent, a % and '
                  f'Cyrillic and CJK letters ({ascii(cd)}, {r.stderr[:80]!r})')
            check(args == [want], f'launch.cmd in code page {page}: the start line names the fixed Xenia and the title '
                                  f'whole ({ascii(args)})')
            check(after == [str(page)], f'launch.cmd in code page {page}: the console has its code page back ({after})')
        r, cd, _args, _after = run(437, control)
        check(cd != [xenia], 'control: without its chcp line, the same file does not reach the folder in code page 437 '
                             f'({ascii(cd)})')
        for bad in ('Xenia "q"', 'Xenia \udc80'):          # a double quote; a lone surrogate (not Unicode)
            try:
                xeniakit.launcher_text(dict(netfix=os.path.join(tmp, bad, netfix.FIXED), title=m['title']), 'vulkan')
                ok = False
            except ValueError:
                ok = True
            check(ok, f'launch.cmd: a folder it cannot name ({ascii(bad)}) is refused')


def full_build():
    research = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(KIT)), 'operation-rising-sun')
    package = os.environ.get('BF1943_PACKAGE', os.path.join(research, 'Battlefield 1943 (XBLA)', '5841097E', '000D0000',
                                                            '945CD965D6B2B2584A9C06CE16F38A075A6D390558'))
    xenia = os.environ.get('XENIA_DIR', os.path.join(research, 'Tools', 'xenia_canary_windows'))
    if not (os.path.isfile(package) and os.path.isdir(xenia)):
        print(f'skip full build: no package at {package} or no Xenia at {xenia}')
        return
    before = install_state(xenia)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as work:
        # the builder writes into the Xenia folder (the patch files, the fixed exe) and a normal build removes a
        # bots patch: build against a scratch folder holding only a copy of the exe, never the real install
        scratch = os.path.join(work, 'xenia')
        os.makedirs(scratch)
        shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(xenia, netfix.EXE), os.path.join(scratch, netfix.EXE))
        tmp = os.path.join(work, 'out')
        py = [sys.executable, '-B', os.path.join(KIT, 'xeniakit.py')]
        r = subprocess.run(py + ['build', package, scratch, '--out', tmp], capture_output=True, text=True)
        check(r.returncode == 0, 'a full build from the package succeeds' + ('' if r.returncode == 0 else ': ' + r.stdout[-400:] + r.stderr[-400:]))
        if r.returncode == 0:
            r = subprocess.run(py + ['verify', '--out', tmp], capture_output=True, text=True)
            check(r.returncode == 0, 'verify accepts the fresh build')
            m = json.load(open(os.path.join(tmp, 'title', 'title-manifest.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
            check(sorted(f['path'] for f in m['files'] if f['replaced']) == ['dist/xenon/config.zz', 'dist/xenon/menu/hud/hud_multiplayer_cq-00.fbrb',
                                                                             'dist/xenon/menu/main/mainmenu-00.fbrb'],
                  'exactly the main menu, in-game menu and config.zz are edited')
            check(os.path.isfile(os.path.join(scratch, 'patches', json.load(open(os.path.join(KIT, 'known.json'), encoding='utf-8'))['patch']['file'])), 'the patch went to the scratch Xenia')
            with open(os.path.join(tmp, 'title', 'default.xex'), 'ab') as f:
                f.write(b'x')
            r = subprocess.run(py + ['verify', '--out', tmp], capture_output=True, text=True)
            check(r.returncode == 1, 'verify notices a changed title file')
    check(install_state(xenia) == before, f'the real Xenia install is untouched ({xenia}: patches and fixed exe unchanged)')


def install_state(d):
    """Every file the builder may write in a Xenia folder (patches/, the fixed exe), by SHA-256."""
    out = {}
    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(os.path.join(d, 'patches')):
        for f in files:
            p = os.path.join(root, f)
            out[os.path.relpath(p, d)] = hashlib.sha256(open(p, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    fixed = os.path.join(d, netfix.FIXED)
    if os.path.isfile(fixed):
        out[netfix.FIXED] = hashlib.sha256(open(fixed, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    return out


if __name__ == '__main__':
    known_and_patch()
    port_edit()
    xenia_fix()
    verify_bot_mode()
    build_bots_patch()
    launcher()
    if '--game' in sys.argv:
        full_build()
    print('all passed' if not failures else f'{len(failures)} failed')
    sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
```

`bf1943-xenia-kit/tests/test_xeniakit_build.py`:

```py
r"""Xenia kit: build, verify and launch on a made-up package and Xenia

xeniakit.py's build on made-up inputs (no game data, no Xenia): a stand-in content package (the stfs reader replaced
by one serving made-up files in 4 KB blocks with their SHA-1s), a stand-in xenia_canary.exe, and the known hashes and
the three edits (menu, in-game menu, config) and the Xenia fix replaced by made-up ones, so the steps between them run
as they do on the real release. Checked: a build extracts every file, writes the edited ones, the patch file, the fixed
Xenia, the manifests and launch.cmd, and verify accepts it; launch verifies and starts the fixed Xenia (a recorder, not
a process); verify checks launch.cmd (in a normal, a d3d12 and a bots build: as written it passes, edited or missing it
fails; a manifest from before the GPU backend was recorded passes with either one); the bots and team experiments; each
refusal (an output already there, no xenia_canary.exe, another package
or Xenia, a foreign bots patch, a package that is not one or holds other files, a broken block chain, a damaged block,
a file that differs, an unsafe path, an edit or fix that differs from the verified result, a changed kit patch file, a
patch file of other contents in Xenia) stops the build in words.
"""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import logging
import os
import types

import bots
import xeniakit

BLOCK = 4096
FILES = {'default.xex': b'xex' * 3000,                              # more than one block
         'dist/xenon/menu/main/mainmenu-00.fbrb': b'main menu bundle',
         'dist/xenon/menu/hud/hud_multiplayer_cq-00.fbrb': b'in-game menu bundle',
         'dist/xenon/config.zz': b'config archive'}


def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


class FakePackage:
    """What xeniakit.extract reads of stfs.Package: magic, entries, the block chain, block addresses and hashes."""
    files = FILES
    magic = b'LIVE'
    damage = None           # a path whose first block's hash entry is wrong
    loop = None             # a path whose block chain names a block twice

    def __init__(self, path):
        blob, self.entries, self.hashes = bytearray(), [], {}
        self.entries.append(dict(path='dist', dir=True))
        for name, data in self.files.items():
            first = len(blob) // BLOCK
            for k in range(0, max(len(data), 1), BLOCK):
                block = data[k:k + BLOCK].ljust(BLOCK, b'\0')
                self.hashes[len(blob) // BLOCK] = hashlib.sha1(block).digest() + bytes(4)
                blob += block
            count = len(blob) // BLOCK - first
            self.entries.append(dict(path=name, dir=False, start=first, count=count, consecutive=True, size=len(data)))
            if name == self.damage:
                self.hashes[first] = bytes(24)
        self.f = io.BytesIO(bytes(blob))

    def _blocks(self, start, count, consecutive):
        out = list(range(start, start + count))
        if self.loop and any(e.get('path') == self.loop and e['start'] == start for e in self.entries):
            out = out + out
        return out

    def _addr(self, b):
        return b * BLOCK

    def _hash_entry(self, b):
        return self.hashes[b]


class Setup:
    """The made-up inputs, the known hashes for them and the stand-in edits, installed into xeniakit."""

    def __init__(self, tmp):
        self.tmp = tmp
        self.package = tmp / 'package'
        self.package.write_bytes(b'made-up package')
        self.xenia = tmp / 'xenia'
        self.xenia.mkdir()
        (self.xenia / 'xenia_canary.exe').write_bytes(b'made-up xenia')
        self.out = tmp / 'out'
        real = xeniakit.KNOWN
        self.known = dict(
            game=dict(files=[dict(path=p, sha256=sha(d)) for p, d in FILES.items()], package_sha256=sha(b'made-up package'),
                      title_id=real['game']['title_id']),
            xenia=dict(build='made-up', exe_sha256=sha(b'made-up xenia'), netfix_sha256=sha(b'made-up xenia fixed')),
            expected=dict(main_nav_res_sha256=sha(b'nav res'), main_root_res_sha256=sha(b'root res'),
                          game_settings_cfg_sha256=sha(b'settings'), igm_mp_cq_res_sha256=sha(b'igm res')),
            patch=dict(real['patch']))
        self.saved = {k: getattr(xeniakit, k) for k in ('KNOWN', 'Package', 'menu_edits', 'igm_edits', 'config_edits',
                                                        'netfix', 'subprocess', 'log')}
        self.started = []
        xeniakit.KNOWN = self.known
        xeniakit.Package = FakePackage
        xeniakit.log = logging.getLogger('test_xeniakit_build')
        self.results = dict(nav=b'nav res', root=b'root res', settings=b'settings', igm=b'igm res', fixed=b'made-up xenia fixed')
        r = self.results
        xeniakit.menu_edits = types.SimpleNamespace(
            BUNDLE='dist/xenon/menu/main/mainmenu-00.fbrb',
            build=lambda data: (data + b' edited', r['nav'], [dict(kind='relocate', why='menu')], r['root']))
        xeniakit.config_edits = types.SimpleNamespace(
            ARCHIVE='dist/xenon/config.zz', build=lambda data: (data + b' edited', r['settings'], [dict(why='ports')]))
        xeniakit.igm_edits = types.SimpleNamespace(
            BUNDLE='dist/xenon/menu/hud/hud_multiplayer_cq-00.fbrb',
            build=lambda data, team: (data + b' edited', r['igm'] if not team else b'team', [dict(why=f'igm {team}')]))
        xeniakit.netfix = types.SimpleNamespace(EXE='xenia_canary.exe', FIXED='xenia_canary_netfix.exe',
                                                build=lambda data: (r['fixed'], [dict(before='00', after='90')]))
        xeniakit.subprocess = types.SimpleNamespace(Popen=lambda argv, cwd=None: self.started.append((argv, cwd)))

    def restore(self):
        for k, v in self.saved.items():
            setattr(xeniakit, k, v)
        FakePackage.files, FakePackage.magic, FakePackage.damage, FakePackage.loop = FILES, b'LIVE', None, None

    def args(self, out=None, **kw):
        return argparse.Namespace(**{**dict(package=str(self.package), xenia=str(self.xenia), out=str(out or self.out),
                                            gpu='vulkan', replace_patch=False, experiment_team=None,
                                            experiment_bots=False), **kw})


@contextlib.contextmanager
def made_up(tmp):
    s = Setup(tmp)
    try:
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            yield s
    finally:
        s.restore()


def refusal(fn, *args):
    try:
        fn(*args)
    except (ValueError, FileExistsError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
        return f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'
    return None


def test_build_verify_launch(tmp_path):
    with made_up(tmp_path) as s:
        xeniakit.build(s.args())
        title = s.out / 'title'
        for p, d in FILES.items():
            want = d + b' edited' if p != 'default.xex' else d
            assert (title / p).read_bytes() == want, p
        m = json.loads((s.out / 'kit-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert m['package_sha256'] == s.known['game']['package_sha256'] and m['bots_patch'] is None
        assert sorted(m['edits']) == sorted(p for p in FILES if p != 'default.xex')
        tm = json.loads((title / 'title-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert sorted(f['path'] for f in tm['files'] if f['replaced']) == sorted(m['edits'])
        assert all('original_sha256' in f for f in tm['files'] if f['replaced'])
        assert (s.xenia / 'xenia_canary_netfix.exe').read_bytes() == b'made-up xenia fixed'
        assert (s.xenia / 'patches' / s.known['patch']['file']).is_file()
        assert (s.out / 'launch.cmd').read_bytes().startswith(b'@echo off')
        xeniakit.verify(argparse.Namespace(out=str(s.out)))
        xeniakit.launch(argparse.Namespace(out=str(s.out), gpu='d3d12'))
        argv, cwd = s.started[0]
        assert argv[0].endswith('xenia_canary_netfix.exe') and argv[1] == '--gpu=d3d12' and cwd == str(s.xenia)
        assert xeniakit.main(['xeniakit.py', 'verify', '--out', str(s.out)]) == 0
        # a second build against the same Xenia: an identical fixed exe is kept as it is, the patch file is replaced
        before = os.stat(s.xenia / 'xenia_canary_netfix.exe').st_mtime_ns
        xeniakit.build(s.args(tmp_path / 'out2'))
        assert os.stat(s.xenia / 'xenia_canary_netfix.exe').st_mtime_ns == before
        # a changed title file, a missing fixed exe
        with open(title / 'default.xex', 'ab') as f:
            f.write(b'x')
        assert 'changed or missing since the build' in (refusal(xeniakit.verify, argparse.Namespace(out=str(s.out))) or '')
        assert 'FileNotFoundError' in (refusal(xeniakit.load, str(tmp_path / 'nothing')) or '')


def test_build_experiments(tmp_path):
    with made_up(tmp_path) as s:
        xeniakit.build(s.args(experiment_bots=True, experiment_team=2))
        m = json.loads((s.out / 'kit-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert m['experiment_team'] == 2 and m['bots_patch'].endswith(bots.PATCH_FILE)
        assert m['bots_patch_sha256'] == sha(bots.patch_toml().encode())
        assert (s.out / 'title' / 'dist/xenon/menu/hud/hud_multiplayer_cq-00.fbrb').is_file()
        xeniakit.verify(argparse.Namespace(out=str(s.out)))


def test_build_refusals(tmp_path):
    with made_up(tmp_path) as s:
        n = [0]

        def fresh():
            n[0] += 1
            return tmp_path / f'o{n[0]}'

        def build(**kw):
            return refusal(xeniakit.build, s.args(fresh(), **kw))

        busy = fresh()
        (busy / 'title').mkdir(parents=True)
        (busy / 'title' / 'x').write_bytes(b'x')
        assert 'already exists' in refusal(xeniakit.build, s.args(busy))
        assert 'xenia_canary.exe not found' in build(xenia=str(tmp_path))
        s.known['game']['package_sha256'] = '0' * 64
        assert 'not the known Battlefield 1943 release' in build()
        s.known['game']['package_sha256'] = sha(b'made-up package')
        s.known['xenia']['exe_sha256'] = '0' * 64
        assert 'not the build the kit was made for' in build()
        s.known['xenia']['exe_sha256'] = sha(b'made-up xenia')
        patches = s.xenia / 'patches'
        patches.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (patches / bots.PATCH_FILE).write_text('# the user\'s own\n', encoding='utf-8')
        assert 'was not made by this kit' in build()
        (patches / bots.PATCH_FILE).unlink()
        FakePackage.magic = b'XXXX'
        assert 'not an Xbox 360 content package' in build()
        FakePackage.magic = b'LIVE'
        FakePackage.files = dict(FILES, extra=b'more')
        assert 'different files from the known release' in build()
        FakePackage.files = FILES
        FakePackage.loop = 'default.xex'
        assert 'invalid block chain: default.xex' in build()
        FakePackage.loop = None
        FakePackage.damage = 'dist/xenon/config.zz'
        assert 'data block SHA-1 mismatch in dist/xenon/config.zz' in build()
        FakePackage.damage = None
        s.known['game']['files'][0]['sha256'] = '0' * 64
        assert 'default.xex differs from the known release' in build()
        s.known['game']['files'][0]['sha256'] = sha(FILES['default.xex'])
        for key, words in (('nav', 'the edited menu movies differ'), ('settings', 'GameSettings.cfg differs'),
                           ('igm', 'the edited in-game menu differs'), ('fixed', 'the fixed Xenia differs')):
            good = s.results[key]
            s.results[key] = b'other'
            assert words in build(), key
            s.results[key] = good
        assert build(experiment_team=1) is None, 'the team experiment is not checked against the verified menu'
        real_patch = dict(s.known['patch'])
        s.known['patch']['sha256'] = '0' * 64
        assert 'patch file was changed' in build()
        s.known['patch'] = real_patch
        (patches / real_patch['file']).write_text('# another patch\n', encoding='utf-8')
        assert 'pass --replace-patch' in build()
        assert build(replace_patch=True) is None


def test_verify_launch_cmd(tmp_path):
    """verify checks launch.cmd against the text the build writes for the manifest (before 2026-11-05 it did not look
    at it, so an edited or deleted launch.cmd passed): in a normal, a d3d12 and a bots build, the file as written passes,
    an edited one (another option, the other GPU backend) and a missing one fail in words."""
    with made_up(tmp_path) as s:
        for name, kw in (('normal', {}), ('d3d12', dict(gpu='d3d12')), ('bots', dict(experiment_bots=True))):
            out = tmp_path / name
            xeniakit.build(s.args(out, **kw))
            launcher = out / 'launch.cmd'
            written = launcher.read_bytes()
            m = json.loads((out / 'kit-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            assert m['gpu'] == kw.get('gpu', 'vulkan') and bool(m['bots_patch']) == (name == 'bots')
            assert written == xeniakit.launcher_text(m, m['gpu']).encode(xeniakit.LAUNCHER_ENCODING)
            verify = argparse.Namespace(out=str(out))
            assert refusal(xeniakit.verify, verify) is None, name
            launcher.write_bytes(written.replace(b'--license_mask=1', b'--license_mask=0'))
            assert f'{launcher} differs from what the build wrote' in (refusal(xeniakit.verify, verify) or ''), name
            other = 'vulkan' if m['gpu'] == 'd3d12' else 'd3d12'
            launcher.write_bytes(xeniakit.launcher_text(m, other).encode(xeniakit.LAUNCHER_ENCODING))
            assert 'differs from what the build wrote' in (refusal(xeniakit.verify, verify) or ''), f'{name}: other GPU'
            launcher.unlink()
            assert f'{launcher} is missing' in (refusal(xeniakit.verify, verify) or ''), name
            launcher.write_bytes(written)
            assert refusal(xeniakit.verify, verify) is None, name
        # a manifest from before the GPU backend was recorded: launch.cmd for either backend passes, another text not
        # (the last build's: the bots build left its patch in Xenia, which the normal builds' verify now refuses)
        out = tmp_path / 'bots'
        m = json.loads((out / 'kit-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        del m['gpu']
        (out / 'kit-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(m), encoding='utf-8')
        verify = argparse.Namespace(out=str(out))
        for gpu in xeniakit.GPUS:
            (out / 'launch.cmd').write_bytes(xeniakit.launcher_text(m, gpu).encode(xeniakit.LAUNCHER_ENCODING))
            assert refusal(xeniakit.verify, verify) is None, gpu
        (out / 'launch.cmd').write_bytes(b'@echo off')
        assert 'differs from what the build wrote' in (refusal(xeniakit.verify, verify) or '')


def test_extract_and_paths(tmp_path):
    with made_up(tmp_path) as s:
        assert xeniakit.extract(str(s.package), str(tmp_path / 't')) == len(FILES)
        assert (tmp_path / 't' / 'dist' / 'xenon' / 'config.zz').read_bytes() == FILES['dist/xenon/config.zz']
    for bad in ('a/../b', '/abs', 'a\\b', 'c:x', 'a//b', './a'):
        assert 'unsafe path' in (refusal(xeniakit.safe_join, str(tmp_path), bad) or ''), bad
    assert xeniakit.safe_join(str(tmp_path), 'a/b') == os.path.join(str(tmp_path), 'a', 'b')
    assert xeniakit.sha256(b'') == hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest()
    assert xeniakit.kit_bots_patches(str(tmp_path / 'none')) == []

```

`bf1943-xenia-kit/xeniakit.py`:

```py
r"""BF1943 Xenia kit: turns your own Battlefield 1943 (XBLA) package into a Xenia setup with offline play.

  python -B xeniakit.py build <package> <xenia folder> [--out <folder>] [--gpu vulkan|d3d12] [--replace-patch]
                              [--experiment-bots] [--experiment-team 1|2]
  python -B xeniakit.py verify [--out <folder>]
  python -B xeniakit.py launch [--out <folder>] [--gpu vulkan|d3d12]

<package> is the game's content package (the file named 945CD965D6B2B2584A9C06CE16F38A075A6D390558, under
5841097E\000D0000\); <xenia folder> holds xenia_canary.exe (Canary build e6cd2e4bc). The output folder,
bf1943-xenia-kit\output\ by default, is never committed: everything in it is made from your own copy.

build:
 1. checks the package against the known release (SHA-256), extracts it verifying every data block's SHA-1,
    and checks each of the 90 files against the known hashes;
 2. edits three files of that copy (each result checked against known.json):
    - menu/main/mainmenu-00.fbrb: the main menu (Local Match opens a browser of locally hosted maps;
      Leaderboards and Return to Game Library removed; no EA Online check when the menu opens; no autosave-icon notice at startup);
    - menu/hud/hud_multiplayer_cq-00.fbrb: the in-game menu (CHOOSE YOUR SIDE before the first deploy;
      FRONTLINE REPORT without Leaderboards; no See Gamer Card);
    - config.zz: GameSettings.cfg network ports above 1024;
 3. installs the patch file (signed in to Xbox LIVE offline, no network) into Xenia's patches folder;
 4. writes xenia_canary_netfix.exe next to xenia_canary.exe (Xenia's UDP address bug fixed; the original
    is only read);
 5. writes title-manifest.json, kit-manifest.json and launch.cmd.
Nothing is downloaded and nothing goes online. The original package and xenia_canary.exe are only read.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    import logging

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
KIT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if __name__ == '__main__':      # the suite's bootstrap (core/suitepath.py)
    import pathlib
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, str(next(p for p in pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents if (p / 'core' / 'suitepath.py').is_file()) / 'core'))
    import suitepath
    suitepath.use()
from bfbc2core import errors  # noqa: E402
import bots  # noqa: E402
import config_edits  # noqa: E402
import igm_edits  # noqa: E402
import menu_edits  # noqa: E402
import netfix  # noqa: E402
from stfs import Package  # noqa: E402

KNOWN = json.load(open(os.path.join(KIT, 'known.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
DEFAULT_OUT = os.path.join(KIT, 'output')
GPUS = ('vulkan', 'd3d12')     # Xenia's --gpu backends; the first is the default
type Manifest = dict[str, Any]     # kit-manifest.json
log = cast('logging.Logger', None)     # set when run (errors.setup) or by a test, before anything says a word


def sha256_file(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        return hashlib.file_digest(f, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def sha256(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def say(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg, flush=True)
    log.info(msg)


def unsafe_part(part: str) -> bool:
    """A package path component that could leave the folder: empty, '.', '..', or holding a backslash or colon."""
    return part in ('', '.', '..') or any(char in part for char in '\\:')


def safe_join(root: str, rel: str) -> str:
    parts = rel.split('/')
    if any(unsafe_part(part) for part in parts):
        raise ValueError(f'unsafe path in the package: {rel!r}')
    path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(root, *parts))
    if os.path.commonpath([path, os.path.abspath(root)]) != os.path.abspath(root):
        raise ValueError(f'path leaves the output folder: {rel!r}')
    return path


def extract(package: str, title: str) -> int:
    """Every file, each data block checked against the package's SHA-1, each file against the known hashes."""
    known = {file['path']: file for file in KNOWN['game']['files']}
    pkg = Package(package)
    try:
        if pkg.magic not in (b'LIVE', b'PIRS', b'CON '):
            raise ValueError('this is not an Xbox 360 content package')
        files = [entry for entry in pkg.entries if not entry['dir']]
        if {entry['path'] for entry in files} != set(known):
            raise ValueError('the package holds different files from the known release')
        for entry in files:
            path = safe_join(title, entry['path'])
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
            blocks = pkg._blocks(entry['start'], entry['count'], entry['consecutive'])
            if len(set(blocks)) != len(blocks) or entry['size'] > len(blocks) * 4096:
                raise ValueError(f'invalid block chain: {entry["path"]}')
            digest, remaining = hashlib.sha256(), entry['size']
            with open(path, 'xb') as out:
                for block in blocks:
                    pkg.f.seek(pkg._addr(block))
                    data = pkg.f.read(4096)
                    if len(data) != 4096 or hashlib.sha1(data).digest() != pkg._hash_entry(block)[:20]:
                        raise ValueError(f'data block SHA-1 mismatch in {entry["path"]} (a damaged package?)')
                    chunk = data[:min(remaining, 4096)]
                    out.write(chunk)
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
            if digest.hexdigest() != known[entry['path']]['sha256']:
                raise ValueError(f'{entry["path"]} differs from the known release')
        return len(files)
    finally:
        pkg.f.close()


def build(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    out = os.path.abspath(args.out)
    args.xenia = os.path.abspath(args.xenia)
    title = os.path.join(out, 'title')
    if os.path.exists(title) and os.listdir(title):
        raise FileExistsError(f'{title} already exists: choose another --out, or delete it to rebuild')
    xenia_exe = os.path.join(args.xenia, netfix.EXE)
    if not os.path.isfile(xenia_exe):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'{xenia_exe} not found: give the folder that holds xenia_canary.exe')
    # a path launch.cmd cannot name is refused before any work
    launcher_text(dict(netfix=os.path.join(args.xenia, netfix.FIXED), title=title), args.gpu)
    say('1/5 checking the package')
    package_hash = sha256_file(args.package)
    if package_hash != KNOWN['game']['package_sha256']:
        raise ValueError(f'the package is not the known Battlefield 1943 release (SHA-256 {package_hash}); '
                         'the edits are only verified for that version')
    xenia_bytes = open(xenia_exe, 'rb').read()
    if sha256(xenia_bytes) != KNOWN['xenia']['exe_sha256']:
        raise ValueError(f'xenia_canary.exe is not the build the kit was made for ({KNOWN["xenia"]["build"]})')
    foreign_bots_patch(os.path.join(args.xenia, 'patches'))   # refused before anything is written
    os.makedirs(title, exist_ok=True)
    say('2/5 extracting and checking every file (about 560 MB)')
    count = extract(args.package, title)
    say(f'    {count} files match the known release')
    say('3/5 editing the main menu and the network ports')
    replaced: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}     # path in the title: its change log
    menu_path = safe_join(title, menu_edits.BUNDLE)
    new_bundle, new_res, menu_log, new_root = menu_edits.build(open(menu_path, 'rb').read())
    if (sha256(new_res) != KNOWN['expected']['main_nav_res_sha256']
            or sha256(new_root) != KNOWN['expected'].get('main_root_res_sha256')):
        raise ValueError('the edited menu movies differ from the verified result')
    cfg_path = safe_join(title, config_edits.ARCHIVE)
    new_cfg, settings, cfg_log = config_edits.build(open(cfg_path, 'rb').read())
    if sha256(settings) != KNOWN['expected']['game_settings_cfg_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('the edited GameSettings.cfg differs from the verified result')
    say('    and the in-game menu: CHOOSE YOUR SIDE before the first deploy'
        if not args.experiment_team else f'    experiment: the deploy screen asks for team {args.experiment_team}')
    igm_path = safe_join(title, igm_edits.BUNDLE)
    new_igm, new_igm_res, igm_log = igm_edits.build(open(igm_path, 'rb').read(), args.experiment_team)
    if not args.experiment_team and sha256(new_igm_res) != KNOWN['expected']['igm_mp_cq_res_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('the edited in-game menu differs from the verified result')
    edited = [(menu_edits.BUNDLE, new_bundle, menu_log), (config_edits.ARCHIVE, new_cfg, cfg_log),
              (igm_edits.BUNDLE, new_igm, igm_log)]
    for rel, data, changes in edited:
        path = safe_join(title, rel)
        with open(path, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(data)
        replaced[rel] = changes
    say('4/5 Xenia: the patch file and the network fix')
    patch_src = os.path.join(KIT, 'patches', KNOWN['patch']['file'])
    if sha256_file(patch_src) != KNOWN['patch']['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('the kit\'s patch file was changed')
    patch_dst = os.path.join(args.xenia, 'patches', KNOWN['patch']['file'])
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(patch_dst), exist_ok=True)
    if os.path.exists(patch_dst) and sha256_file(patch_dst) != KNOWN['patch']['sha256'] and not args.replace_patch:
        raise FileExistsError(f'{patch_dst} exists with other contents: pass --replace-patch to replace it')
    shutil.copyfile(patch_src, patch_dst)
    bots_dst = os.path.join(args.xenia, 'patches', bots.PATCH_FILE)
    bots_text = None
    if args.experiment_bots:
        say('    experiment: offline bots (bots.py; they join, take a kit and spawn, and move only on a host '
            'program\'s commands: navhost, guestmem.py)')
        bots_text = bots.patch_toml()
    install_bots_patch(os.path.dirname(bots_dst), bots_text)
    fixed, fix_log = netfix.build(xenia_bytes)
    if sha256(fixed) != KNOWN['xenia']['netfix_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('the fixed Xenia differs from the verified result')
    fixed_path = os.path.join(args.xenia, netfix.FIXED)
    if not (os.path.isfile(fixed_path) and sha256_file(fixed_path) == KNOWN['xenia']['netfix_sha256']):
        with open(fixed_path, 'wb') as f:  # an identical copy is kept as is (it may be running)
            f.write(fixed)
    say('5/5 manifests and launch.cmd')
    known = {file['path']: file['sha256'] for file in KNOWN['game']['files']}
    files = []
    for rel in sorted(known):
        digest = sha256_file(safe_join(title, rel))
        original = {'original_sha256': known[rel]} if rel in replaced else {}
        files.append(dict(path=rel, sha256=digest, replaced=rel in replaced, **original))
    with open(os.path.join(title, 'title-manifest.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        json.dump(dict(name='bf1943-xenia-kit', base='package', files=files), f, indent=1)
    built = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec='seconds')
    manifest = dict(tool='bf1943-xenia-kit/xeniakit.py', built=built,
                    package=os.path.abspath(args.package), package_sha256=package_hash,
                    xenia=os.path.abspath(args.xenia), xenia_sha256=KNOWN['xenia']['exe_sha256'],
                    netfix=fixed_path, netfix_sha256=sha256(fixed), netfix_changes=fix_log,
                    patch=patch_dst, patch_sha256=KNOWN['patch']['sha256'], title=title, edits=replaced,
                    experiment_team=args.experiment_team, gpu=args.gpu,
                    bots_patch=bots_dst if bots_text else None,
                    bots_patch_sha256=sha256(bots_text.encode()) if bots_text else None)
    with open(os.path.join(out, 'kit-manifest.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        json.dump(manifest, f, indent=1)
    write_launcher(out, manifest, args.gpu)
    say(f'done: {out}\n    play: {os.path.join(out, "launch.cmd")}  (or: python -B xeniakit.py launch)')


def made_by_kit(path: str) -> bool:
    """Whether a patch file starts with the kit's bots header (bots.HEADER)."""
    return open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read().startswith(bots.HEADER)


def kit_bots_patches(patches: str) -> list[str]:
    """Every bots experiment patch in a Xenia patches folder: the file under the kit's bots patch name, and any .toml
    the kit made (it starts with bots.HEADER) under another name. verify allows none in a normal build and only its
    own in a bots build; build leaves the folder that way."""
    if not os.path.isdir(patches):
        return []
    return [os.path.join(patches, name) for name in sorted(os.listdir(patches))
            if name == bots.PATCH_FILE or name.endswith('.toml') and made_by_kit(os.path.join(patches, name))]


def foreign_bots_patch(patches: str) -> None:
    """Refuses a file under the kit's bots patch name that the kit did not make (it is never overwritten or removed)."""
    own = os.path.join(patches, bots.PATCH_FILE)
    if os.path.isfile(own) and not made_by_kit(own):
        raise FileExistsError(f'{own} was not made by this kit: move it away first')


def install_bots_patch(patches: str, text: str | None) -> None:
    """A normal build (text None) leaves no bots patch in Xenia's patches folder, a bots build exactly its own: every
    other kit-made bots patch, under any name, is removed (verify would refuse it; before 2026-10-30 only the kit's own
    file name was, so a renamed copy made the build pass and its verify fail). A file under the kit's name that the
    kit did not make is refused, with nothing changed."""
    foreign_bots_patch(patches)
    own = os.path.join(patches, bots.PATCH_FILE)
    for path in kit_bots_patches(patches):
        if text is None or os.path.normcase(path) != os.path.normcase(own):
            os.remove(path)
    if text is not None:
        with open(own, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
            f.write(text)


def launch_args(manifest: Manifest, gpu: str) -> list[str]:
    """Xenia's command line: the fixed Xenia, the GPU backend, the license mask and the title's default.xex."""
    return [manifest['netfix'], f'--gpu={gpu}', '--license_mask=1', os.path.join(manifest['title'], 'default.xex')]


# cmd.exe reads a batch file line by line, each line in the console's code page at the time it reads it: the OEM one
# (437, 850...) by default, UTF-8 (65001) in a console set to it, as Windows increasingly is. launch.cmd is written in
# UTF-8 and its first lines, plain ASCII, note the console's page and switch it to 65001, so every line naming a path
# is read as written, whatever the page was; the last line switches it back (the page is the console's, and outlives
# the batch file). Before 2026-10-30 the file was UTF-8 without the switch, so in an OEM console a folder such as
# "Xenia José" became another name ("The system cannot find the path specified"); until 2026-10-31 it was written in
# the OEM code page, which failed the same way in a UTF-8 console and refused folders the OEM page cannot hold
# (Cyrillic, CJK). tests/test_xeniakit.py runs it under both pages.
LAUNCHER_ENCODING = 'utf-8'


def cmd_quoted(path: str) -> str:
    """A path as one quoted cmd.exe argument: '%' doubled (cmd expands %...% even inside quotes, so a folder such as
    "50%off" broke the line before 2026-10-30); a path with a double quote, or one UTF-8 cannot write (a lone
    surrogate), is refused."""
    try:
        path.encode(LAUNCHER_ENCODING)
    except UnicodeError:
        raise ValueError(f'launch.cmd cannot name {path!r}: it is not valid Unicode (UTF-8 cannot write it); '
                         'use a folder with another name') from None
    if '"' in path:
        raise ValueError(f'a path with a double quote cannot be passed on: {path!r}')
    return '"' + path.replace('%', '%%') + '"'


def launcher_text(manifest: Manifest, gpu: str) -> str:
    """launch.cmd's text (raises ValueError when a path cannot be written in it). The lines before "chcp 65001" are
    ASCII: they are read in whatever code page the console has."""
    netfix_exe, gpu_flag, license_flag, title = launch_args(manifest, gpu)
    cmd = ' '.join([cmd_quoted(netfix_exe), gpu_flag, license_flag, cmd_quoted(title)])
    return ('@echo off\r\nsetlocal\r\n'
            'rem Made by bf1943-xenia-kit: Battlefield 1943 in Xenia, offline with Local Match.\r\n'
            'rem This file is UTF-8: the console reads it in UTF-8 (code page 65001) from the chcp line on, then gets\r\n'
            'rem its own code page back.\r\n'
            'for /f "tokens=2 delims=:." %%p in (\'chcp\') do set "KIT_CODE_PAGE=%%p"\r\n'
            'chcp 65001 >nul\r\n'
            f'cd /d {cmd_quoted(os.path.dirname(netfix_exe))}\r\nstart "" {cmd}\r\n'
            'if defined KIT_CODE_PAGE chcp %KIT_CODE_PAGE% >nul 2>nul\r\n')


def write_launcher(out: str, manifest: Manifest, gpu: str) -> None:
    text = launcher_text(manifest, gpu)
    with open(os.path.join(out, 'launch.cmd'), 'wb') as f:
        f.write(text.encode(LAUNCHER_ENCODING))


def load(out: str) -> Manifest:
    """The build's kit-manifest.json from an output folder."""
    path = os.path.join(os.path.abspath(out), 'kit-manifest.json')
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'{path} not found: run "xeniakit.py build" first')
    return json.load(open(path, encoding='utf-8'))


def launcher_problem(out: str, manifest: Manifest) -> str | None:
    """Why launch.cmd in an output folder is not what the build wrote for its manifest (None when it is): missing, or
    other bytes than launcher_text gives for the manifest's paths and GPU backend. A manifest from before 2026-11-05
    does not record the backend, so either one is accepted for it."""
    path = os.path.join(os.path.abspath(out), 'launch.cmd')
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        return f'{path} is missing'
    gpu = manifest.get('gpu')
    expected = [launcher_text(manifest, g).encode(LAUNCHER_ENCODING) for g in ([gpu] if gpu else GPUS)]
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        if f.read() not in expected:
            return f'{path} differs from what the build wrote for kit-manifest.json'
    return None


def verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Every title file, the fixed Xenia, the patch files and launch.cmd as the build left them; raises ValueError
    otherwise."""
    manifest = load(args.out)
    bad = []
    title_manifest = json.load(open(os.path.join(manifest['title'], 'title-manifest.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    for file in title_manifest['files']:
        if sha256_file(os.path.join(manifest['title'], *file['path'].split('/'))) != file['sha256']:
            bad.append(file['path'])
    checked = [(manifest['netfix'], manifest['netfix_sha256']), (manifest['patch'], manifest['patch_sha256'])]
    bots_patch = manifest.get('bots_patch')
    if bots_patch:
        checked.append((bots_patch, manifest['bots_patch_sha256']))
    for path, expected in checked:
        if not os.path.isfile(path) or sha256_file(path) != expected:
            bad.append(path)
    if bad:
        raise ValueError(f'changed or missing since the build: {bad}')
    problem = launcher_problem(args.out, manifest)
    if problem:
        raise ValueError(f'{problem} (an older kit or an edit: rebuild into an empty --out to write it again)')
    # the build's bot mode: Xenia applies every patch file in the folder, so a normal build must find no bots patch
    # there (another build against the same Xenia may have written one), and a bots build only its own
    extra = [path for path in kit_bots_patches(os.path.dirname(manifest['patch']))
             if not (bots_patch and os.path.normcase(path) == os.path.normcase(bots_patch))]
    if extra:
        found = 'a normal build, but Xenia has' if not bots_patch else 'Xenia has another'
        raise ValueError(f'{found} bots experiment patch: {extra} (rebuild, or move it away)')
    say(f'ok: {len(title_manifest["files"])} title files, the fixed Xenia, the patch file and launch.cmd match the build'
        f'{" (with the bots experiment)" if bots_patch else "; no bots patch"}')


def launch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    manifest = load(args.out)
    verify(args)
    subprocess.Popen(launch_args(manifest, args.gpu), cwd=os.path.dirname(manifest['netfix']))
    say('Xenia started')


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='xeniakit.py', description=__doc__,
                                     formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    build_parser = commands.add_parser('build')
    build_parser.add_argument('package')
    build_parser.add_argument('xenia')
    build_parser.add_argument('--replace-patch', action='store_true')
    build_parser.add_argument('--experiment-team', type=int, choices=[1, 2],
                              help='experiment: the deploy screen requests this team')
    build_parser.add_argument('--experiment-bots', action='store_true',
                              help='experiment: a second patch file with offline bots')
    for command in (build_parser, commands.add_parser('verify'), commands.add_parser('launch')):
        command.add_argument('--out', default=DEFAULT_OUT)
        command.add_argument('--gpu', default=GPUS[0], choices=GPUS)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv[1:])
    {'build': build, 'verify': verify, 'launch': launch}[args.command](args)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    log = errors.setup('xeniakit', gui=False)
    with errors.guard():
        sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
```

```java
            }
            out.println("suffix entries="+(rows.size()-1));
            out.println("function count="+currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionCount());
        }
    }
```

`bf1943-xex-tools/DecodeXex.java`:

```java
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import xexloaderwv.XEXHeader;
import xexloaderwv.Helper;
import xexloaderwv.LzxDecompression;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.Arrays;

/** Decode only; deliberately do not call ProcessImportLibraries (it patches thunks). */
public class DecodeXex {
    static class CheckedHeader extends XEXHeader {
        CheckedHeader(byte[] data) throws Exception { super(data, new ArrayList<>(), false); }
        @Override public void ReadPEImage(byte[] data) throws Exception {
            if (baseFileFormat.encryption != 1 || baseFileFormat.compression != 2)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pilot only supports NORMAL/NORMAL");
            byte[] compressed = Helper.AESDecrypt(sessionKey, Arrays.copyOfRange(data, offsetPE, data.length));
            int size = baseFileFormat.normal.blockSize, pos = 0, blocks = 0;
            byte[] expected = baseFileFormat.normal.blockHash;
            ByteArrayOutputStream packed = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            while (size != 0) {
                if (size < 24 || pos + size > compressed.length) throw new IOException("Block bounds");
                byte[] block = Arrays.copyOfRange(compressed, pos, pos + size);
                if (!Arrays.equals(expected, MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-1").digest(block)))
                    throw new IOException("Compressed block SHA-1 mismatch at " + pos);
                ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(block).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
                int next = b.getInt(); expected = Arrays.copyOfRange(block, 4, 24);
                for (int p = 24; p + 2 <= size;) {
                    int n = Short.toUnsignedInt(b.getShort(p)); p += 2;
                    if (n == 0) break;
                    if (p + n > size) throw new IOException("Chunk bounds");
                    packed.write(block, p, n); p += n;
                }
                pos += size; size = next; blocks++;
            }
            int window = baseFileFormat.normal.windowSize;
            if (Integer.bitCount(window) != 1) throw new IOException("Invalid window");
            byte[] input = packed.toByteArray();
            LzxDecompression lzx = new LzxDecompression();
            lzx.init(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(window), 0, input.length, loaderInfo.imageSize, false, null);
            ByteArrayOutputStream output = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            lzx.decompress(new ByteArrayInputStream(input), output, loaderInfo.imageSize);
            peImage = output.toByteArray();
            if (peImage.length != loaderInfo.imageSize) throw new IOException("Decoded size mismatch");
            System.out.println("Verified compressed SHA-1 blocks: " + blocks);
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        if (args.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("input.xex output.memory.bin");
        Path output = Path.of(args[1]);
        if (Files.exists(output)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Output already exists");
        XEXHeader header = new CheckedHeader(Files.readAllBytes(Path.of(args[0])));
        if (header.peImage[0] != 'M' || header.peImage[1] != 'Z') throw new IllegalStateException("Missing MZ");
        Files.write(output, header.peImage, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
        System.out.printf("Decoded memory image: %d bytes; base=0x%08x entry=0x%08x%n",
            header.peImage.length, header.imageBaseAddress, header.entryPointAddress);
    }
}
```

```java
// Ghidra script: bounded entry-point disassembly and pseudocode, no target execution.
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.*;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class EntryPilot extends GhidraScript {
    public void run() throws Exception {
        Address entry = toAddr(0x827d78b0L);
        disassemble(entry);
        Function f = createFunction(entry, "xex_entry");
        if (f == null) f = getFunctionAt(entry);
        try (PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(getScriptArgs()[0])) {
            out.println("Exploratory decoded image; integrity validation unresolved. Pseudocode is not original source.");
            out.println("Language: " + currentProgram.getLanguageID());
            InstructionIterator it = currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(entry, true);
            for (int i=0; i<80 && it.hasNext(); i++) {
                Instruction ins = it.next();
                out.println(ins.getAddress() + "  " + ins);
            }
            if (f != null) {
                DecompInterface di = new DecompInterface();
                try {
                    di.openProgram(currentProgram);
                    DecompileResults r = di.decompileFunction(f, 60, monitor);
                    out.println("Decompiler complete: " + r.decompileCompleted());
                    out.println(r.getErrorMessage());
                    if (r.getDecompiledFunction() != null) out.println(r.getDecompiledFunction().getC());
                } finally { di.dispose(); }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`bf1943-xex-tools/ExperimentDecompile.java`:

```java
// Read-only experiments on one function that fails decompilation: annotation-only variants, never semantic changes.
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.app.cmd.disassemble.DisassembleCommand;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.*;
import ghidra.program.model.data.*;
import ghidra.program.model.lang.*;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.SourceType;
import ghidra.program.util.DefaultLanguageService;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
public class ExperimentDecompile extends GhidraScript {
    PrintWriter log;
    boolean respectReadOnly=true;
    String attempt(Function f,String label,Path out)throws Exception{
        DecompInterface di=new DecompInterface();
        try{di.toggleCCode(true);di.setSimplificationStyle("decompile");
            DecompileOptions options=new DecompileOptions();options.grabFromProgram(currentProgram);options.setRespectReadOnly(respectReadOnly);di.setOptions(options);
            di.openProgram(currentProgram);
            DecompileResults r=di.decompileFunction(f,600,monitor);
            String c=r.getDecompiledFunction()==null?null:r.getDecompiledFunction().getC();
            log.println(label+": completed="+r.decompileCompleted()+" has_c="+(c!=null)+" error="+(r.getErrorMessage()==null?"":r.getErrorMessage().trim()));log.flush();
            if(c!=null)Files.writeString(out,"/* variant: "+label+" */\n"+c);
            return c;
        }finally{di.dispose();}
    }
    public void run()throws Exception{
        Path root=Path.of(getScriptArgs()[0]);Path dir=root.resolve("experiment");Files.createDirectories(dir);
        String[] args=getScriptArgs()[1].split("[ ,]+");
        long entry=Long.parseLong(args[0],16);
        log=new PrintWriter(dir.resolve(args[0]+".log").toFile());
        currentProgram.setLanguage(DefaultLanguageService.getLanguageService().getLanguage(new LanguageID("PowerPC:BE:64:XenonVMX128")),new CompilerSpecID("default"),true,monitor);
        Function f=getFunctionAt(toAddr(entry));
        new DisassembleCommand(f.getEntryPoint(),f.getBody(),true).applyTo(currentProgram,monitor);
        Path out=dir.resolve(args[0]+".c");
        // Raw p-code: which instructions touch vector-register storage with a size other than 16 bytes.
        for(Instruction ins:currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(f.getBody(),true))
            for(ghidra.program.model.pcode.PcodeOp op:ins.getPcode()){
                List<ghidra.program.model.pcode.Varnode> vs=new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(op.getInputs()));if(op.getOutput()!=null)vs.add(op.getOutput());
                for(var v:vs)if(v.isRegister()&&v.getOffset()>=0x4200&&v.getOffset()<0x4400&&v.getSize()!=16)
                    log.println("  partial "+ins.getAddress()+" "+ins+" :: "+op);
            }
        if(attempt(f,"baseline",out)!=null){log.close();return;}
        // Hypothesis: read-only constants loaded at 4 and 16 bytes from the same .rdata address become overlapping RAM inputs.
        TreeMap<Long,TreeSet<Integer>> constantReads=new TreeMap<>();Map<Integer,Long> high=new HashMap<>();
        for(Instruction ins:currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(f.getBody(),true)){
            int w=getInt(ins.getAddress()),op=w>>>26,rd=(w>>21)&31,ra=(w>>16)&31;short imm=(short)(w&0xffff);
            if(op==15&&ra==0){high.put(rd,(long)(imm<<16)&0xffffffffL);continue;}
            if((op==48||op==50||op==32)&&high.containsKey(ra))constantReads.computeIfAbsent((high.get(ra)+imm)&0xffffffffL,k->new TreeSet<>()).add(op==50?8:4);
            if(op==14&&high.containsKey(ra))high.put(rd,(high.get(ra)+imm)&0xffffffffL);
            if(ins.getMnemonicString().startsWith("lvx128")||ins.getMnemonicString().equals("lvx")){
                int a=(w>>16)&31,b=(w>>11)&31;Long base=high.get(a)!=null?high.get(a):high.get(b);
                if(base!=null)constantReads.computeIfAbsent(base&~15L,k->new TreeSet<>()).add(16);
            }
        }
        for(var e:constantReads.entrySet())log.println("  constant read 0x"+Long.toHexString(e.getKey())+" sizes="+e.getValue()+" block="+(currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(toAddr(e.getKey()))==null?"none":currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(toAddr(e.getKey())).getName()));
        respectReadOnly=false;
        if(attempt(f,"respectReadOnly=false",out)!=null){log.close();return;}
        respectReadOnly=true;
        for(var e:constantReads.entrySet())if(e.getValue().contains(16)){
            try{createData(toAddr(e.getKey()),new ArrayDataType(FloatDataType.dataType,4,4));}catch(Exception ex){log.println("  data "+Long.toHexString(e.getKey())+" "+ex.getMessage());}
        }
        if(attempt(f,"float[4] data at vector constants",out)!=null){log.close();return;}
        // Diagnose: in each lighter style that completes, list input varnodes and report any overlapping pair.
        for(String style:new String[]{"register","paramid","jumptable","firstpass"}){
            DecompInterface di=new DecompInterface();
            try{di.toggleSyntaxTree(true);di.setSimplificationStyle(style);di.openProgram(currentProgram);
                DecompileResults r=di.decompileFunction(f,600,monitor);
                ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighFunction h=r.getHighFunction();
                log.println("style "+style+": completed="+r.decompileCompleted()+" high="+(h!=null)+" error="+(r.getErrorMessage()==null?"":r.getErrorMessage().trim()));
                if(h==null)continue;
                List<ghidra.program.model.pcode.Varnode> inputs=new ArrayList<>();
                for(Iterator<ghidra.program.model.pcode.VarnodeAST> it=h.locRange();it.hasNext();){var v=it.next();if(v.isInput())inputs.add(v);}
                for(var v:inputs)log.println("  input "+v.getAddress()+" size="+v.getSize()+" reg="+currentProgram.getRegister(v.getAddress(),v.getSize()));
                for(int i=0;i<inputs.size();i++)for(int j=i+1;j<inputs.size();j++){var a=inputs.get(i);var b=inputs.get(j);
                    if(a.getSpace()==b.getSpace()&&a.getOffset()<b.getOffset()+b.getSize()&&b.getOffset()<a.getOffset()+a.getSize())log.println("  OVERLAP "+a.getAddress()+":"+a.getSize()+" with "+b.getAddress()+":"+b.getSize());}
            }finally{di.dispose();}
        }
        log.flush();
        // Frame size from the stwu r1,-N(r1) prologue; r1-relative bases become entry-SP-relative frame offsets.
        int frame=0;TreeSet<Integer> slots=new TreeSet<>();
        for(Instruction ins:currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(f.getBody(),true)){
            int w=getInt(ins.getAddress()),op=w>>>26,rd=(w>>21)&31,ra=(w>>16)&31;short imm=(short)(w&0xffff);
            if(op==37&&rd==1&&ra==1)frame=-imm;
            else if(frame>0&&op==14&&ra==1&&(imm&15)==0)slots.add(imm-frame);
        }
        log.println("frame=0x"+Integer.toHexString(frame)+" vector slots (entry-relative)="+slots);
        StackFrame sf=f.getStackFrame();
        DataType vec=new ArrayDataType(FloatDataType.dataType,4,4);
        for(int s:slots){try{sf.createVariable("vec_"+Integer.toHexString(-s),s,vec,SourceType.USER_DEFINED);}catch(Exception e){log.println("slot "+s+" "+e);}}
        if(attempt(f,"float[4] stack slots",out)!=null){log.close();return;}
        for(int s:slots){Variable v=sf.getVariableContaining(s);if(v!=null)sf.clearVariable(v.getStackOffset());}
        DataType raw=new ArrayDataType(ByteDataType.dataType,16,1);
        for(int s:slots){try{sf.createVariable("raw_"+Integer.toHexString(-s),s,raw,SourceType.USER_DEFINED);}catch(Exception e){log.println("slot "+s+" "+e);}}
        if(attempt(f,"byte[16] stack slots",out)!=null){log.close();return;}
        for(int s:slots){Variable v=sf.getVariableContaining(s);if(v!=null)sf.clearVariable(v.getStackOffset());}
        // Parameter recovery is where the overlap is raised (paramid fails, jumptable succeeds); lock the prototype so it is skipped.
        f.updateFunction(null,new ReturnParameterImpl(VoidDataType.dataType,currentProgram),new ArrayList<Variable>(),
            Function.FunctionUpdateType.DYNAMIC_STORAGE_ALL_PARAMS,true,SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
        if(attempt(f,"prototype locked void(void)",out)!=null){log.close();return;}
        // Diagnosis only: cut one path at a time and report which cut avoids the error. Never used as output.
        Path scratch=dir.resolve(args[0]+".diagnostic.c");
        for(Instruction ins:currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(f.getBody(),true)){
            var flow=ins.getFlowType();FlowOverride cut;
            if(flow.isConditional()&&flow.isJump())cut=FlowOverride.RETURN;
            else if(flow.isCall())cut=FlowOverride.CALL_RETURN;
            else continue;
            ins.setFlowOverride(cut);
            String c=attempt(f,"diagnostic cut "+cut+" at "+ins.getAddress()+" "+ins,scratch);
            ins.setFlowOverride(FlowOverride.NONE);
        }
        // Diagnosis only, in the read-only session: nop one instruction at a time past the formerly undecodable lvlx, then restore it.
        if(args.length>2){
            long lo=Long.parseLong(args[1],16),hi=Long.parseLong(args[2],16);
            for(long a=lo;a<hi;a+=4){
                int original=getInt(toAddr(a));Instruction was=getInstructionAt(toAddr(a));String text=was==null?"?":was.toString();
                clearListing(toAddr(a));setInt(toAddr(a),0x60000000);disassemble(toAddr(a));
                attempt(f,"diagnostic nop at "+Long.toHexString(a)+" ("+text+")",scratch);
                clearListing(toAddr(a));setInt(toAddr(a),original);disassemble(toAddr(a));
                if(getInt(toAddr(a))!=original)throw new Exception("restore failed at "+Long.toHexString(a));
            }
        }
        log.println("no variant produced C");log.close();
    }
}
```

```java
        clearListing(start,end);
        new DisassembleCommand(start,body,true).applyTo(currentProgram,monitor);
        Function f=getFunctionAt(start);if(f==null)f=currentProgram.getFunctionManager().createFunction("pdata_"+start,start,body,SourceType.ANALYSIS);
        int decoded=0,unknown=0,logical=0;
        try(PrintWriter out=new PrintWriter(root.resolve(stem+".asm").toFile())){
            for(Address at=start;at.compareTo(end)<=0;at=at.add(4)){
                Instruction ins=getInstructionAt(at);
                if(ins!=null){decoded++;if(ins.getMnemonicString().equals("vor128"))logical++;}else unknown++;
                out.println(at+" "+(ins==null?"UNDECODED":ins));
            }
        }
        DecompInterface di=new DecompInterface();String error;boolean complete;
        try{di.openProgram(currentProgram);DecompileResults r=di.decompileFunction(f,60,monitor);complete=r.decompileCompleted();error=r.getErrorMessage();
            if(r.getDecompiledFunction()!=null)Files.writeString(root.resolve(stem+".c"),r.getDecompiledFunction().getC());
        }finally{di.dispose();}
        byte[] data=new byte[14352384];currentProgram.getMemory().getBytes(toAddr(0x82000000L),data);
        String hash=HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(data));
        if(!hash.equals("cbb152d10bee2e9c0ed28732a1328791b5510672a83786a5daf67f7b5abff27a"))throw new Exception("Image changed");
        Files.writeString(root.resolve(range[0]==0x82348ec8L?"caller-validation.txt":"permutation-caller-validation.txt"),"decoded="+decoded+" unknown_words="+unknown+" vor128="+logical+" decompile_completed="+complete+" diagnostic="+error+"\nimage_sha256="+hash+"\n");
        }
    }
}
```
