`bf1943-xex-tools/MapXex.java`:

```java
// Apply evidence TSVs to the existing decoded-image project. Never patch bytes.
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.app.cmd.disassemble.DisassembleCommand;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.*;
import ghidra.program.model.address.*;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.*;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;

public class MapXex extends GhidraScript {
    long hex(String s) { return Long.parseUnsignedLong(s.replace("0x", ""),16); }
    String digest() throws Exception {
        byte[] data=new byte[14352384];
        currentProgram.getMemory().getBytes(toAddr(0x82000000L),data);
        return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(data));
    }
    void split(long at) throws Exception {
        Memory mem=currentProgram.getMemory(); Address a=toAddr(at);
        MemoryBlock b=mem.getBlock(a);
        if(b!=null && !b.getStart().equals(a)) mem.split(b,a);
    }
    public void run() throws Exception {
        Path root=Path.of(getScriptArgs()[0]);
        String before=digest();
        if(!before.equals("cbb152d10bee2e9c0ed28732a1328791b5510672a83786a5daf67f7b5abff27a")) throw new IOException("Unexpected memory identity");
        List<String> sections=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("sections.tsv"));
        for(String line:sections.subList(1,sections.size())) {
            String[] c=line.split("\t"); long start=hex(c[1]),size=Long.parseLong(c[2]); split(start); split(start+size);
        }
        int gap=0;
        for(MemoryBlock b:currentProgram.getMemory().getBlocks()) {
            b.setName("unclassified_"+(gap++)); b.setRead(true); b.setWrite(false); b.setExecute(false);
        }
        for(String line:sections.subList(1,sections.size())) {
            String[] c=line.split("\t"); MemoryBlock b=currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(toAddr(hex(c[1])));
            b.setName(c[0]); b.setRead(c[3].equals("1")); b.setWrite(c[4].equals("1")); b.setExecute(c[5].equals("1"));
        }
        int defined=0,conflicts=0; List<Function> samples=new ArrayList<>();
        try(PrintWriter report=new PrintWriter(root.resolve("mapping-report.txt").toFile())) {
            List<String> rows=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("functions.tsv"));
            for(String line:rows.subList(1,rows.size())) {
                monitor.checkCancelled(); String[] c=line.split("\t");
                Address start=toAddr(hex(c[0])),end=toAddr(hex(c[1])-1);
                AddressSet body=new AddressSet(start,end);
                try {
                    Function f=currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(start);
                    if(f==null) f=currentProgram.getFunctionManager().createFunction(c.length>4?c[4]:"pdata_"+c[0],start,body,c.length>4?SourceType.ANALYSIS:SourceType.IMPORTED);
                    else f.setBody(body);
                    f.setComment(c.length>4?"Full-byte-verified register helper block; split at actual blr where needed. Raw pdata bits retained in evidence; unwind flag semantics unresolved.":"BF1943 .pdata declared range; end exclusive 0x"+c[1]+"; prologue bytes="+c[2]+"; exception flag="+c[3]+". Not all bytes necessarily instructions.");
                    defined++;
                    if(samples.size()<8 || start.getOffset()==0x827d78b0L) samples.add(f);
                } catch(Exception e) { conflicts++; report.println("FUNCTION_CONFLICT "+line+" "+e); }
            }
            int imports=0;
            List<String> rowsI=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("imports.tsv"));
            for(String line:rowsI.subList(1,rowsI.size())) {
                String[] c=line.split("\t",-1); String lib=c[0],name=c[2];
                Address slot=toAddr(hex(c[3]));
                createLabel(slot,"__imp_"+lib.replace('.','_')+"_"+name,true);
                setPlateComment(slot,"XEX import ordinal "+c[1]+" from "+lib+"; name resolved by reference table, not embedded symbol.");
                currentProgram.getExternalManager().addExtLocation(lib,name,null,SourceType.IMPORTED);
                currentProgram.getReferenceManager().addExternalReference(slot,lib,name,null,SourceType.IMPORTED,0,RefType.DATA);
                if(!c[4].isEmpty() && !c[4].equals("0") && !c[4].equals("0x0")) {
                    Address thunk=toAddr(hex(c[4]));
                    createLabel(thunk,name,true);
                    setPlateComment(thunk,"XEX unresolved import thunk for "+lib+" ordinal "+c[1]+". Original encoded bytes preserved; not treated as executable PPC before loader fixup.");
                }
                imports++;
            }
            report.println("pdata functions applied="+defined+" conflicts="+conflicts+" imports="+imports);
            DecompInterface di=new DecompInterface();
            try {
                di.openProgram(currentProgram);
                for(Function f:samples) {
                    new DisassembleCommand(f.getEntryPoint(),f.getBody(),true).applyTo(currentProgram,monitor);
                    DecompileResults r=di.decompileFunction(f,20,monitor);
                    report.println("SAMPLE "+f.getEntryPoint()+" complete="+r.decompileCompleted()+" "+r.getErrorMessage());
                    if(r.getDecompiledFunction()!=null) Files.writeString(root.resolve("mapped-"+f.getEntryPoint()+".c"),r.getDecompiledFunction().getC());
                }
            } finally { di.dispose(); }
            report.println("memory_before="+before); report.println("memory_after="+digest());
            if(!before.equals(digest())) throw new IOException("Memory changed");
            try(PrintWriter out=new PrintWriter(root.resolve("ghidra-functions.tsv").toFile())) {
                out.println("entry\tname\tbytes\tmin\tmax");
                for(Function f:currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctions(true))
                    out.println(f.getEntryPoint()+"\t"+f.getName()+"\t"+f.getBody().getNumAddresses()+"\t"+f.getBody().getMinAddress()+"\t"+f.getBody().getMaxAddress());
            }
        }
    }
}

`bf1943-xex-tools/README.md`:

```md
# BF1943 executable tools (bf1943-xex-tools)

Part of the BF1943 Tool Suite. **BF1943 status: ready** (2026-10-23) - tools for BF1943's Xbox 360 executable
(`default.xex`): decode it to a checked memory image, map its functions and imports, build an isolated Xenon
(PowerPC + VMX128) language for Ghidra and test it, decompile every function, and disassemble or search the image.
Moved here from operation-rising-sun's `src/xexresearch` on 2026-10-23 (the investigations that use them stayed
there; their history is in that repository's git log).

They are BF1943's: they check this build's image (SHA-256 `cbb152d10bee2e9c0ed28732a1328791b5510672a83786a5daf67f7b5abff27a`,
base `0x82000000`, entry `0x827d78b0`) and refuse another. Two are more general: `bfbc2dis.py` also reads BFBC2's
Xbox 360 image (as a comparison reference), and the language tests (`Test*.java`) test the Xenon language itself.

## The research workspace

The tools read and write a **research workspace**: a folder with `work\` and `research\` laid out as
operation-rising-sun is. It is `BF1943_RESEARCH`, else the folder you run the tool from (`workspace.py`,
`workspace.ps1`); anything else is refused with what to do. Inputs and outputs, relative to it:

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `work\extracted\default.xex` | your executable (the same file as `bf1943-xenia-kit\output\title\default.xex`) |
| `work\xex-analysis\` | the decoded image (`default.checked.memory.bin`), `functions.tsv`, `sections.tsv`, helper tables, the Ghidra project, the decompiled functions |
| `work\vmx128\` | the Xenon language module (`XenonVMX128`), its encoding table and the test results |
| `work\tools\XEXLoaderWV\` | XEXLoaderWV at commit `4bcf58da` (its Java sources decode the XEX) |
| `work\tools\xenia-95a5c3ee\`, `work\tools\xenia-canary-src\` | Xenia's reference sources (VMX128 semantics; the function trace format) |
| `Tools\XenonRecomp.zip` or `Tools\XenonRecomp\` | the XenonRecomp reference (its `xbox.h` and `ppc-dis`), hash-checked |
| `research\evidence\` | the JSON evidence each step writes (inputs, hashes, counts, validations) |

Also needed: Ghidra 12.1.4 at `C:\Tools\ghidra_12.1.4_PUBLIC` and JDK 26.0.2 at `C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-26.0.2`
(the PowerShell steps use these paths), Python 3 with `capstone` for the disassembly helpers.

## Sources and credits

These tools read third-party sources that you supply. None of them is copied into this repository. Each file is
pinned by hash, and its hash goes into the evidence the tools write.

| Source | License | What we use |
|---|---|---|
| [XenonRecomp](https://github.com/hedge-dev/XenonRecomp), hedge-dev and contributors | MIT | `XenonUtils/xbox.h` (Xbox runtime structures, `map_functions.py`); `recompiler.cpp` (unaligned vector loads and stores, helper bodies) |
| GNU binutils `ppc-dis.c`, Free Software Foundation (bundled in XenonRecomp's `thirdparty/disasm`) | GPL-2.0-or-later | its VMX128 opcode table: the mnemonics, encodings and operand fields that `classify_vmx.py` and `build_vmx_language.py` decode |
| [Xenia](https://github.com/xenia-project/xenia), Ben Vanik and contributors, commit `95a5c3ee` | BSD-3-Clause | `ppc_emit_altivec.cc` and `ppc_instr.h` (VMX128 semantics, the unaligned loads and stores) |
| [Xenia Canary](https://github.com/xenia-canary/xenia-canary), commit `e6cd2e4bc` | BSD-3-Clause | `function_trace_data.h` (the function trace format, `parse_function_trace.py`) |
| [Ghidra](https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra) 12.1.4 | Apache-2.0 | the PowerPC language files that the Xenon module starts from |
| XEXLoaderWV, commit `4bcf58da` | its own | its Java sources decode the XEX |

The p-code we wrote follows the AltiVec PEM and these references. Where a reference decides a behaviour, the comment
in the code and the research write-up name the file and lines.

The language module that `build_vmx_language.py` writes (`work\vmx128\XenonVMX128`) combines Ghidra's files (Apache-2.0)
with entries taken from `ppc-dis.c` (GPL-2.0-or-later). It stays in your workspace; if you share it, its GPL part
comes with GPL terms.

## The pipeline

Run from the workspace, in this order (`<suite>` is this suite's folder):

```powershell
powershell -File <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\decode.ps1                       # XEX -> checked memory image (DecodeXex.java over XEXLoaderWV)
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\inspect_decoded.py                      # image provenance, PE layout, ASCII leads
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\verify_xex_image.py                     # all 219 page digests of the XEX against the image; the .reloc extent
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\map_functions.py                        # PE sections and .pdata runtime functions -> functions.tsv
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\map_imports.py                          # XEX import records
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\resolve_helpers.py                      # register save/restore helper bodies, verified whole
powershell -File <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\map_project.ps1                  # apply the tables to the Ghidra project (MapXex.java; -ValidateOnly: ValidateXex.java)
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\build_vmx_language.py                   # the isolated Xenon language: every VX128 encoding decodes
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\classify_vmx.py                         # classify the image's VX128 words
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\run_vmx.ps1            # compile the language, run every test suite
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\record_vmx_validation.py                # evidence, only when every suite passed on the current inputs
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\run_batch_decompile.ps1  # decompile every function (read-only project)
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\record_batch_decompile.py               # evidence of the batch run (with the before/after comparison when a baseline run exists)
python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\export_callgraph_strings.py --ghidra-call-refs work\xex-analysis\ghidra-call-refs.tsv  # call graph, strings
```

`run_batch_decompile.ps1 -Out <folder> -Module <language module>` runs the batch with another (saved) language into
`work\xex-analysis\<folder>`; a folder named `batch-baseline-<date>` is what `record_batch_decompile.py` compares
against. The batch also writes `fpvmx-mnemonics.tsv` (floating-point and vector instructions, modelled or opaque) and
`ghidra-call-refs.tsv` (the listing's call references, a cross-check for the call graph). `-Extra <tsv> -OnlyExtra` creates functions in-session
(start, end, name, source; e.g. `callgraph\inferred-functions.tsv`, the leaf functions without `.pdata`), refusing any
that overlap an existing function, and decompiles only them; `-Heap` sets the Java heap (default `6g`). Each function's
listing is cleared before flow disassembly (the saved project's stock-language listing stops at words that language
cannot decode), and `unreached-words.tsv` lists every word the flow does not reach.

Every step refuses to overwrite source evidence; the recorders write evidence only after a complete pass. Output is
pseudocode, not original source.

## The files

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `decode.ps1`, `DecodeXex.java` | decode the XEX into a memory image (decode only: imports are not patched) |
| `inspect_decoded.py` | the decoded image's provenance, PE layout and bounded ASCII leads |
| `map_functions.py`, `map_imports.py`, `resolve_helpers.py` | functions (`.pdata`), imports, register helpers |
| `xenonrecomp_reference.py` | hash-checked access to the XenonRecomp reference (archive or extracted folder) |
| `map_project.ps1`, `MapXex.java`, `ValidateXex.java`, `ApplyHelpers.java`, `InspectHelpers.java` | apply and check the tables in the Ghidra project. Ghidra's headless analyzer exits 0 when a post-script throws, so the step also requires the script's own result from this run, whole (`-ValidateOnly`: `saved-validation.txt` starting `PASS`; `MapXex.java`: `mapping-report.txt`; `ApplyHelpers.java`: `helper-application.txt` ending with its `function count=` line; `InspectHelpers.java`: `helper-disassembly.tsv`, its header and 411 rows), and removes the old one first (before 2026-10-30 a failed validation left the previous PASS for `record_batch_decompile.py`). Any other script is refused before Ghidra starts (2026-10-31; before, its failure passed as success). `BF1943_JAVA` / `BF1943_GHIDRA` name other installs (the tests' stand-ins) |
| `verify_xex_image.py` | the XEX page-digest chain over the decoded image (each digest covers the next page and its descriptor), the `.reloc` extent; `research\evidence\xex-image-integrity.json` |
| `build_vmx_language.py`, `classify_vmx.py`, `inventory_vmx.py` | the Xenon language and the image's VX128 words |
| `xenon_vector_semantics.py`, `xenon_splice.py` | our own p-code for AltiVec, VMX128 and the scalar FP conversions, spliced into the language by `build_vmx_language.py` |
| `run_vmx.ps1`, `TestVmx.java`, `TestLogical.java`, `TestPermutation.java`, `TestRlimi.java`, `TestUnaligned.java`, `TestDecodeCoverage.java`, `TestVectorSemantics.java`, `TestScalarFp.java`, `InspectVmxCaller.java`, `record_vmx_validation.py` | the language's test suites and their evidence (`run_vmx.ps1 -Only @('TestVectorSemantics.java')` runs a subset; `-CallerOnly` runs only the two caller probes) |
| `vmx_inputs.py` | the fingerprint of everything a VMX128 run tests (tools, test scripts, the compiled language, its tables, the image): `run_vmx.ps1` stamps it into each result it produces, and `record_vmx_validation.py` refuses results from other inputs or from a partial (`-Only`) run. What the fingerprint does not cover is handled by the recorder, not by changing the fingerprint (it stays `465a75c8...`; `run_vmx.ps1` is one of its inputs, so that script is unchanged): the tested program must be the image (the caller probes' `image_sha256`, since `run_vmx.ps1` re-uses the Ghidra project's saved program once it exists), no file of the language module (the copied Ghidra pspec/cspec, includes, ldefs) may be newer than the run's results, and the module must equal the one the evidence's last record names (a copy that keeps an older mtime passes the first check; `--module-changed` accepts a change made on purpose, 2026-10-31); every module file's hash, Ghidra's version and Java's hash go into the evidence as `environment`, Ghidra and Java being the installs `run_vmx.ps1` names (read from it: `BF1943_GHIDRA` / `BF1943_JAVA`, which only `map_project.ps1` reads, are ignored since 2026-10-31) |
| `export_callgraph_strings.py` | call graph (direct, tail, import and indirect calls, resolved or classified unresolved; leaf functions without `.pdata` inferred), address references, strings with encodings and referencing functions; `work\xex-analysis\callgraph\`. Version 1.2 (2026-10-30): float stores, `dcbz` and VMX128 stores drop the remembered stores they may overwrite (before, a float store kept exactly the slots it could alias, so a reloaded slot could resolve an indirect call wrongly) |
| `run_batch_decompile.ps1`, `export_all_decompiled.java`, `record_batch_decompile.py` | decompile all functions; evidence |
| `DumpCode.java`, `EntryPilot.java`, `InspectMainFunctions.java`, `ExperimentDecompile.java` | Ghidra inspection scripts, run from Ghidra's script manager or headless by hand: they need arguments `map_project.ps1` does not pass, and it cannot confirm their results, so it refuses them |
| `xexrefs.py` | static reference scanning over the image (no Ghidra): words, strings, `lis` pairs; used by operation-rising-sun's investigations. A `lis` value pairs only until its register is written by anything (2026-10-30; before, only at branches and a few forms, so 212 of 55,036 references came from overwritten registers) |
| `ppcdis.py` | `python -B <suite>\bf1943-xex-tools\ppcdis.py <hex address> [count]`: disassembly of the image (capstone, PowerPC 64 big-endian) |
| `bfbc2dis.py` | two images (BF1943's and BFBC2 Xbox 360's): functions, normalized fingerprints, disassembly |
| `parse_function_trace.py` | a Xenia function trace (`run_xenia_probe.ps1 -FunctionTrace` in the test harness) mapped onto the image's functions |
| `workspace.py`, `workspace.ps1` | the research workspace lookup |

## Tests

`python -B tests\test_workspace.py` (the `quick` tier of `run_tests.py`; no game data): `workspace.py` and
`workspace.ps1` accept a folder with `work\` and `research\` and refuse one without. `python -B tests\test_vector_semantics.py`
(also `quick`): the p-code generator gives every modelled mnemonic a body with unique sized locals that writes its
destination (CR6 for record forms); vexptefp/vlogefp (+128) use one named estimate op per lane; vupkd3d128 is
modelled for UIMM 20 and 4 only and vpkd3d128 stays opaque; the fctiw/fctiwz/fctid/fctidz bodies write fD (CR1 for
record forms; fctiw rounds, fctiwz truncates); and it splices without touching decoding.
The emulated semantics tests are Ghidra scripts run by `run_vmx.ps1`. The `bf1943` tier also runs
`ppcdis.py` from the research workspace (`BF1943_RESEARCH`, else operation-rising-sun next to the suite) on the
decoded image; it is skipped without one.

Added 2026-10-30, not in `run_tests.py` yet: `tests\test_callgraph_memory.py` (no game data: float stores, `dcbz` and
VMX128 stores end a remembered store), `tests\test_map_project.py` (Windows; a stand-in java: a post-script that
threw fails the step, an old PASS is gone), and, reading the research workspace (only the image is copied into a
temporary folder; nothing is written there): `tests\test_xexrefs.py` (overwritten registers end a `lis` pairing),
`tests\test_record_vmx.py` (the recorder's environment and its refusals) and `tests\test_output_bytes.py` (map_functions,
classify_vmx, inventory_vmx and resolve_helpers write the outputs that evidence pins by hash byte for byte: CRLF,
as recorded; an LF change on 2026-10-30 was reverted for them and kept for outputs nothing pins; resolve_helpers' helper-branches.tsv, which nothing pins, is CRLF again since 2026-10-31, as recorded, and the test compares it too).

## Checked

Moved and run from operation-rising-sun on 2026-10-23: `map_functions.py` and `inspect_decoded.py` give the same
results as before the move (only their own tool hashes in the evidence differ), and the investigations
`trace_player_pipeline.py`, `trace_ai_soldier_control.py` and `trace_string_leads.py` reproduce their evidence byte for
byte through `xexrefs.py`, `ppcdis.py` and `bfbc2dis.py` from here. The Ghidra steps were not re-run.

Run on 2026-10-26 from operation-rising-sun: `verify_xex_image.py` (all 219 page digests verify), `run_vmx.ps1` (all ten
suites pass), the batch before and after the new semantics (33,232 of 33,232 functions decompile in both), and
`export_callgraph_strings.py` (it includes all 144,917 of Ghidra's direct-call references). See operation-rising-sun's
`research/XENON_FP_VMX_SEMANTICS.md`, `XEX_IMAGE_INTEGRITY.md` and `XEX_CALLGRAPH_STRINGS.md`.

`bf1943-xex-tools/TestDecodeCoverage.java`:

```java
// Every classified VX128 word and every reference-table encoding must decode to its expected mnemonic.
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.app.util.PseudoDisassembler;
import ghidra.app.util.PseudoInstruction;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.PcodeOp;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
public class TestDecodeCoverage extends GhidraScript {
    static final Map<Integer,String> OPCODE31=Map.of(21,"ldx",84,"ldarx",519,"lvlx",775,"lvlxl",551,"lvrx",807,"lvrxl",647,"stvlx",903,"stvlxl",679,"stvrx",935,"stvrxl");
    void check(boolean b,String why)throws Exception{if(!b)throw new Exception(why);}
    String digest()throws Exception{byte[] d=new byte[14352384];currentProgram.getMemory().getBytes(toAddr(0x82000000L),d);return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(d));}
    List<String> userOps(PseudoInstruction ins){List<String> s=new ArrayList<>();
        for(PcodeOp op:ins.getPcode())if(op.getOpcode()==PcodeOp.CALLOTHER)s.add(currentProgram.getLanguage().getUserDefinedOpName((int)op.getInput(0).getOffset()));
        return s;}
    String lastError="";
    PseudoInstruction decode(PseudoDisassembler pd,long at){try{return pd.disassemble(toAddr(at));}catch(Exception ex){lastError=ex.toString();return null;}}
    public void run()throws Exception{
        Path root=Path.of(getScriptArgs()[0]);Files.writeString(root.resolve("decode-coverage.txt"),"RUNNING\n");
        String expectedHash="cbb152d10bee2e9c0ed28732a1328791b5510672a83786a5daf67f7b5abff27a";
        check(digest().equals(expectedHash),"Original image identity");
        PseudoDisassembler pd=new PseudoDisassembler(currentProgram);
        Map<String,int[]> counts=new TreeMap<>();HashSet<Long> classified=new HashSet<>();
        List<String> rows=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("classified.tsv"));
        Map<String,Integer> collisions=new TreeMap<>();
        try(PrintWriter out=new PrintWriter(root.resolve("decode-mismatches.tsv").toFile())){
            out.println("address\tfunction\tword\texpected\tdecoded");
            for(String line:rows.subList(1,rows.size())){
                String[] c=line.split("\t");long at=Long.parseLong(c[0],16);classified.add(at);
                PseudoInstruction ins=decode(pd,at);
                int[] n=counts.computeIfAbsent(c[3],k->new int[3]);n[0]++;
                String got=ins==null?"UNDECODED":ins.getMnemonicString();
                if(!got.equals(c[3])){out.println(line+"\t"+got);collisions.merge(c[3]+" -> "+got,1,Integer::sum);continue;}
                n[1]++;
                if(userOps(ins).stream().anyMatch(o->o.startsWith("VMX128_")))n[2]++;
            }
        }
        check(collisions.isEmpty(),"Classified words not decoding as classified: "+collisions);
        // Synthetic coverage of all 80 reference encodings, including those absent from this image.
        if(currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(toAddr(0x83400000L))==null)currentProgram.getMemory().createInitializedBlock("decode_coverage_test",toAddr(0x83400000L),0x10000,(byte)0,monitor,false);
        clearListing(toAddr(0x83400000L),toAddr(0x8340ffffL));
        Map<String,String> collisionWords=new TreeMap<>();
        Random random=new Random(1943);long at=0x83400000L;int synthetic=0,entries=0,unaligned=0;
        rows=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("vx128-table.tsv"));
        for(String line:rows.subList(1,rows.size())){
            String[] c=line.split("\t");int mask=(int)Long.parseLong(c[2],16),value=(int)Long.parseLong(c[3],16);entries++;
            for(int i=0;i<64;i++){
                int word=value|(random.nextInt()&~mask);setInt(toAddr(at),word);
                PseudoInstruction ins=decode(pd,at);
                if(ins==null || !ins.getMnemonicString().equals(c[0])){
                    collisions.merge(c[0]+" -> "+(ins==null?lastError.replaceAll(" at .*",""):ins.getMnemonicString()),1,Integer::sum);
                    collisionWords.putIfAbsent(c[0]+" -> "+(ins==null?"error":ins.getMnemonicString()),String.format("%08x",word));
                    at+=4;synthetic++;continue;
                }
                boolean opaque=userOps(ins).stream().anyMatch(o->o.startsWith("VMX128_"));
                boolean expectOpaque=c[4].equals("opaque")||(c[4].startsWith("vrlimi128")&&((word>>20)&1)==1)
                    ||(c[4].startsWith("partial:")&&!java.util.Arrays.asList(c[4].substring(8).split("\\|")).contains("xmuimm="+((word>>16)&31)));
                check(opaque==expectOpaque,"Semantics class "+c[0]+" word "+Integer.toHexString(word)+" ops "+userOps(ins));
                if(c[0].matches("(lv|stv)[lr]xl?(128)?")){
                    // Unaligned forms: memory confined to one aligned 16-byte access; the opaque op never receives a pointer.
                    int loads=0,stores=0;
                    for(PcodeOp op:ins.getPcode()){
                        if(op.getOpcode()==PcodeOp.LOAD){check(op.getOutput().getSize()==16,"Unaligned load size "+c[0]);loads++;}
                        if(op.getOpcode()==PcodeOp.STORE){check(op.getInput(2).getSize()==16,"Unaligned store size "+c[0]);stores++;}
                        if(op.getOpcode()==PcodeOp.CALLOTHER)for(int k=1;k<op.getNumInputs();k++)
                            check(op.getInput(k).getSize()==16||op.getInput(k).getSize()==1,"Pointer-sized opaque input "+c[0]+" "+op);
                    }
                    check(loads==1&&stores==(c[0].startsWith("stv")?1:0),"Unaligned memory shape "+c[0]+" loads="+loads+" stores="+stores);
                    unaligned++;
                }
                at+=4;synthetic++;
            }
        }
        check(collisions.isEmpty(),"Synthetic encodings not decoding as table entry: "+collisions+" examples "+collisionWords);
        // Informational: unclassified primary-opcode 4/5/6 words (AltiVec, data or unsupported encodings).
        int other=0,otherDecoded=0;TreeMap<String,Integer> opcode31=new TreeMap<>();
        try(PrintWriter out=new PrintWriter(root.resolve("unclassified-decode.tsv").toFile())){
            out.println("address\tword\tdecoded");
            rows=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("../xex-analysis/functions.tsv"));
            for(String line:rows.subList(1,rows.size())){
                String[] c=line.split("\t");
                for(long a=Long.parseLong(c[0],16);a<Long.parseLong(c[1],16);a+=4){
                    int word=getInt(toAddr(a));int op=word>>>26;
                    if(op==31&&(word&1)==0&&OPCODE31.containsKey((word>>>1)&0x3ff)){
                        // Corrected inherited ldx/ldarx and the Xenon VR0-31 unaligned vector loads/stores.
                        String want=OPCODE31.get((word>>>1)&0x3ff);PseudoInstruction ins=decode(pd,a);
                        check(ins!=null&&ins.getMnemonicString().equals(want),"Opcode-31 word "+Long.toHexString(a)+" expected "+want);
                        opcode31.merge(want,1,Integer::sum);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if((op<4||op>6)||classified.contains(a))continue;
                    PseudoInstruction ins=decode(pd,a);other++;if(ins!=null)otherDecoded++;
                    out.println(Long.toHexString(a)+"\t"+String.format("%08x",word)+"\t"+(ins==null?"UNDECODED":ins.getMnemonicString()));
                }
            }
        }
        try(PrintWriter out=new PrintWriter(root.resolve("decode-coverage.tsv").toFile())){
            out.println("mnemonic\tclassified\tdecoded\twith_opaque_op");
            for(var e:counts.entrySet())out.println(e.getKey()+"\t"+e.getValue()[0]+"\t"+e.getValue()[1]+"\t"+e.getValue()[2]);
        }
        check(digest().equals(expectedHash),"Image bytes modified");
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("decode-coverage.txt"),"PASS COMPLETE classified_words="+classified.size()+" mnemonics="+counts.size()+" table_entries="+entries+" synthetic_words="+synthetic+" unaligned_memory_shape_checked="+unaligned
            +" unclassified_op4_5_6="+other+" unclassified_decoded="+otherDecoded+" opcode31="+opcode31.toString().replace(" ","")+" image_sha256="+expectedHash+"\n");
    }
}

import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.app.emulator.EmulatorHelper;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;
public class TestLogical extends GhidraScript {
    String reg(int n){return n<32?"vs"+(n+32):"v"+n;}
    void check(boolean b,String message)throws Exception{if(!b)throw new Exception(message);}
    public void run()throws Exception{
        Path root=Path.of(getScriptArgs()[0]);Files.writeString(root.resolve("logical-validation.txt"),"RUNNING\n");
        if(currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(toAddr(0x83100000L))==null)
            currentProgram.getMemory().createInitializedBlock("logical_test_code",toAddr(0x83100000L),0x10000,(byte)0,monitor,false);
        clearListing(toAddr(0x83100000L),toAddr(0x8310ffffL));
        int[] codes={528,592,720,784};String[] names={"vand128","vandc128","vor128","vxor128"};
        ArrayList<int[]> cases=new ArrayList<>();
        for(int op=0;op<4;op++)for(int d=0;d<128;d++)for(int mode=0;mode<5;mode++)for(int pattern=0;pattern<2;pattern++){
            int a=(d+31)%128,b=(d+65)%128;
            if(mode==1)a=d;if(mode==2)b=d;if(mode==3)b=a;if(mode==4){a=d;b=d;}
            int word=0x14000000|codes[op]|((d&31)<<21)|((d&96)>>3)|((a&31)<<16)|(a&32)|((a&64)<<4)|((b&31)<<11)|((b&96)>>5);
            setInt(toAddr(0x83100000L+cases.size()*4),word);cases.add(new int[]{op,d,a,b,pattern});
        }
        BigInteger mask=BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(128).subtract(BigInteger.ONE);
        EmulatorHelper e=new EmulatorHelper(currentProgram);
        try{int index=0;
            for(int[] c:cases){
                long at=0x83100000L+index*4;disassemble(toAddr(at));
                check(getInstructionAt(toAddr(at))!=null && getInstructionAt(toAddr(at)).getMnemonicString().equals(names[c[0]]),"Decode "+Long.toHexString(at));
                BigInteger x=c[4]==0?new BigInteger("0123456789abcdeffedcba9876543210",16):mask;
                BigInteger y=c[4]==0?new BigInteger("a55a00ff33cc96966996cc33ff005aa5",16):BigInteger.ZERO;
                e.writeRegister(reg(c[1]),mask);e.writeRegister(reg(c[2]),x);e.writeRegister(reg(c[3]),y);
                x=e.readRegister(reg(c[2]));y=e.readRegister(reg(c[3]));
                BigInteger expected=switch(c[0]){case 0->x.and(y);case 1->x.and(y.xor(mask));case 2->x.or(y);default->x.xor(y);};
                int guard=(c[1]+1)%128;while(guard==c[2]||guard==c[3])guard=(guard+1)%128;
                e.writeRegister(reg(guard),new BigInteger("123456789abcdef",16));e.writeRegister("crall",0x12345678L);
                e.writeRegister(e.getPCRegister(),at);check(e.step(monitor),e.getLastError());
                check(e.readRegister(reg(c[1])).equals(expected),"Result "+Arrays.toString(c));
                check(e.readRegister(reg(guard)).equals(new BigInteger("123456789abcdef",16)),"Adjacent register changed");
                check(e.readRegister("crall").equals(BigInteger.valueOf(0x12345678L)),"CR changed");
                index++;
            }
        }finally{e.dispose();}
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("logical-validation.txt"),"PASS COMPLETE logical_cases="+cases.size()+"; four operations; all destination registers; all source register numbers; five alias patterns; known bit patterns and ones/zero; register and CR preservation\n");
    }
}

        }}finally{e.dispose();}

// Scalar floating-point p-code of the Xenon language: every scalar FP mnemonic BF1943 uses is encoded, emulated and
// compared with a Java model of the PowerPC definition over random and special operands, plus hand-computed
// literal cases (fctiw/fctid rounding and saturation, fsel with NaN and -0, fused-looking chains, loads/stores).
// Writes scalar-fp-validation.txt (last line "PASS COMPLETE ..." only when everything passed).
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;

    void put(EmulatorHelper e,long at,int word)throws Exception{
        clearListing(toAddr(at),toAddr(at+3));setInt(toAddr(at),word);
        e.writeMemory(toAddr(at),new byte[]{(byte)(word>>>24),(byte)(word>>>16),(byte)(word>>>8),(byte)word});

    interface Op{double f(double a,double b,double c);}

    static long rne(double x){return (long)Math.rint(x);}
    static double satw(double x,boolean nearest){
        if(Double.isNaN(x))return Double.longBitsToDouble(0x80000000L);
        double r=nearest?Math.rint(x):(x<0?Math.ceil(x):Math.floor(x));

    int encode(Spec s,int d,int a,int b,int c){
        int w=(s.op()<<26)|(d<<21);
        return switch(s.form()){
            case 'A'->w|(a<<16)|(b<<11)|(s.xo()<<1);
            case 'M'->w|(a<<16)|(c<<6)|(s.xo()<<1);

            case 'B'->w|(b<<11)|(s.xo()<<1);
            default->w|(b<<11)|(s.xo()<<1);};
    }

    }

    double step(EmulatorHelper e,Spec s,long at,int d,int a,int b,int c,double av,double bv,double cv)throws Exception{
        int word=encode(s,d,a,b,c);put(e,at,word);disassemble(toAddr(at));
        Instruction ins=getInstructionAt(toAddr(at));
        check(ins!=null&&ins.getMnemonicString().equals(s.name()),"Decode "+s.name()+" "+Integer.toHexString(word)+" -> "+(ins==null?"none":ins.getMnemonicString()));
        for(PcodeOp op:ins.getPcode())check(op.getOpcode()!=PcodeOp.CALLOTHER,"Opaque op in "+s.name());
        // Unused operand fields first, so an alias with a used register keeps the used value.
        String used=switch(s.form()){case 'A'->"ab";case 'M'->"ac";case 'F'->"abc";default->"b";};
        for(String pass:new String[]{"unused","used"})for(char k:new char[]{'a','b','c'}){
            if((used.indexOf(k)>=0)!=pass.equals("used"))continue;
            int rn=k=='a'?a:k=='b'?b:c;double val=k=='a'?av:k=='b'?bv:cv;e.writeRegister("f"+rn,bits(val));}
        int guard=(d+1)%32;while(guard==a||guard==b||guard==c)guard=(guard+1)%32;
        e.writeRegister("f"+guard,bits(12345.678));
        e.writeRegister(e.getPCRegister(),at);check(e.step(monitor),s.name()+": "+e.getLastError());
        if(guard!=d)check(dbl(e.readRegister("f"+guard))==12345.678,s.name()+" changed f"+guard);
        return dbl(e.readRegister("f"+d));
    }
}

import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.app.emulator.EmulatorHelper;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Instruction;

import java.math.BigInteger;

public class TestUnaligned extends GhidraScript {
    String reg(int n){return n<32?"vs"+(n+32):"v"+n;}
    void check(boolean b,String why)throws Exception{if(!b)throw new Exception(why);}
    static final long BLOCK=0x6000L;
    public void run()throws Exception{
        Path root=Path.of(getScriptArgs()[0]);Files.writeString(root.resolve("unaligned-validation.txt"),"RUNNING\n");
        Map<String,Integer> value=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for(String line:Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("vx128-table.tsv")).subList(1,Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("vx128-table.tsv")).size())){
            String[] c=line.split("\t");if(c[0].matches("(lv|stv)[lr]xl?(128)?"))value.put(c[0],(int)Long.parseLong(c[3],16));
        }
        check(value.size()==16,"Expected 16 unaligned forms, found "+value.keySet());
        // Case: form, register, offset, RA (0 = literal zero, else r3 holds the block and r11 the offset).
        ArrayList<Object[]> cases=new ArrayList<>();ArrayList<Integer> words=new ArrayList<>();
        for(var e:value.entrySet()){
            boolean wide=e.getKey().endsWith("128");
            for(int v=0;v<(wide?128:32);v++)for(int off=0;off<16;off++){
                int ra=(v==5)?3:0;
                int word=e.getValue()|((v&31)<<21)|(wide?((v&96)>>3):0)|(ra<<16)|(11<<11);
                words.add(word);cases.add(new Object[]{e.getKey(),v,off,ra});
                if(v==5){words.add(e.getValue()|((v&31)<<21)|(11<<11));cases.add(new Object[]{e.getKey(),v,off,0});}
            }
        }
        if(currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(toAddr(0x83500000L))==null)currentProgram.getMemory().createInitializedBlock("unaligned_test",toAddr(0x83500000L),0x20000,(byte)0,monitor,false);
        clearListing(toAddr(0x83500000L),toAddr(0x8351ffffL));
        for(int i=0;i<words.size();i++)setInt(toAddr(0x83500000L+4L*i),words.get(i));
        for(int i=0;i<words.size();i++){
            Address a=toAddr(0x83500000L+4L*i);disassemble(a);Instruction ins=getInstructionAt(a);
            check(ins!=null&&ins.getMnemonicString().equals(cases.get(i)[0]),"Decode "+a+" "+cases.get(i)[0]);
        }
        byte[] block=new byte[16],source=new byte[16];
        for(int i=0;i<16;i++){block[i]=(byte)(0x10+i*7);source[i]=(byte)(0xc0+i*3);}
        EmulatorHelper e=new EmulatorHelper(currentProgram);int count=0;
        try{for(int i=0;i<cases.size();i++){
            String name=(String)cases.get(i)[0];int v=(int)cases.get(i)[1],off=(int)cases.get(i)[2],ra=(int)cases.get(i)[3];
            boolean load=name.startsWith("lv"),right=name.charAt(load?2:3)=='r';
            byte[] memory=new byte[48];Arrays.fill(memory,(byte)0xa5);System.arraycopy(block,0,memory,16,16);
            e.writeMemory(toAddr(BLOCK-16),memory);
            if(ra==0)e.writeRegister("r11",BLOCK+off);else{e.writeRegister("r3",BLOCK);e.writeRegister("r11",off);}
            e.writeRegister(reg(v),load?new BigInteger("5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a",16):new BigInteger(1,source));
            int guard=(v+1)%(name.endsWith("128")?128:32);e.writeRegister(reg(guard),BigInteger.valueOf(0x1234));
            e.writeRegister("crall",0x12345678L);e.writeRegister(e.getPCRegister(),0x83500000L+4L*i);
            check(e.step(monitor),e.getLastError());
            // Independent byte model of the Cell definitions; guest byte 0 is most significant.
            byte[] expectedMemory=memory.clone();byte[] expectedRegister=new byte[16];
            if(load&&!right)for(int k=0;k<16-off;k++)expectedRegister[k]=block[off+k];
            if(load&&right&&off!=0)for(int k=0;k<off;k++)expectedRegister[16-off+k]=block[k];
            if(!load&&!right)for(int k=0;k<16-off;k++)expectedMemory[16+off+k]=source[k];
            if(!load&&right)for(int k=0;k<off;k++)expectedMemory[16+k]=source[16-off+k];
            String label=name+" v"+v+" offset="+off+" ra="+ra;
            check(Arrays.equals(e.readMemory(toAddr(BLOCK-16),48),expectedMemory),"Memory "+label);
            if(load)check(e.readRegister(reg(v)).equals(new BigInteger(1,expectedRegister)),"Register "+label+" got "+e.readRegister(reg(v)).toString(16));
            else check(e.readRegister(reg(v)).equals(new BigInteger(1,source)),"Source modified "+label);
            if(guard!=v)check(e.readRegister(reg(guard)).equals(BigInteger.valueOf(0x1234)),"Adjacent register "+label);
            check(e.readRegister("crall").equals(BigInteger.valueOf(0x12345678L)),"CR changed "+label);
            count++;
        }}finally{e.dispose();}
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("unaligned-validation.txt"),"PASS COMPLETE unaligned_cases="+count+"; 16 forms; all 16 offsets; all register numbers per form; RA=0 and RA+RB addressing; guard bytes outside the aligned block; source/adjacent/CR preservation\n");
    }

`bf1943-xex-tools/TestVectorSemantics.java`:

```java
// Vector p-code semantics of the Xenon language (AltiVec/VMX and VMX128): every modelled mnemonic is encoded,
// emulated and compared with an independent Java model of the instruction definition, over random and special
// operands, every register bank and aliased operands; hand-computed literal vectors check the models themselves.
// Writes vector-validation.txt (last line "PASS COMPLETE ..." only when everything passed).
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.app.emulator.EmulatorHelper;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Instruction;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.PcodeOp;
import ghidra.pcode.emulate.BreakCallBack;
import ghidra.pcode.pcoderaw.PcodeOpRaw;
import ghidra.pcode.memstate.MemoryState;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class TestVectorSemantics extends GhidraScript {
    // ---- vector helpers: a vector is byte[16], byte 0 = guest lane 0 (most significant) ----
    static long lane(byte[] v,int e,int i,boolean s){long x=0;for(int k=0;k<e;k++)x=(x<<8)|(v[i*e+k]&0xff);if(s&&e<8){long sign=1L<<(8*e-1);x=(x^sign)-sign;}return x;}
    static byte[] lanes(long[] l,int e){byte[] v=new byte[16];for(int i=0;i<l.length;i++)for(int k=0;k<e;k++)v[i*e+k]=(byte)(l[i]>>>(8*(e-1-k)));return v;}
    static float fl(byte[] v,int i){return Float.intBitsToFloat((int)lane(v,4,i,false));}
    static byte[] fv(float... f){long[] l=new long[4];for(int i=0;i<4;i++)l[i]=Float.floatToRawIntBits(f[i])&0xffffffffL;return lanes(l,4);}
    static long satS(long x,int e){long max=(1L<<(8*e-1))-1,min=-(1L<<(8*e-1));return Math.max(min,Math.min(max,x));}
    static long satU(long x,int e){long max=e==8?-1:(1L<<(8*e))-1;return x<0?0:Math.min(max,x);}
    static boolean nan(float f){return Float.isNaN(f);}
    interface Ref{byte[] f(byte[] d,byte[] a,byte[] b,byte[] c,int imm);}
    interface L2{long f(long x,long y);}
    static Ref ib(int e,boolean s,L2 op){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{int n=16/e;long[] r=new long[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)r[i]=op.f(lane(a,e,i,s),lane(b,e,i,s));return lanes(r,e);};}
    interface F2{float f(float x,float y);}
    static Ref fb(F2 op){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{float[] r=new float[4];for(int i=0;i<4;i++)r[i]=op.f(fl(a,i),fl(b,i));return fv(r);};}
    interface F1{float f(float x);}
    static Ref f1(F1 op){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{float[] r=new float[4];for(int i=0;i<4;i++)r[i]=op.f(fl(b,i));return fv(r);};}
    static float maxf(float x,float y,boolean max){
        if(nan(x))return Float.intBitsToFloat(Float.floatToRawIntBits(x)|0x400000);if(nan(y))return Float.intBitsToFloat(Float.floatToRawIntBits(y)|0x400000);
        if(x==0&&y==0)return Float.intBitsToFloat(max?Float.floatToRawIntBits(x)&Float.floatToRawIntBits(y):Float.floatToRawIntBits(x)|Float.floatToRawIntBits(y));
        return max?(x>y?x:y):(x<y?x:y);}
    static float rnd(float x,char m){
        if(nan(x)||Math.abs(x)>=8388608f)return x;
        double r=switch(m){case 'n'->Math.rint(x);case 'z'->x<0?Math.ceil(x):Math.floor(x);case 'm'->Math.floor(x);default->Math.ceil(x);};
        float f=(float)r;if(f==0)f=Math.copySign(0f,x);return f;}
    static long ctsx(float x,int imm){float v=x*(float)(1L<<imm);if(nan(v))return 0;if(v>=2147483648f)return 0x7fffffff;if(v<-2147483648f)return 0x80000000L;return ((int)v)&0xffffffffL;}
    static long ctux(float x,int imm){float v=x*(float)(1L<<imm);if(nan(v)||v<=0)return 0;if(v>=4294967296f)return 0xffffffffL;return ((long)v)&0xffffffffL;}
    static Ref cmpf(F2 cmpAsFloat){return null;}
    interface FC{boolean f(float x,float y);}
    static Ref fcmp(FC c){return (d,a,b,cc,imm)->{long[] r=new long[4];for(int i=0;i<4;i++)r[i]=c.f(fl(a,i),fl(b,i))?0xffffffffL:0;return lanes(r,4);};}
    interface LC{boolean f(long x,long y);}
    static Ref icmp(int e,boolean s,LC c){return (d,a,b,cc,imm)->{int n=16/e;long[] r=new long[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)r[i]=c.f(lane(a,e,i,s),lane(b,e,i,s))?-1L:0;return lanes(r,e);};}
    static Ref merge(int e,boolean high){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{int n=16/e;long[] r=new long[n];for(int i=0;i<n/2;i++){int k=high?i:i+n/2;r[2*i]=lane(a,e,k,false);r[2*i+1]=lane(b,e,k,false);}return lanes(r,e);};}
    static Ref shift(int e,int kind){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{int n=16/e,bits=8*e;long[] r=new long[n];long m=(1L<<bits)-1;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){long x=lane(a,e,i,false);int s=(int)(lane(b,e,i,false)&(bits-1));
            r[i]=switch(kind){case 0->x<<s;case 1->x>>>s;case 2->lane(a,e,i,true)>>s;default->((x<<s)|(x>>>(bits-s)))&m;};}return lanes(r,e);};}
    static Ref pack(int e,int kind){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{int n=16/e,h=e/2;long[] r=new long[2*n];
        for(int i=0;i<2*n;i++){byte[] src=i<n?a:b;int k=i%n;
            r[i]=switch(kind){case 0->lane(src,e,k,false);case 1->satU(lane(src,e,k,false),h);case 2->satU(lane(src,e,k,true),h);default->satS(lane(src,e,k,true),h);};}return lanes(r,h);};}
    static Ref unpack(int e,boolean high){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{int n=8/e;long[] r=new long[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)r[i]=lane(b,e,high?i:i+n,true);return lanes(r,2*e);};}
    static Ref mul(int e,boolean s,boolean odd){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{int n=16/(2*e);long[] r=new long[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int k=2*i+(odd?1:0);r[i]=lane(a,e,k,s)*lane(b,e,k,s);}return lanes(r,2*e);};}
    static Ref splat(int e){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{int n=16/e;long v=lane(b,e,imm&(n-1),false);long[] r=new long[n];Arrays.fill(r,v);return lanes(r,e);};}
    static Ref splatImm(int e){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{int n=16/e;long v=(imm<<27)>>27;long[] r=new long[n];Arrays.fill(r,v);return lanes(r,e);};}
    static Ref avg(int e,boolean s){return ib(e,s,(x,y)->(x+y+1)>>1);}
    static Ref msum(int e,boolean sa,boolean sb,int sat){return (d,a,b,c,imm)->{long[] r=new long[4];int per=4/e;
        for(int w=0;w<4;w++){long t=sat==2?lane(c,4,w,true):(sat==1?lane(c,4,w,false):lane(c,4,w,sa));for(int j=0;j<per;j++)t+=lane(a,e,w*per+j,sa)*lane(b,e,w*per+j,sb);
            r[w]=sat==1?satU(t,4):sat==2?satS(t,4):t;}return lanes(r,4);};}

        for(int h=0;h<2;h++){final int H=h;s.add(new Spec(h==0?"vupkhpx":"vupklpx",h==0?0x1000034e:0x100003ce,"VB",(d,a,b,c,i)->{long[] o=new long[4];
            for(int k=0;k<4;k++){long x=lane(b,2,k+4*H,false);o[k]=((x>>15)!=0?0xff000000L:0)|(((x>>10)&31)<<16)|(((x>>5)&31)<<8)|(x&31);}return lanes(o,4);},'i',0));}
        // Named estimate ops: the emulator callbacks below compute exact 2^x / log2(x); the test checks lane plumbing.
        Ref exp2=f1(x->(float)Math.pow(2,x)),log2=f1(x->(float)(Math.log(x)/Math.log(2)));
        s.add(new Spec("vexptefp",0x1000018a,"VB",exp2,'f',0));s.add(new Spec("vlogefp",0x100001ca,"VB",log2,'f',0));
        s.add(new Spec("vexptefp128",0x180006b0,"X128U",exp2,'f',0));s.add(new Spec("vlogefp128",0x180006f0,"X128U",log2,'f',0));
        // vupkd3d128 UIMM 20 (encoded in the base word): the four halves of bytes 8-15 to floats (Java's IEEE binary16).
        s.add(new Spec("vupkd3d128",0x180007f0|(20<<16),"X128U",(d,a,b,c,i)->{float[] r=new float[4];for(int k=0;k<4;k++)r[k]=Float.float16ToFloat((short)lane(b,2,4+k,false));return fv(r);},'f',0));
        // vupkd3d128 UIMM 4: z = 0.0, w = 1.0; x, y come from the unknown op (callback value 0x11223344 0x55667788).
        s.add(new Spec("vupkd3d128",0x180007f0|(4<<16),"X128U",(d,a,b,c,i)->lanes(new long[]{0x11223344L,0x55667788L,0,0x3f800000L},4),'i',0));
        s.add(new Spec("vpkpx",0x1000030e,"VX",(d,a,b,c,i)->{long[] o=new long[8];for(int k=0;k<8;k++){long x=lane(k<4?a:b,4,k%4,false);
            o[k]=(((x>>24)&1)<<15)|(((x>>19)&31)<<10)|(((x>>11)&31)<<5)|((x>>3)&31);}return lanes(o,2);},'i',0));
        return s;
    }
    static byte[] fit(BigInteger v){byte[] r=new byte[16];byte[] x=v.toByteArray();for(int k=0;k<16;k++){int j=x.length-16+k;r[k]=j>=0?x[j]:0;}return r;}

    // ---- encoding ----
    static int vmxD(int d){return ((d&31)<<21)|((d>>5)<<2);}
    static int vmxA(int a){return ((a&31)<<16)|(((a>>5)&1)<<5)|((a>>6)<<10);}
    static int vmxB(int b){return ((b&31)<<11)|(b>>5);}
    int encode(Spec s,int d,int a,int b,int c,int imm){
        return switch(s.form()){
            case "VX"->s.base()|(d<<21)|(a<<16)|(b<<11);
            case "VA"->s.base()|(d<<21)|(a<<16)|(b<<11)|(c<<6);
            case "VB"->s.base()|(d<<21)|(b<<11);
            case "VI"->s.base()|(d<<21)|(imm<<16)|(b<<11);
            case "VS"->s.base()|(d<<21)|((imm&31)<<16);
            case "SH"->s.base()|(d<<21)|(a<<16)|(b<<11)|(imm<<6);
            case "X128"->s.base()|vmxD(d)|vmxA(a)|vmxB(b);
            case "X128U"->s.base()|vmxD(d)|vmxB(b);
            case "X128C"->s.base()|vmxD(d)|vmxA(a)|vmxB(b)|((c&7)<<6);
            case "X128B"->s.base()|vmxD(d)|vmxB(b)|(imm<<16);
            case "X128S"->s.base()|vmxD(d)|((imm&31)<<16);
            case "X128H"->s.base()|vmxD(d)|vmxA(a)|vmxB(b)|(imm<<6);
            default->throw new IllegalArgumentException(s.form());};
    }
    String reg(int n){return n<32?"vs"+(n+32):"v"+n;}
    void check(boolean b,String why)throws Exception{if(!b)throw new Exception(why);}
    // Write one instruction word to the program (fresh listing) and to the emulator's memory, which caches pages.
    void put(EmulatorHelper e,long at,int word)throws Exception{
        clearListing(toAddr(at),toAddr(at+3));setInt(toAddr(at),word);
        e.writeMemory(toAddr(at),new byte[]{(byte)(word>>>24),(byte)(word>>>16),(byte)(word>>>8),(byte)word});
    }

    // Operand values: random words, floats of mixed magnitude and the special values.
    static final int[] SPECIAL={0,0x80000000,0x7f800000,0xff800000,0x7fc00000,0x7f800001,0x00000001,0x807fffff,0x3f800000,0xbf800000,0x3f000000,0x4b000000,0x4effffff,0x4f000000,0xcf000000,0x4f800000,
        0x3fc00000,0x40200000,0xbfc00000,0x7f7fffff,0x00800000,0xffffffff,0x7fffffff,0x00000080,0x00008000,0x0000ffff,0x80008000,0x40000000,0xc0000000,0x3e800000,0x47000000,0x2f800000};
    byte[] value(Random r,char kind){
        long[] l=new long[4];
        for(int k=0;k<4;k++){int mode=r.nextInt(6);int w;
            if(mode==0)w=SPECIAL[r.nextInt(SPECIAL.length)];
            else if(mode<=2&&kind=='f'){float f=(float)((r.nextDouble()*2-1)*Math.pow(2,r.nextInt(40)-20));w=Float.floatToRawIntBits(r.nextInt(8)==0?(float)Math.rint(f):f);}
            else if(mode==3){w=(r.nextInt(64)-32);}
            else w=r.nextInt();
            l[k]=w&0xffffffffL;}
        return lanes(l,4);
    }
    boolean same(byte[] got,byte[] want,char kind){
        if(kind=='i')return Arrays.equals(got,want);
        for(int k=0;k<4;k++){float g=fl(got,k),w=fl(want,k);
            // Subnormal results: the emulator's rounding of tiny results differs from IEEE, and Xenon's VMX flushes them
            // (VSCR NJ, not modelled); a zero or subnormal result is accepted for a zero or subnormal expectation.
            if(Math.abs(w)<Float.MIN_NORMAL&&Math.abs(g)<Float.MIN_NORMAL){subnormalTolerated++;continue;}
            if(nan(w)?!nan(g):Float.floatToRawIntBits(g)!=Float.floatToRawIntBits(w))return false;}
        return true;
    }
    static byte[] bytes(BigInteger v){return fit(v);}
    int subnormalTolerated=0;
    static final Set<String> KNOWN=Set.of("exp2_estimate","log2_estimate","vupkd3d128_xy_unknown");
    // Callbacks for the named ops: exact values for the estimates, a fixed marker for the unknown x/y lanes.
    void registerKnownOps(EmulatorHelper e){
        e.registerCallOtherCallback("exp2_estimate",new BreakCallBack(){public boolean pcodeCallback(PcodeOpRaw op){
            MemoryState m=emulate.getMemoryState();float x=Float.intBitsToFloat((int)m.getValue(op.getInput(1)));
            m.setValue(op.getOutput(),Float.floatToRawIntBits((float)Math.pow(2,x))&0xffffffffL);return true;}});
        e.registerCallOtherCallback("log2_estimate",new BreakCallBack(){public boolean pcodeCallback(PcodeOpRaw op){
            MemoryState m=emulate.getMemoryState();float x=Float.intBitsToFloat((int)m.getValue(op.getInput(1)));
            m.setValue(op.getOutput(),Float.floatToRawIntBits((float)(Math.log(x)/Math.log(2)))&0xffffffffL);return true;}});
        e.registerCallOtherCallback("vupkd3d128_xy_unknown",new BreakCallBack(){public boolean pcodeCallback(PcodeOpRaw op){
            emulate.getMemoryState().setValue(op.getOutput(),0x1122334455667788L);return true;}});
    }
    static boolean floatInputs(Spec s){String n=s.name();return n.contains("fp")||n.startsWith("vct")||n.startsWith("vrfi")||n.startsWith("vref")||n.startsWith("vrsq");}

    // Loads, stores, lvsl/lvsr and VSCR moves: every byte offset, RA=0 and RA!=0, guard bytes around the block.
    int testMemory(EmulatorHelper e,long at)throws Exception{
        long data=0x83b00000L;
        if(currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(toAddr(data))==null)currentProgram.getMemory().createInitializedBlock("vector_memory_test",toAddr(data),0x1000,(byte)0,monitor,false);
        Object[][] ops={{"lvsl",0x7c00000c,'x',0},{"lvsr",0x7c00004c,'x',0},{"lvebx",0x7c00000e,'x',1},{"lvehx",0x7c00004e,'x',2},{"lvewx",0x7c00008e,'x',4},{"lvx",0x7c0000ce,'x',16},{"lvxl",0x7c0002ce,'x',16},
            {"stvebx",0x7c00010e,'x',-1},{"stvehx",0x7c00014e,'x',-2},{"stvewx",0x7c00018e,'x',-4},{"stvx",0x7c0001ce,'x',-16},{"stvxl",0x7c0003ce,'x',-16},
            {"lvsl128",0x10000003,'v',0},{"lvsr128",0x10000043,'v',0},{"lvewx128",0x10000083,'v',4},{"stvewx128",0x10000183,'v',-4},{"lvxl128",0x100002c3,'v',16},{"stvxl128",0x100003c3,'v',-16}};
        Random r=new Random(360);int n=0;
        byte[] block=new byte[64];
        for(Object[] o:ops){
            String name=(String)o[0];boolean v128=(char)o[2]=='v';int kind=(int)o[3];
            for(int off=0;off<16;off++)for(int raZero=0;raZero<2;raZero++){
                int d=v128?r.nextInt(128):r.nextInt(32);int ra=raZero==1?0:3,rb=4;
                long base=data+0x100;long ea=base+off;
                int word=(int)o[1]|(v128?vmxD(d):(d<<21))|(ra<<16)|(rb<<11);
                put(e,at,word);disassemble(toAddr(at));Instruction ins=getInstructionAt(toAddr(at));
                check(ins!=null&&ins.getMnemonicString().equals(name),"Decode "+name+" "+Integer.toHexString(word)+" -> "+(ins==null?"none":ins.getMnemonicString()));
                for(PcodeOp op:ins.getPcode())check(op.getOpcode()!=PcodeOp.CALLOTHER,"Opaque op in "+name);
                r.nextBytes(block);e.writeMemory(toAddr(base-16),block);
                byte[] vec=new byte[16];r.nextBytes(vec);e.writeRegister(reg(d),new BigInteger(1,vec));
                if(raZero==1){e.writeRegister("r4",ea);}else{e.writeRegister("r3",base);e.writeRegister("r4",off);}
                e.writeRegister("r0",0x5555);
                e.writeRegister(e.getPCRegister(),at);check(e.step(monitor),name+": "+e.getLastError());at+=4;
                byte[] got=bytes(e.readRegister(reg(d)));byte[] mem=e.readMemory(toAddr(base-16),64);
                int sh=(int)(ea&15);byte[] want=new byte[16];byte[] wantMem=block.clone();
                if(name.startsWith("lvsl"))for(int k=0;k<16;k++)want[k]=(byte)(sh+k);
                else if(name.startsWith("lvsr"))for(int k=0;k<16;k++)want[k]=(byte)(16-sh+k);
                else if(kind>0&&kind<16){long a=ea&~(kind-1);int lanePos=(int)(a&15);for(int k=0;k<kind;k++)want[lanePos+k]=block[(int)(a-(base-16))+k];}
                else if(kind==16){long a=ea&~15L;for(int k=0;k<16;k++)want[k]=block[(int)(a-(base-16))+k];}
                else{int sz=-kind;long a=ea&~(long)(sz-1);int lanePos=(int)(a&15);if(sz==16){a=ea&~15L;lanePos=0;}
                    for(int k=0;k<sz;k++)wantMem[(int)(a-(base-16))+k]=vec[lanePos+k];want=vec;}
                check(Arrays.equals(got,want),name+" off="+off+" ra0="+raZero+" got "+hex(got)+" want "+hex(want));
                check(Arrays.equals(mem,wantMem),name+" off="+off+" memory "+hex(mem)+" want "+hex(wantMem));
                n++;
            }
        }
        // mtvscr then mfvscr: the low word moves through VSCR.
        for(int k=0;k<32;k++){
            int b=r.nextInt(32),d=r.nextInt(32);byte[] vec=new byte[16];r.nextBytes(vec);
            put(e,at,0x10000644|(b<<11));put(e,at+4,0x10000604|(d<<21));disassemble(toAddr(at));disassemble(toAddr(at+4));
            check("mtvscr".equals(getInstructionAt(toAddr(at)).getMnemonicString())&&"mfvscr".equals(getInstructionAt(toAddr(at+4)).getMnemonicString()),"Decode VSCR moves");
            e.writeRegister(reg(b),new BigInteger(1,vec));e.writeRegister(e.getPCRegister(),at);check(e.step(monitor)&&e.step(monitor),"VSCR moves");at+=8;
            byte[] want=new byte[16];System.arraycopy(vec,12,want,12,4);
            check(Arrays.equals(bytes(e.readRegister(reg(d))),want),"mfvscr after mtvscr");n++;
        }
        return n;
    }
    static String hex(byte[] v){return HexFormat.of().formatHex(v);}

                    // Aliased registers carry one value.
                    Map<Integer,byte[]> regVal=new HashMap<>();
                    boolean usesA=!s.form().equals("VB")&&!s.form().equals("VI")&&!s.form().equals("VS")&&!s.form().equals("X128B")&&!s.form().equals("X128S")&&!s.form().equals("X128U");
                    boolean usesC=s.form().equals("VA")||s.form().equals("X128C");
                    regVal.put(d,dv);if(usesA)regVal.put(a,av);regVal.put(b,bv);if(usesC)regVal.put(x128?c:c,cv);
                    dv=regVal.get(d);if(usesA)av=regVal.get(a);bv=regVal.get(b);if(usesC)cv=regVal.get(c);
                    byte[] want=s.ref().f(dv,av,bv,cv,imm);
                    int[] crWant=new int[1];
                    byte[] got=step(e,s,at,d,a,b,c,imm,dv,av,bv,cv,crWant);at+=4;
                    check(same(got,want,s.kind()),s.name()+" d="+d+" a="+a+" b="+b+" c="+c+" imm="+imm+" a="+hex(av)+" b="+hex(bv)+" c="+hex(cv)+" d0="+hex(dv)+" got "+hex(got)+" want "+hex(want));
                    if(s.crMode()>0){
                        int cr=crWant[0],expect;
                        if(s.crMode()==1){boolean all=true,none=true;for(byte q:want){if(q!=(byte)0xff)all=false;if(q!=0)none=false;}expect=(all?8:0)|(none?2:0);}
                        else{boolean in=true;for(byte q:want)if(q!=0)in=false;expect=in?2:0;}
                        check(cr==expect,s.name()+" cr6="+cr+" expected "+expect+" for "+hex(want));
                    }
                    cases++;
                }
                }catch(Exception ex){failures.add(s.name()+": "+ex.getMessage());}
                total+=cases;report.append(s.name()).append('=').append(cases).append(' ');
            }
            try{memoryCases=testMemory(e,at+0x20000);}catch(Exception ex){failures.add("memory: "+ex.getMessage());}
        }finally{e.dispose();}
        if(!failures.isEmpty()){Files.writeString(result,"FAIL "+failures.size()+"\n"+String.join("\n",failures)+"\n");return;}
        Files.writeString(result,"literal_vectors="+literal+"\n"+report.toString().trim()+"\nPASS COMPLETE vector_mnemonics="+specs.size()+" emulated_cases="+total+" literal_vectors="+literal+" memory_cases="+memoryCases+" subnormal_lanes_tolerated="+subnormalTolerated
            +"; no CALLOTHER in any tested instruction other than the named ops exp2_estimate, log2_estimate and vupkd3d128_xy_unknown (emulated by callbacks); destination, guard register and CR checked (CR6 for record forms); register banks 0-127 for VMX128\n");
    }

    // Write operands, step one instruction, return the destination; crOut[0] receives CR6 when asked.
    byte[] step(EmulatorHelper e,Spec s,long at,int d,int a,int b,int c,int imm,byte[] dv,byte[] av,byte[] bv,byte[] cv,int[] crOut)throws Exception{
        int word=encode(s,d,a,b,c,imm);
        put(e,at,word);disassemble(toAddr(at));
        Instruction ins=getInstructionAt(toAddr(at));
        check(ins!=null&&ins.getMnemonicString().equals(s.name()),"Decode "+s.name()+" "+Integer.toHexString(word)+" -> "+(ins==null?"none":ins.getMnemonicString()));
        for(PcodeOp op:ins.getPcode())if(op.getOpcode()==PcodeOp.CALLOTHER&&!KNOWN.contains(currentProgram.getLanguage().getUserDefinedOpName((int)op.getInput(0).getOffset())))throw new Exception("Opaque op in "+s.name()+": "+currentProgram.getLanguage().getUserDefinedOpName((int)op.getInput(0).getOffset()));
        boolean x128=s.form().startsWith("X128");
        String cr=x128&&s.form().equals("X128C")?reg(c):reg(c);
        // Sources first, destination last only if not aliased with a source (aliases already share a value).
        if(s.form().equals("VA"))e.writeRegister(reg(c),new BigInteger(1,cv));
        if(s.form().equals("X128C"))e.writeRegister(reg(c),new BigInteger(1,cv));
        e.writeRegister(reg(b),new BigInteger(1,bv));
        e.writeRegister(reg(a),new BigInteger(1,av));
        e.writeRegister(reg(d),new BigInteger(1,dv));
        e.writeRegister(reg(b),new BigInteger(1,bv));
        if(!s.form().equals("VB")&&!s.form().equals("VI")&&!s.form().equals("VS")&&!s.form().startsWith("X128B")&&!s.form().equals("X128S")&&!s.form().equals("X128U"))e.writeRegister(reg(a),new BigInteger(1,av));
        if(s.form().equals("VA")||s.form().equals("X128C"))e.writeRegister(reg(c),new BigInteger(1,cv));
        int guard=(d+1)%(x128?128:32);while(guard==a||guard==b||guard==c&&(s.form().equals("VA")||s.form().equals("X128C")))guard=(guard+1)%(x128?128:32);
        BigInteger gv=new BigInteger("123456789abcdef0fedcba9876543210",16);
        if(guard!=d)e.writeRegister(reg(guard),gv);
        e.writeRegister("crall",0x1234567812345678L);
        e.writeRegister(e.getPCRegister(),at);
        check(e.step(monitor),"Emulation "+s.name()+": "+e.getLastError());
        if(guard!=d)check(e.readRegister(reg(guard)).equals(gv),s.name()+" changed register "+guard);
        BigInteger crall=e.readRegister("crall");
        long expectAll=0x1234567812345678L;
        if(s.crMode()>0){
            int cr6=e.readRegister("cr6").intValue();if(crOut!=null)crOut[0]=cr6;
            // cr6 is byte 6 of crall (offset 0x906); everything else unchanged.
            long mask=~(0xffL<<8);check((crall.longValue()&mask)==(expectAll&mask),s.name()+" changed CR beyond CR6");
        }else check(crall.longValue()==expectAll,s.name()+" changed CR");
        return bytes(e.readRegister(reg(d)));
    }
}

```java
// Reopen saved database read-only and validate mapped ranges, labels and bytes.
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Function;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
public class ValidateXex extends GhidraScript {
    long hex(String s) { return Long.parseUnsignedLong(s.replace("0x",""),16); }
    public void run() throws Exception {
        Path root=Path.of(getScriptArgs()[0]); int functions=0,imports=0,thunks=0;
        List<String> rows=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("functions.tsv"));
        for(String line:rows.subList(1,rows.size())) {
            String[] c=line.split("\t"); long start=hex(c[0]),end=hex(c[1]);
            Function f=currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(toAddr(start));
            if(f==null || f.getBody().getNumAddresses()!=end-start || f.getBody().getMaxAddress().getOffset()!=end-1)
                throw new Exception("Function mismatch: "+line);
            functions++;
        }
        rows=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("imports.tsv"));
        for(String line:rows.subList(1,rows.size())) {
            String[] c=line.split("\t",-1);
            if(currentProgram.getReferenceManager().getReferencesFrom(toAddr(hex(c[3]))).length==0)
                throw new Exception("No import reference "+line);
            if(currentProgram.getSymbolTable().getSymbols(toAddr(hex(c[3]))).length==0)
                throw new Exception("No slot label "+line);
            if(!c[4].isEmpty()) {
                if(currentProgram.getSymbolTable().getSymbols(toAddr(hex(c[4]))).length==0) throw new Exception("No thunk label");
                thunks++;
            }
            imports++;
        }
        byte[] data=new byte[14352384]; currentProgram.getMemory().getBytes(toAddr(0x82000000L),data);
        int helperLabels=0;
        if(Files.exists(root.resolve("helper-entries.tsv"))) {
            rows=Files.readAllLines(root.resolve("helper-entries.tsv"));
            for(String line:rows.subList(1,rows.size())) {
                String[] c=line.split("\t"); boolean found=false;
                for(var symbol:currentProgram.getSymbolTable().getSymbols(toAddr(hex(c[0])))) if(symbol.getName().equals(c[1])) found=true;
                if(!found) throw new Exception("Missing helper label "+line);
                helperLabels++;
            }
        }
        String hash=HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(data));
        if(!hash.equals("cbb152d10bee2e9c0ed28732a1328791b5510672a83786a5daf67f7b5abff27a")) throw new Exception("Memory mismatch");
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("saved-validation.txt"),"PASS functions="+functions+" imports="+imports+" thunks="+thunks+" helper_labels="+helperLabels+" sha256="+hash+"\n");
    }
}

`bf1943-xex-tools/bfbc2dis.py`:

```py
"""Two-image helpers (BF1943 checked image and BFBC2 Xbox 360 image): .pdata functions, normalized fingerprints,
direct call edges, capstone disassembly. Read only; research reading only (capstone has no VMX128; those print .long).

  python -B <suite>/bf1943-xex-tools/bfbc2dis.py {bf1943|bfbc2} <hex address> [count]

Importing this module looks up the research workspace (workspace.py: BF1943_RESEARCH, else the current folder) for
IMAGES; set BF1943_RESEARCH before the import. The investigations import IMAGES, ROOT and Image from it.
"""
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import bisect  # noqa: E402
import collections  # noqa: E402
import hashlib  # noqa: E402
import struct  # noqa: E402
from collections.abc import Iterator  # noqa: E402

import capstone  # noqa: E402

from workspace import research_root  # noqa: E402

ROOT = research_root()                  # the research workspace (workspace.py)
IMAGES = {'bf1943': (ROOT / 'work/xex-analysis/default.checked.memory.bin',
                     'cbb152d10bee2e9c0ed28732a1328791b5510672a83786a5daf67f7b5abff27a'),
          'bfbc2': (ROOT / 'work/bfbc2-xenon/game.memory.bin',
                    '094e53261d2ffdf2f0c7069b7d6762d46a5bb93ee09b01c1189ffae2dc28c4ae')}
_disassembler = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_PPC, capstone.CS_MODE_64 | capstone.CS_MODE_BIG_ENDIAN)
# D-form loads and stores by primary opcode, for disp_accesses
D_FORM_NAMES = {32: 'lwz', 34: 'lbz', 36: 'stw', 38: 'stb', 40: 'lhz', 44: 'sth', 48: 'lfs', 52: 'stfs', 50: 'lfd',
                54: 'stfd'}


type Normalized = tuple[int] | tuple[int, int]     # (primary opcode, extended opcode or form bits)


def normalize(instruction: int) -> Normalized:
    """Same normalization as compare_bfbc2_code.py: primary + extended opcode, operands masked."""
    op = instruction >> 26
    if op in (19, 31, 63):
        return (op, (instruction >> 1) & 0x3ff)
    if op == 59:
        return (op, (instruction >> 1) & 0x1f)
    if op == 30:
        return (op, (instruction >> 1) & 0xf)
    if op in (58, 62):
        return (op, instruction & 3)
    if op in (4, 5, 6):
        return (op, instruction & 0x7f3)
    if op in (16, 18):
        return (op, instruction & 3)
    return (op,)


class Image:
    """One image ('bf1943' or 'bfbc2', IMAGES), checked against its hash: its .pdata functions and readers over it."""

    def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
        path, expected = IMAGES[name]
        self.name = name
        self.path = path
        self.data = path.read_bytes()
        self.sha256 = hashlib.sha256(self.data).hexdigest()
        assert self.sha256 == expected, path
        pe = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.data, 60)[0]
        self.base = struct.unpack_from('<I', self.data, pe + 24 + 28)[0]
        rva, size = struct.unpack_from('<II', self.data, pe + 24 + 96 + 3 * 8)   # the exception directory (.pdata)
        functions: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
        for offset in range(rva, rva + size, 8):
            start, packed = struct.unpack_from('>II', self.data, offset)
            length = ((packed >> 8) & 0x3fffff) * 4
            if length and start % 4 == 0 and self.base <= start and start + length <= self.base + len(self.data):
                functions.append((start, start + length))
        self.functions = sorted(set(functions))
        self.starts = [start for start, _ in self.functions]
        self.end_of = dict(self.functions)
        self._fingerprints: dict[int, str] | None = None
        self._callers: dict[int, list[tuple[int, int]]] | None = None

    def word(self, address: int) -> int:
        return struct.unpack_from('>I', self.data, address - self.base)[0]

    def valid(self, address: int) -> bool:
        """Whether address lies in the image."""
        return self.base <= address < self.base + len(self.data)

    def containing(self, address: int) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
        """The (start, end) of the .pdata function holding address, or None."""
        i = bisect.bisect_right(self.starts, address) - 1
        return self.functions[i] if i >= 0 and address < self.functions[i][1] else None

    def norm_seq(self, start: int, end: int | None = None) -> list[Normalized]:
        """The normalized instruction words of the function at start (to end, else its .pdata end)."""
        end = end or self.end_of[start]
        return [normalize(self.word(address)) for address in range(start, end, 4)]

    def fingerprint(self, start: int, end: int | None = None) -> str:
        """SHA-1 of the function's normalized instructions (norm_seq), comparable across the two images."""
        return hashlib.sha1(repr(self.norm_seq(start, end)).encode()).hexdigest()

    def fingerprints(self) -> dict[int, str]:
        """{function start: fingerprint} of every .pdata function (computed once)."""
        if self._fingerprints is None:
            self._fingerprints = {start: self.fingerprint(start, end) for start, end in self.functions}
        return self._fingerprints

    def calls(self, start: int, end: int | None = None) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
        """Direct bl targets in order, [(site, target)]."""
        end = end or self.end_of[start]
        out: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
        for site in range(start, end, 4):
            instruction = self.word(site)
            # bl / bla
            if instruction >> 26 == 18 and instruction & 1:
                displacement = instruction & 0x3fffffc
                if displacement & 0x2000000:
                    displacement -= 0x4000000
                absolute = instruction & 2
                out.append((site, (displacement if absolute else site + displacement) & 0xffffffff))
        return out

    def callers(self) -> dict[int, list[tuple[int, int]]]:
        """{target: [(site, calling function start)]} over every function's direct calls."""
        if self._callers is None:
            callers: collections.defaultdict[int, list[tuple[int, int]]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
            for start, end in self.functions:
                for site, target in self.calls(start, end):
                    callers[target].append((site, start))
            self._callers = callers
        return self._callers

    def insn(self, address: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """(mnemonic, operands) of the instruction at address; '.long' for a word capstone cannot decode."""
        offset = address - self.base
        for instruction in _disassembler.disasm(self.data[offset:offset + 4], address):
            return instruction.mnemonic, instruction.op_str
        return '.long', f'0x{self.word(address):08x}'

    def lines(self, address: int, count: int) -> Iterator[tuple[int, int, str, str]]:
        """(address, word, mnemonic, operands) of count instructions from address."""
        for k in range(count):
            at = address + 4 * k
            mnemonic, operands = self.insn(at)
            yield at, self.word(at), mnemonic, operands

    def cstring(self, address: int) -> str | None:
        """The printable ASCII NUL-terminated string at address (1 to 159 characters), else None."""
        if not self.valid(address):
            return None
        offset = address - self.base
        text = self.data[offset:self.data.find(b'\0', offset)]
        if 0 < len(text) < 160 and all(32 <= c < 127 for c in text):
            return text.decode('latin1')
        return None

    def disp_accesses(self, start: int, end: int | None = None) -> list[tuple[int, str, int, int]]:
        """D-form load/store accesses [(addr, mnemonic, base reg, displacement)]."""
        end = end or self.end_of[start]
        out: list[tuple[int, str, int, int]] = []
        for address in range(start, end, 4):
            instruction = self.word(address)
            op = instruction >> 26
            if op in D_FORM_NAMES:
                displacement = instruction & 0xffff
                if displacement & 0x8000:
                    displacement -= 0x10000
                out.append((address, D_FORM_NAMES[op], (instruction >> 16) & 31, displacement))
        return out


if __name__ == '__main__':
    image = Image(sys.argv[1])
    address = int(sys.argv[2], 16)
    count = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ((image.end_of.get(address, address + 160) - address) // 4)
    for at, instruction, mnemonic, operands in image.lines(address, count):
        print(f'{at:08x}  {instruction:08x}  {mnemonic:8s} {operands}')

"""Build an isolated Xenon language: all VX128-table encodings decode; semantics come from xenon_vector_semantics.py
and xenon_splice.py where modelled (vx128-table.tsv: validated, modelled, partial:<immediates>), else they stay opaque."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import xenonrecomp_reference
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import xenon_splice
import xenon_vector_semantics as vsem
import sys as _sys
_sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from workspace import research_root  # noqa: E402
ROOT = research_root()                  # the research workspace (workspace.py)
SOURCE=Path('C:/Tools/ghidra_12.1.4_PUBLIC/Ghidra/Processors/PowerPC/data/languages')

def ops128(operands):
    imm=next((display[o] for o in operands if o in ('UIMM','SIMM','SHB')),None)
    return dict(D='XV',A='XA',B='XB',C='XC',IMM=imm,RA='RA_OR_ZERO',RB='B')
# Unaligned left/right loads and stores: byte shifts within the aligned block containing EA, per
# XenonRecomp recompiler.cpp 1148-1163/1610-1631 and Xenia ppc_emit_altivec.cc 205-335 (see VMX128_UNALIGNED_SEMANTICS.md).
# lvrx/stvrx touch no memory when EA is 16-byte aligned; stores are modeled as read-modify-write of the block.
def unaligned(name):return re.fullmatch(r'(lv|stv)[lr]xl?(128)?',name) is not None
def unaligned_body(name,register):
    right=name[2 if name.startswith('lv') else 3]=='r'
    body=['local ea:8 = RA_OR_ZERO + B;','local block_ea:8 = ea & 0x00000000fffffff0;','local offset:4 = zext(ea:1 & 15);']
    if right:body.append(f'if (offset != 0) goto <access>;')
    if name.startswith('lv'):
        if right:body+=[f'{register} = 0;','goto inst_next;','<access>',f'{register} = *[ram]:16 block_ea >> ((16 - offset) * 8);']
        else:body.append(f'{register} = *[ram]:16 block_ea << (offset * 8);')
    else:
        if right:body+=['goto inst_next;','<access>']
        body+=['local ones:16 = 0;','ones = ~ones;','local tail:16 = ones >> (offset * 8);','local old:16 = *[ram]:16 block_ea;']
        if right:body.append(f'*[ram]:16 block_ea = (old & tail) | (({register} << ((16 - offset) * 8)) & ~tail);')
        else:body.append(f'*[ram]:16 block_ea = (old & ~tail) | (({register} >> (offset * 8)) & tail);')
    return body
def opaque_constructor(name,form,op,value,operands,extra='',pcodeop=None):
    pcodeop=pcodeop or 'VMX128_unimplemented_'+name.replace('.','_rc')
    fields=[display[o] for o in operands];shown=list(dict.fromkeys(fields))
    body=[]
    if operands[1:]==['RA','RB']:
        body.append('local ea:8 = RA_OR_ZERO + B;')
        body.append(f'{pcodeop}(ea, XV);' if name.startswith('stv') else f'XV = {pcodeop}(ea);')
    else:
        args=[]
        for f in fields[1:]+(['XV'] if name in merges else []):
            if f in immediates:
                body.append(f'local {f}_value:1 = {f};');f+='_value'
            args.append(f)
        body.append(f'XV = {pcodeop}({", ".join(args)});')
        if name.endswith('.'):
            body.append(f'cr6 = {pcodeop}_cr6({", ".join(args)});');pcodeops.append(pcodeop+'_cr6')
    pcodeops.append(pcodeop);opaque.append(dict(mnemonic=name,pcodeop=pcodeop,operands=operands))
    return f':{name} {",".join(shown)} is {pattern(op,form,value)} & {" & ".join(dict.fromkeys(fields))}{extra} {{\n    '+'\n    '.join(body)+'\n}\n'
generated=''
for name,form,op,value,operands in table:
    if name in validated:continue
    if unaligned(name):
        body='\n    '.join(unaligned_body(name,'XV'))
        generated+=f':{name} XV,RA_OR_ZERO,B is {pattern(op,form,value)} & XV & RA_OR_ZERO & B {{\n    {body}\n}}\n'
        continue
    if name=='vrlimi128':

                for lane in range(4):

                    generated+=f'    local word{lane}:4 = {"source" if taken else "destination"}({(3-((lane+z)%4 if taken else lane))*4});\n    result = (result << 32) | zext(word{lane});\n'
                generated+='    XV = result;\n}\n'

        generated+=opaque_constructor(name,form,op,value,operands,' & xm20=1',pcodeop='VMX128_unresolved_vrlimi128_imm4')
        continue
    split=vsem.variants(name,ops128(operands))

    modelled.append(name)
